gist: Channel disclaimer: does not promote drugs, alcohol or intoxicants; content is for information and education only; follows community guidelines.
Greeting and thanks to the audience for joining.
General remark that what a person thinks and where life actually goes are different, and this happens to us all the time.
Everyday example: a son or daughter is born, marriage is dreamed of, early joy, then a blast of trouble that shreds hands and feet.
Advice not to be astonished or celebrate too much at the very start of anything in life.
Never assume anything, nobody knows where a thing begins and where it ends up.
He says he had not talked on jyotish for years and planned only a few classes, now unsure how long the series will run (caption partly garbled).
Life turns on its own; do not quarrel between what God wants and what you want.

hindi: जो ईश्वर चाहता है का मतलब यह है कि हमारा प्रारब्ध बंधा हुआ है
says: He defines 'what God wants' as our prarabdha (destiny already earned from past actions), which is bound and fixed before birth.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical prarabdha karma idea behind the birth chart.

hindi: हमारे जीवन की फिक्स जन्मपत्री कुंडली होती है
says: The fixed part of our life is written in the janma patri, the kundali.
ambiguity: Caption word 'फिस' is probably 'फिक्स' (fixed).
classical_check: Classical view: the chart shows karma, consistent.

hindi: कुंडली का मतलब वह स्नैपशॉट जो हमारे जन्म के समय अंतरिक्ष में ग्रहों का था
says: A kundali is a snapshot of where the planets stood in space at the moment of our birth.
classical_check: Agrees: chart is a birth-moment sky map.

hindi: उसको रेखांकित करने के लिए 12 भाव का खाने बनाए जाते हैं और उसमें राहु केतु मंगल बुध बृहस्पति लिख दिए जाते हैं
says: To mark that snapshot, a grid of 12 house boxes is drawn and the planets (Rahu, Ketu, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter and so on) are written into the boxes.
classical_check: Agrees with standard chart construction (12 bhavas).

hindi: यह ग्रह हमें डिनोट करते हैं जैसे ही डॉक्टर देखता है एक रिपोर्ट को और कहता है मैग्नीशियम सोडियम पोटेशियम ऐसा है
says: Planets in the chart denote us the way values in a blood report (magnesium, sodium, potassium) let a doctor describe a patient; the chart is a report that can be read.
classical_check: Analogy only; classical texts are silent on the doctor comparison.

hindi: एक जो यह बता सकता है कि आपकी जीवन के अंदर कब कैसी क्या घटना होगी काफी हद तक बताया जा सकता है
says: A trained reader can tell to a large extent when and what kind of event will occur in your life, though not everything.
classical_check: Agrees with the general predictive claim of Jyotish.

hindi: कुछ चीजें रह जाती हैं क्योंकि ये 12 परसेंट होता है जो जीवन को कमांड करता है
says: Some things stay unpredicted, because the fixed portion of destiny is what commands life; he gives its share as a garbled number, likely meaning 100 percent.
ambiguity: Caption number '12 परसेंट' is garbled; probably 'सौ परसेंट' (100 percent). Meaning of 'some things are left' is also unclear.
classical_check: Silent on percentage claims.

hindi: यानी अनचेंजेबल 12 पर है जैसे कुछ भी हो जाए आप अपने जीवन में यही नाक लेकर चलेंगे यही आंख यही कान यही शरीर
says: The fixed part is unchangeable, like the nose, eyes, ears and body structure you carry through life whatever happens.
ambiguity: Garbled '12 पर' again, likely 100 percent.
classical_check: Silent; this is his analogy.

hindi: यह घटता बढ़ता रहेगा बड़े होंगे फिर बुढ़ापे की ओर जाएंगे लेकिन रहेगा यह वैसा ही आपका डीएनए आपका सिग्नेचर है
says: The body grows and shrinks and ages, but your basic form stays the same; your DNA is your signature and is the model for the unchangeable part.
classical_check: Silent; modern analogy.

hindi: वह कभी नहीं बदल सकता वह 12 पर ही रहेगा फिक्स है बाकी चीजें वेरिएबल है
says: That signature can never change and stays fixed, while everything else in life is variable.
ambiguity: Garbled percentage again.
classical_check: Classical split of fixed (drdha) and changeable (adrdha) karma roughly matches.

hindi: पेट ने भोजन पचा ही है आप अलग-अलग किस्म का खा सकते हैं कुछ सूट नहीं करेगा कुछ करेगा कुछ आप स्वाद पाएंगे कुछ नहीं
says: Analogy for the variable part: the stomach digests, you may eat many kinds of food, some will suit you and taste good and some will not.
classical_check: Silent; illustration only.

hindi: एक जैन परिवार के अंदर हो सकता है मांस खाने वाले बच्चे का संस्कार हो वह उठ जाए और एक मासाहारी परिवार में जैन समुदाय जैसा बच्चा हो जाए
says: A child in a Jain family may carry meat-eating tendencies, and a child in a non-vegetarian family may turn saintly or Jain-like; he says these are qualities of past-life prarabdha.
classical_check: Consistent with the sanskara carry-over idea; no specific text cited.

hindi: एक परिवार में आपने जन्म लिया क्योंकि वहां आपके भाग्य के द्वारा आगे का जीवन बनना है
says: You take birth in a particular family because your destiny will build the rest of your life through that family.
classical_check: Agrees with classical idea of birth family as karmic placement.

hindi: पूर्व जन्म के संस्कार है उस आत्मा के तो जब वह इस जन्म में पैदा हो जाएगा तो इस घर में आने के पश्चात उसके मन में नॉनवेज की इच्छा आ जाएगी
says: If the soul carries past-life sanskara of non-veg, then even in a strictly vegetarian, non-drinking home the child will develop a craving for non-veg without knowing why.
ambiguity: Start of the sentence is at the end of the previous chunk.
classical_check: Silent on diet specifics.

hindi: पूर्व जन्म के द्वारा निर्धारित बीमारी उसको लग जाएगी बच्चों को टाइप वन डायबिटीज होती है
says: A disease fixed by the past life will attach to the person; he gives childhood type 1 diabetes as his example. (Medical claim recorded as he said it, not endorsed.)
classical_check: Classical texts link some diseases to past-life karma (purvajanma-krita roga); a specific modern disease is not named there.

hindi: कौन से पाप होते हैं अभी तो कर्म ही नहीं किया पैदा हुए लूले लंगड़े कोई कटे हाथ के साथ पैदा क्यों हुआ है किसी की आंख ही खराब है अंधा ही पैदा हुआ है
says: Rhetorical argument: a newborn has done no deeds yet, so birth defects (lame, missing hand, blind) can only come from the previous life's fate.
classical_check: Agrees with karma-rebirth reasoning; no text cited.

hindi: यह सब 12 परसेंट पूर्व जन्म का भाग्य होता है बहुत से ऐसे दोष होते हैं जिसमें भगवान कहता है मैं कुछ नहीं करूंगा
says: These are entirely past-life fate; many afflictions are of the kind where God says he will do nothing, so they have to be borne.
ambiguity: Garbled percentage, likely 100.
classical_check: Matches the classical view that some doshas are non-remediable (drdha karma).

hindi: आप भगवान की सारी जिंदगी पूजा करो वो कहता है बेटा भोग योनि है इस जन्म में कष्ट भोगना पड़ेगा
says: Even a lifetime of worship will not remove such a bhoga (to-be-suffered) affliction; God tells you that this birth's suffering must be endured.
classical_check: Partly differs: classical texts do offer upayas even for heavy karma, though they say fixed karma is only softened.

hindi: यह कोटा तो तेरा पूरा हुआ नहीं पिछले जन्म में जो कर्म किए उसके आगे ही तो भोगना है
says: Your quota of suffering is not yet complete; what you must endure now is the continuation of what you did in the previous birth.
classical_check: Agrees with prarabdha doctrine.

gist: We spend life asking why I am cheated, why I get hurt, why only I cry while my brothers do well.

hindi: वो बहाना है जो भाई बने बहन बने दोस्त बने आपको अपना ही जीना है इसलिए अपनी जिंदगी जीनी है अपनी जिंदगी मरनी है
says: Siblings, friends and others are only pretexts for your destiny; each person must live and die their own life.
ambiguity: 'बहाना' continues the previous sentence about comparison with others.
classical_check: Silent; philosophical statement.

hindi: इस जन्म में 12 पर फिक्स भाग्य के साथ आप कितनी समझदारी ला सकते हैं यह एक एडिशनल गुण है
says: Within a fixed destiny, how much wisdom you can bring is an additional quality of yours and is the one thing you can add.
ambiguity: Garbled percentage.
classical_check: Consistent with the view that wisdom softens karma; no text cited.

hindi: आपका जीवन विभाजित है छोटे-छोटे टुकड़ों में 12 पर आपका भाग्य है जो आपकी जन्म कुंडली है
says: Life is divided into small pieces (phases) and the fixed destiny shown in the birth chart governs them.
ambiguity: Whether 'pieces' means dasha periods or only general phases is not stated.
classical_check: Consistent with dasha-based division of life.

hindi: बहुत सी डिबेट होती है इस बात पर कि नहीं भाग्य लिखा नहीं होता पहले से फिर भी चीजें अपने आप हो रही हम लिख सकते हैं कौन सी तोप उखाड़ लेते हैं
says: He mentions the debate that destiny is not pre-written and says that if we could write it ourselves, what great thing do we achieve; he dismisses the free-will side.
classical_check: Silent; philosophical.

hindi: जो लोग लिख सकते हैं 10 20 50 चीज करते हैं फिर रोते हैं
says: People who believe they write their own destiny do ten, twenty, fifty things and still end up crying.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Elon Musk example: reached about 250 billion, bought Twitter for 44 billion, the company fell into loss; he asks where it will end.

hindi: यह हम अपना भाग्य बनाते हैं हम लगातार भाग्य बनाते बिगाड़ते हैं यानी हमारे से यही होना लिखा होता है
says: We keep making and breaking what we call our fortune, yet it was written that this very making and breaking would happen through us.
ambiguity: Could be a question ('do we make our fortune?') or a statement; the caption has no marks.
classical_check: Silent; reconciles free will with fixed destiny.

hindi: सिर्फ ज्ञान के द्वारा हम उसके अंतर्गत फेलियर को बर्दाश्त करने की ताकत लाते हैं
says: Knowledge does not change destiny; it only gives the strength to bear failure inside it.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: कोई भी डॉक्टर आपका ऐसा उपाय नहीं कर सकता कि हां भाई अब तू और ताकतवर हो गया तुझे फीवर नहीं होगा या होगा तो बचेगा
says: No doctor can make you so strong that fever will never come; at most he helps you survive it; likewise knowledge gives resilience, not immunity.
classical_check: Silent; analogy.

hindi: आप हेलमेट लगाते प्रोटेक्शन के लिए इसका यह मतलब नहीं अब एक्सीडेंट के लिए तैयार है
says: Wearing a helmet for protection does not mean you are now ready for an accident; protection reduces harm but is not an invitation to it, an analogy for remedies.
classical_check: Silent; analogy.

hindi: इस 12 पर भाग्य जो फिक्स है जो नहीं बदलेगा उसको आप यदि अपना 72 पर शरीर देते हैं तो उसका इंपैक्ट नजर आएगा अदर वाइज इंपैक्ट नजर नहीं आएगा
says: For the fixed destiny that will not change, a remedy shows impact only if you give it your full effort or body; otherwise no impact is seen. (Numbers garbled, meaning inferred.)
ambiguity: Numbers '12' and '72' are garbled, probably 'सौ' and 'सौ' (100 percent); what he asks you to give is unclear.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसी भाग्य के अंतर्गत जो आपके जीवन के अंदर नेगेटिव चीजें हैं उनको आप काट सकें इस ज्ञान रूपी बुद्धि के द्वारा आप इसको सेटल कर सकेंगे
says: Inside the fixed destiny, negative things in life can be cut down or settled through knowledge in the form of wisdom.
ambiguity: A '6 पर' number before 'ज्ञान' is garbled and left out.
classical_check: Consistent with jnana as the highest upaya in classical thought.

hindi: आप इसको बिना बदले इसके अंदर शांति के साथ ना इवॉल्व किए हुए मजे में जी सकते हैं यानी कि आप शांति से देखेंगे बाहर बरसात हो रही है और अपनी छतरी ले जाने का फैसला करेंगे
says: Without changing destiny you can live inside it in peace, like calmly noting that it is raining outside and choosing to take an umbrella.
ambiguity: 'ना इवॉल्व किए हुए' (without getting involved) is unclear in the caption.
classical_check: Silent; analogy.

hindi: आपको भगवान ने सिर्फ एक ही चीज दी है धरती पर चॉइस
says: The only thing God gave you on earth is choice.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: बारिश हो रही है क्या करना है भीगना है नहीं भीगना है लड़ाई हो रही है तुम्हें गुस्सा करना है नहीं करना है यह तुम्हारी मर्जी
says: Choice means deciding whether to get wet in the rain or whether to get angry in a fight; the reaction is your own will.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इदा और पिंगला यस और नो इलेक्ट्रॉन और प्रोटॉन
says: He ties the binary nature of choice to the two energy channels, Ida and Pingala, calling them like yes and no, or electron and proton.
ambiguity: Short phrase; the link between Ida/Pingala and choice is inferred.
classical_check: Ida (lunar) and Pingala (solar) are yogic nadis; yes/no and electron/proton mapping is his own.

hindi: भगवान कुछ नहीं कहता मैं कुछ करूंगा कृष्ण ने कुछ किया ही नहीं यह एग्जांपल है
says: God does not say he will do something for you; Krishna in the Mahabharata did nothing himself and is the example of this non-interference.
ambiguity: Caption is compressed; Krishna example could refer to guiding without fighting.
classical_check: Consistent with Krishna as charioteer, not a fighter.

hindi: साक्षात आपको ज्ञान होगा और आप ऐसा जिए वैसा जिए अच्छा जिए गंदा जिए अपनी ऐसी तैसी कराए
says: With real knowledge you are free to live this way or that, well or badly, even ruin yourself; the choice remains yours.
ambiguity: A garbled number sits before 'ज्ञान'; sentence meaning inferred.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपके जीवन में अग्नि रूपी आपके जीवन को चलाने वाली अग्नि जिसके अंतर्गत सांस का सुई धागा चल रहा है ये आ गया नाभी पर
says: The fire principle that runs your life sits at the navel and works the needle and thread of the breath.
ambiguity: A garbled number before 'अग्नि'; maybe a fraction of life.
classical_check: Matches yogic manipura/agni at the navel; not a Jyotish point.

hindi: हमने कभी सांस नहीं लिया एक सेकंड के लिए भी जिंदगी में अगर हमने लिया होता तो हमारी मर्जी से हम छोड़ते ना
says: We never actually took a breath by our own will; if we did, we would also be able to stop it by will, so breathing runs by itself.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: हमने लिया होता तो रात को सोते सोते भूल जाते ये अग्नि तत्व अपने आप चल रहा है
says: If we were breathing by will we would forget to breathe in sleep; so the fire element keeps it going on its own.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: सिलाई होती है ना आप मशीन में देखा होगा ऐसे चलती है खड़ खच खिच खिच दो कपड़े आपस में सिल जाते हैं ऐसे ये धागा
says: Sewing-machine analogy for the breath thread: like the needle stitching two cloths together, the breath continuously stitches life; the sentence is cut off at the end of the slice.
ambiguity: Sentence ends mid-way; the point is inferred from the previous breath-thread sentence.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसके द्वारा आप क्या काम कर रहे हैं आप नहीं कर रहे हैं क्या हो रहा है ये स्वयं
says: You are not the real doer of what the body does; what is happening is being done by 'Swayam', the inner self, through you.
ambiguity: The sentence opens mid-thought from the previous slice (the fire element running the breath).
classical_check: Resembles the Gita idea of the doer being the guna or atman, not the ego; not a Jyotish rule.

hindi: ये एक स्वयं नाम का देवता है स्वयं
says: He names a deity called 'Swayam' (Self) who sits inside each person and drives the body.
ambiguity: Swayam as a 'deva' is his own terminology.
classical_check: Not a classical Jyotish deity; closer to the atman/jiva idea.

hindi: इसके अतिरिक्त ये हो गया 12 72 6 4 इसके अलावा बच गया 100 में से
says: He adds up several shares (captioned as 12, 72, 6, 4) of the life-energy out of 100 and says some portion is left over from the 100.
ambiguity: The four numbers are garbled captions of percentages (fixed destiny, body, knowledge, fire); real values cannot be recovered.
classical_check: Silent; his own scheme.

hindi: वो अनलिमिटेड हो सकता है वो है आपका स्पेस एलिमेंट जिसे हम कहते हैं कृपा यह इनफिनिटी है
says: What is left over beyond the fixed parts is unlimited; it is your space (akasha) element, which he calls kripa or grace, and it is infinite.
ambiguity: A '%' fragment before 'छह नहीं है' is unclear.
classical_check: Akasha as the fifth element is classical; equating it with grace is his own link.

hindi: अनलिमिटेड कृपा ली जा सकती है कहां से ले सकते हैं औरों से
says: Unlimited grace can be taken, and the source is other people.
classical_check: Silent; compare the classical idea of blessings of elders and guru.

gist: Imagined objection: I am poor, only a small amount is written in my fate, how will it become 100 or even 1000.

hindi: मैं औरों से लूंगा मामा जी से ले लूंगा चाचा से ले लूंगा ऐसे औरों से मैं ब्लेसिंग ले सकता हूं कृपा ले सकता हूं प्रेम ले सकता हूं धन ले सकता हूं
says: Answer to the objection: take from others, such as maternal uncle or paternal uncle; you can receive blessing, grace, love and even money from other people.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आप औरों से लेने लायक बुद्धि रखते हैं तो वो बुद्धि ज्ञान रूपी बुद्धि आपको गुरु दे सकता है
says: If you have the intellect to receive from others, a guru can give you the knowledge-type intellect (wisdom) that makes you fit to receive.
ambiguity: Jupiter as guru-karaka is not mentioned here.
classical_check: Silent; consistent with guru (Jupiter) as giver of jnana.

hindi: और यह अग्नि आपकी ऐसे ही चलेगी यह अग्नि ऐसे ही चलती रहेगी यह आपके शरीर को चलाएगी
says: The fire element (the garbled share of life) keeps running by itself in the same way and keeps your body going.
ambiguity: Percentage before 'अग्नि' is garbled.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: शरीर आपका व्हीकल है जैसे इस बृजेश गौतम का व्हीकल यह शरीर इस्तेमाल किया जा रहा है किसी शक्ति के द्वारा
says: The body is only a vehicle; he says his own body is being used by some power, so what he speaks is not truly his.
classical_check: Silent; spiritual claim.

gist: He says he is nothing himself, someone else is using him; who that is is a big separate topic to be taught in some later class.

hindi: यह शरीर एक वसल है जैसे घर के बाहर एक गाड़ी खड़ी है चार भाइयों में से कोई भी चला सकता है

hindi: अब जुपिटर डिस्टर्ब है कुंडली में जुपिटर ठीक कर लेने से आपके घर के नॉर्थ ईस्ट की करेक्शन होगी
says: If Jupiter is disturbed in the kundali, then repairing Jupiter there will also correct the north-east of the house; the two corrections work in both directions.
ambiguity: Sentence continues into the 32:02 chunk; direction of the correction (chart to home) is as he says.
classical_check: Silent; assumes a Jupiter-north-east link.

gist: He says this is a matter of depth and a very deep science.
Different places in the home have their programmes; he says more points will open as we keep adding.

hindi: शरीर के अंग भी हमने देखे यहां किस प्रकार है
says: Body parts are also mapped onto the boxes of the chart, which he says we have looked at, showing how each part sits in which box.
ambiguity: No specific part or box is given here.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical kalapurusha mapping of houses to body parts.

hindi: जैसे मान लो यहां पर राहु का कार्यक्रम है अभी करेंगे बात कर्म स्थान तो वहां पर आपको खूब बढ़िया से चाय कॉफी खिलानी पिलानी चाहिए लोगों को
says: For example, if Rahu's programme (remedy) is in the karma place, you should serve people really good tea and coffee there.
cells_derived_method: Where Rahu occupies or troubles the 10th, the remedy form would change with the sign: Rahu's gifts of drinks follow the sign lord's nature. Derived.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in the 10th in Gemini (Mercury's sign) suggests serving tea or coffee to staff or colleagues in a way that fits communication-based work.
Derived: Rahu in the 10th in Virgo (Mercury) suggests serving fresh, clean refreshments to workers and service staff.
Derived: Rahu in the 10th in Sagittarius (Jupiter) suggests serving tea to teachers, priests and elders.

ambiguity: He says 'यहां पर राहु का कार्यक्रम' without saying whether Rahu sits in the 10th or whether it is the remedy slot; 'कर्म स्थान' is the 10th.
classical_check: Rahu remedies are classical but a tea-and-coffee offering at the workplace is his own.

hindi: उससे क्या होता है गृह शुद्ध होता है बेहतरी आती है तो आपके छोटे-छोटे इवेंट्स छोटे-छोटे कार्य करने से भी खराबी अच्छाई होती है
says: The result is that the planet is cleansed and things improve; even small events and small acts can bring good or harm.
ambiguity: 'गृह' is written, likely 'ग्रह' (planet).
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आप कुत्ते को रोटी डालते हैं गाय को रोटी डालते हैं या आपके केतु शुक्र जैसा कुंडली में
says: Feeding bread to a dog or a cow is also a remedy, linked to Ketu (dog) and Venus (cow) as they stand in your kundali.
ambiguity: The sentence is cut short at 'जैसा कुंडली में'; the planets named are Ketu and Venus but the dog-Ketu and cow-Venus pairing is inferred.
classical_check: Agrees: dog is commonly tied to Ketu and the cow to Venus or Moon.

gist: Therefore proceed with full knowledge, as he says.

hindi: यह कहा जाता है वास्तु के अंतर्गत जब आपका घर लाजवाब पैसा बरकत दे रहा है शरीर स्वास्थ्य ठीक रख रहा है सारे घर की फोटो खींच लो और देख लो कहां क्या रखा है
says: Vastu advice: when your house is giving excellent prosperity and keeping your body healthy, photograph the entire house to record where everything is placed.
classical_check: Silent; a practical method of his, not from vastu texts.

hindi: जैसे ही अगली बार लाइफ में कोई प्रॉब्लम हो फोटो से मिलाओ यार कुछ हिलाया है हमने कोई नया ऑब्जेक्ट रखा है नई
says: When a problem appears later, compare the home with the old photo to see whether you moved something or placed a new object, since that change may be the cause.
ambiguity: The sentence is cut off at the end of the slice ('नई...').
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: पेंटिंग लाए हैं कोई नए कालीन कारपेट सोफे कुछ रंग बदला है हमने पेंट अलग कर दिया है उसको वापस वैसा कर दो वापस जिंदगी ठीक हो जाएगी
says: If life went wrong after you brought new paintings, carpets or sofas, or repainted walls in a different colour, put the old arrangement and colour back and life will settle again. He treats recent changes at home as a cause of trouble and reversal as the fix.
ambiguity: He does not say which planet or house the colour or object change disturbs; it is a general vastu-style reversal remedy.
classical_check: Classical Jyotish is silent on this; it is closer to vastu and to Gautam's own experience-based method.

hindi: कहते हैं ना फूड हैबिट्स बदल लो वापस वैसे खा लो जैसे खाते थे हम इसम वाला कहते हैं अपना वाला मत बदलो जैसे वाले हो वैसे रहो जैसे ही आपने किया ठीक हो जाओगे
says: Where someone is told to change food habits as a remedy, he says go back to eating the way you used to eat; do not alter your natural diet, and you will be fine once you return to it.
ambiguity: The caption is a bit garbled around 'इसम वाला कहते हैं'; the sense of 'do not change your own natural way' is clear.
classical_check: Classical texts prescribe food restrictions on some days or for some planets; his advice to simply revert differs from that. Silent as a general rule.

hindi: इसी प्रकार वापस वैसा ही करना शुरू करो जो करते थे जैसा जी रहे थे वैसे जियो ये फालतू के दानवीर मत बनो फालतू की मत सोचो
says: General rule that the fix for a rough patch is to resume the routine and way of living you had before the trouble began, and to stop being a needless big donor or overthinking.
ambiguity: 'Daanveer' is used sarcastically for people who donate wildly as a remedy; it is not praise.
classical_check: Classical dana remedies are encouraged when prescribed for a specific planet; he warns against unguided giving, which differs in emphasis.

hindi: कर्म कृपा जब तक पता नहीं है मत करो यह आप करोगे आपको हो सकता है ले डूबे
says: Do not perform remedial acts or seek grace-type rituals until you actually know what they are for; doing them blindly can sink you instead of helping.
ambiguity: 'कर्म कृपा' is garbled; most likely refers to karma or kripa style remedies done without knowledge.
classical_check: Classical texts also say remedies should be chosen per the chart; agrees in spirit, silent on the exact claim.

gist: Rhetorical aside asking which temple Elon Musk or Zuckerberg goes to and which havan they do, implying they succeed without ritual.
Mimics a devotee chanting Jai Lakshmi Maiya, Diwali has come, open the doors, mocking ritual-driven wealth hopes.
Says one can realise God through mind, speech and action (manasa vacha karmana); a philosophical remark with no chart content.
Remarks that Buddha's dharma and Mimamsa-type darshan are largely atheistic yet part of our tradition; philosophy discussion, no astrology.
Praises Sanatan for accepting all darshans and says any route to reach God is valid, no path wrong or right.

hindi: नॉनवेज मत खाओ वेज मत खाओ आएगा समय नॉनवेज खाने वाला एक दिन कहे यार इसकी जरूरत नहीं है इट विल बिकम यूजलेस अन इंपॉर्टेंट और छोड़ देगा
says: Do not force or preach diet rules either way; a non-vegetarian will himself drop meat when the time comes because it becomes unimportant to him, so natural change beats imposed restriction.
ambiguity: He starts with a muddled 'don't eat non-veg, don't eat veg'; meaning is do not impose either rule.
classical_check: Tradition often recommends vegetarian days for planetary remedies; this relaxed view differs from that.

hindi: यदि आप कहेंगे यह गंदी बात है यह गंदी बात है आप अनवांटेड वांट बना रहे हैं आपके जीवन में वो होके रहेगा आप शनि एक्टिवेट कर रहे हैं और कूटकूट के मुन्ना आपका वो काम कराएगा
says: If you keep condemning something as dirty or bad, you build an unwanted want; that very thing will come into your life, because you are activating Saturn, who will make you do it thoroughly.
cells_derived_method: Saturn's strength and house decide what kind of repression turns into compulsion: Saturn in 12th makes suppressed urges show in secret or foreign settings; Saturn in 7th shows through partners; Saturn in 10th through work habits. Not said by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna is Scorpio (7-12+1=-4, so 8); Saturn exalted in Libra in the 12th would turn condemned urges into hidden, tightly controlled habits or private indulgence.
Derived: lagna is Cancer (10-7+1=4); Saturn in own sign in the 7th would turn condemned relationship patterns into repeated partner themes.

ambiguity: He links Saturn to compulsion of rejected things, but does not specify houses or signs.
classical_check: Classical Saturn is delayer, karmic enforcer; the idea of Saturn forcing what you resist is consistent in spirit but not stated in texts.

gist: Mentions a class of his called The Unwanted Wants on this topic.
Urges the audience to be comfortable, easy and enjoy life, even if earning only about 25 thousand a month.
Says ask people earning lakhs who are still crying, and be happy with 50 thousand; contentment advice.
Starts with body is fine, then a garbled line linking the owner with money and something about attacking 72; cannot be understood.

hindi: जो ज्यादा पैसे वाले हैं वह गलत चीजों के दान करते हैं गलत वास्तु की बिल्डिंग बना लेते हैं ब्यूटी देखते हैं कितनी ब्यूटीफुल मकान बिल्डिंग घर बनाया है उसका वास्तु एनर्जी डिस्टर्ब हो जाती हैं
says: Wealthy people often donate wrong things and build good-looking houses with wrong vastu; the beauty is seen but the building's vastu energy gets disturbed, harming the occupants.
ambiguity: The first half of the sentence has a garbled 'दान चीजें बनाते हैं'; I read it as wrong donations.
classical_check: Vastu is a separate shastra from Jyotish; classical Jyotish is silent here.

hindi: यह शरीर जो चल रहा है यह चिजी है इसके अंदर एनर्जी बॉडी है यह जो हम चीजों का दान करते हैं ये चीजों के अंदर एनर्जी को हम डालते हैं हाथ से और जाता है पानी के अंदर
says: The physical body carries an energy body; when we donate or offer things we pour our energy into those objects through the hand, and when they are released into water that energy goes into the water. This is his mechanism for why remedies work.
ambiguity: 'चिजी' is probably a caption error for a word like 'physical'.
classical_check: Classical texts give no such mechanism; they just prescribe dana and jala-pravaha. Silent.

hindi: यहां जल के अंदर चार फूल भी फेंक देने मात्र से आपके काम बन जाते हैं कि यह वाले चार फूल जल को दे दो कौन से पीले लाल घी से शहद से एग्जांपल की बात
says: Simply offering four flowers (for example yellow or red ones, or items like ghee or honey, as examples) into flowing water is said to get your work done; the planet is pacified once the offering flows away.
ambiguity: Flower colour and substance (ghee, honey) are given only as examples; no planet is named for each.
classical_check: Floating offerings in flowing water is a common remedy in tradition (jala-pravaha); the specifics are his own.

hindi: वो आपके जल प्रवाहित हो जाने मात्र से गृह शांत हो जाता है और आपका काम हो जाता है कैसी मजेदार बात है खुले स्थान में कोई चीज दबा दी जाए उससे आपका काम होता है
says: Once the offering is carried off by water the troubling graha is calmed and your work is done; likewise burying an object in an open place is also said to get your work done.
ambiguity: 'गृह' here is almost certainly 'graha' (planet); no particular planet is named.
classical_check: Burying and flowing remedies appear in later lal-kitab style traditions and folk practice; classical Parashari texts are silent.

hindi: अभी ये तो बड़ी वहम की बात है बिल्कुल वहम है जिसे समझ ना आए आप एक अनपढ गवार गांव में
says: He voices the objection that such remedies sound like superstition and answers that it is only superstition for someone who cannot understand how they work; the gap is in the listener's understanding.
ambiguity: Could be read as him agreeing it is superstition, but the following analogy shows he defends remedies.
classical_check: Not a classical matter; it is a defence of remedial practice.

gist: Begins an analogy about an uneducated villager, continued in the next chunk.
Analogy: tell an old villager his liver is paining and he will say what is a liver, as he does not know the concept; so mechanisms unknown to us look foolish.

hindi: सिर्फ बाबा जी के आशीर्वाद देने से भी होता है ऐसे ऐसे लोग हैं कि किसी महात्मा ने आशीर्वाद दे दिया काम हो गया जी
says: He says there are people for whom a saint or baba merely giving a blessing is enough and their work gets done, offered as another example of things working without a mechanism we understand.
ambiguity: It is unclear if he endorses this or is repeating what sceptics or believers say.
classical_check: Silent in classical Jyotish; it is a devotional claim.

gist: Says people go to Vaishno Devi, various places and gurudwaras believing in their power, and receive some grace.
We go as beggars asking for grace and keep wandering because we do not know the right source; switch on the inner guru who already sits within.

hindi: ये अलग-अलग खाने है हम अलग-अलग खानों के हिसाब से आगे बात करेंगे
says: The chart is made of separate boxes (houses) and he will go forward discussing the material box by box.
ambiguity: 'खाने' means the boxes of a north- or south-Indian style chart, taken here as houses.
classical_check: Agrees with the standard bhava-by-bhava approach.

hindi: अब हमारे यह पहला खाना होता है यह खाना हमारा फिक्स है ये फिक्स खाने जो हमने देख लिए जो भी थे अब मान के चलते हैं हम यहां से हम उलट लेकर चलेंगे
says: The first box is fixed in position, and the fixed boxes already seen are taken as given; from here he will proceed in a reverse order, counting the signs backwards.
ambiguity: 'फिक्स खाने' may refer to the fixed house positions of the chart format, or to earlier boxes explained in the series.
classical_check: Silent; it is his teaching sequence.

hindi: 12 नंबर राशि लेते हैं पहले कि ये 12 नंबर राशि है इसके बाद एक आएगी दो आएगी तीन 11 हम उलट चलेंगे
says: He starts the study from sign number 12 (Pisces) first; after it come 1, 2, 3 in normal order, and then he will walk backwards through 11 and downwards for his reverse counting drill.
ambiguity: The caption mixes forward order 1, 2, 3 with reverse 11; the exact walk is unclear.
classical_check: Silent; it is a teaching device.

hindi: एक नंबर से हमने स्टार्ट करना है तो एक ही नंबर राशि और पहले ही भाव में
says: If you begin from number 1, it is sign 1 (Aries) in the first house, meaning sign number and house number coincide when Aries is the lagna.
cells_derived_method: Aries lagna makes sign number equal house number for every box; for any other lagna the house number is sign minus lagna plus 1.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna is Aries (1-1+1=1) so sign and house numbers match everywhere.
Derived: lagna is Libra (10-4+1=7); Capricorn sits in the 4th house, so sign number 10 and house number 4 differ and must not be confused.

ambiguity: Sign number versus house number overlap is the thing he warns about in the next lines.
classical_check: Agrees with the standard numbering of Aries as sign 1.

gist: People will be confused; counting 12 11 10 9 8 reprograms the brain like rebooting or rewiring, with talk of neuroplasticity and new connections.

hindi: यह 12 नंबर किसी की कुंडली में लगन में लिखा है यहां पर सिर्फ एक ही मतभेद है कि 12 नंबर के साथ काम कौन-कौन सा राशियां कर रही है क्या 12 कर रहा है 11 कर रहा है
says: Suppose 12 (Pisces) is written in a person's lagna; the only difference to resolve is which other signs also work with 12 on that lagna: is it 12 alone, or 11 (Aquarius) working too. So the first house is influenced by more than one sign.
cells_derived_method: A house is touched by its major sign and a neighbouring minor sign; each carries impact. The lagna reading blends Pisces (Jupiter-Ketu) with Aquarius (Saturn-Pluto) nature in proportion to the degrees falling in each.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Pisces, Jupiter-ruled body and mind, soft, intuitive self.
Derived: if part of the first house falls in Aquarius, Saturn-style detachment and structure colour the self.
Derived: with Pisces lagna (1-2+1=0, so 12) the second house holds Aries, giving sharp speech and assertive money-making.

ambiguity: He could mean sign 12 only versus sign 11 and 12 together; he lists the combinations in the next chunk.
classical_check: Bhava chalit and Sripati do shift house cusps across signs, so this agrees with the idea that houses straddle signs.

hindi: हमारे पास एक जन्म कुंडली है एक चलित कुंडली है एक निर्ण भाव है एक कृष्ण मूर्ति पद्धति है
says: The charts at his disposal are the birth chart, the chalit chart, a nirnaya or nirayana bhava chart (name garbled), and the Krishnamurti Paddhati chart.
ambiguity: 'निर्ण भाव' is garbled and may be nirayana bhava or sripati-type equal house chart.
classical_check: Birth chart, chalit and KP are all standard systems; the garbled one cannot be checked.

hindi: एक बृजेश गौतम के अपने भी जीवन के एक्सपीरियंस से जो कुंडली आई है वह भी है जिसको देखा है सटीक असर मिलते हैं कमाल के
says: He adds a fifth chart, derived from his own life experience and observation, which he claims gives accurate and remarkable effects.
ambiguity: The construction of his own chart is not described here.
classical_check: Not in any classical text; it is his personal method and has not been validated here.

gist: Says he will cover everything slowly, with grace the BG chart and KP chart will come too.

hindi: यह सब हम जोड़ तोड़ चलेंगे साथ में
says: He will combine and cross-check all these charts together instead of using one alone.
ambiguity: 'जोड़ तोड़' can mean combine or manipulate; taken as combine.
classical_check: Agrees with the practice of checking rasi against chalit and KP.

gist: As life brings new experience, new knowledge comes by grace, and nobody knows where inventions come from; leads into the next chunk.
Claims that with these charts your predictions will be rocket-like and people will say oh my God how did you know.
Quips that you can wash the other person with words, needing no Ariel or Tide detergent.
Assume 12 is in the lagna; your own chart may be complicated, so he will not complicate it today and will first learn the sutra.

hindi: हो सकता है य 11 नंबर भी काम कर रहा है 12 भी कर रहा है हो सकता है एक नंबर भी कर रहा है हो सकता है 11 12 कर रहे हैं या 12 एक कर रहा है या तीनों भी कर सकते हैं
says: On a lagna the working signs may be 11 alone, 12 alone, 1 alone, or the pairs 11 and 12, 12 and 1, or all three together. The first house is therefore multi-sign, with Aquarius, Pisces and Aries all possible contributors.
cells_derived_method: The first house spans parts of three adjacent signs; weight each by its share of degrees. Each house in each chart is touched by 2 or more signs, so reading one sign only is incomplete.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: if only the Aquarius share is strong, the self reads Saturn-like, restrained and group-minded.
Derived: an Aries share adds Mars-like drive and quick temper to the personality.
Derived: with Pisces lagna (6-7+1=0, so 12) the seventh house falls in Virgo, with neighbouring sign shares of Leo or Libra influencing partners.

ambiguity: Whether he means exactly three signs for the lagna or just the possible spread.
classical_check: Agrees with bhava-chalit idea that a house can cover parts of adjacent signs; the three-sign spread is wider than usual.

hindi: तो उसमें हमें मल्टीपल कुंडलियां घुमानी पड़ती है आपका ब्रेन इतना शार्प हो जाएगा कि एक बार में आप पांच छह कुंडली घुमा लेते हो इतनी स्पीड से घुमाते हो
says: Because of the multiple possible signs, the reader must rotate several charts mentally, five or six at once, and with practice the brain becomes quick enough to do that rapidly while interpreting.
ambiguity: 'Kundali ghumana' means mentally cycling through chart variants, not literally rotating a chart.
classical_check: Reading several charts together is standard practice; the five-six count is his own.

hindi: ये 12 नंबर की कुंडली है यहां से आपके बाकी के एलाइनमेंट हो गई है अब ये 12 नंबर हो गया लगन ये हो गया एक नंबर
says: For a chart with sign 12 as lagna, everything else lines up from there: Pisces is the lagna and the next box is sign 1 (Aries), which becomes the second house.
cells_derived_method: Lagna sign number L makes house H hold sign (L+H-1) wrapped at 12; with L=12 house 2 holds sign 1, house 3 sign 2, and so on.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pisces lagna (1-2+1=0, so 12); second house in Aries, Mars rules wealth and speech.
Derived: Pisces lagna (9-10+1=0, so 12); the tenth house holds Sagittarius, a Jupiter-ruled career field.

ambiguity: None; clear counting.
classical_check: Agrees with standard house numbering.

hindi: एक नंबर क्या होता है यह मंगल की राशि है मंगल का होता है लाल
says: Sign number 1 is Aries, a sign of Mars, and Mars is associated with the colour red.
cells_derived_method: Mars in own sign Aries takes the topics of the house it holds: strong in the angles, assertive anywhere else.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Pisces (1-2+1=0, so 12); Mars in own sign in the second gives forceful speech and self-earned wealth.
Derived: lagna Cancer (1-10+1=-8, so 4); Mars own sign in the tenth gives a command-style career, Ruchaka-type strength.
Derived: lagna Libra (1-7+1=-5, so 7); Mars own sign in the seventh makes a forceful partner or sharp business dealings.

ambiguity: Caption cuts off at 'लाल'; the colour red is the only claim visible.

ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; it follows the colour of each planet: white for Moon, yellow for Jupiter, red for Mars.

hindi: यह इतना महीन साइंस है अपने जीवन में प्रयोग करते हुए हमने देखा है कि एक दो रप का धागा पा का कागज लगवा कर के भी जिंदगी में परिवर्तन आ गया
says: From his own experiments he says this is a very fine science: even a two-rupee thread or a piece of coloured paper has changed lives, so tiny remedies can matter.
ambiguity: Caption garbled around 'पा का कागज' (probably some colour of paper).
classical_check: Silent; it is his experience claim.

gist: Reports people saying wonderful, you did wonders, while he insists he did nothing, not even a penny's worth of effort.
Doctor analogy: a doctor says take two tablets morning and evening and you will be fine; he describes lying in bed near death with high fever and being restored by a few days of medicine.

hindi: जब तक असाध्य बीमारी ना हो छोटे-छोटे उपाय टोटके कहते हैं इसे इसी से काम हो जाता है
says: Unless the trouble is incurable, small easy remedies, which people call totke, are enough to get the work done, just as a short medicine course cures an ordinary illness.
ambiguity: The sentence spans two chunks; 'incurable' is used for a grave chart affliction, not literally a disease.
classical_check: Classical texts prescribe heavier remedies such as mantra, puja and gemstones for serious afflictions; he says small ones suffice for ordinary cases.

gist: Says it is a wonder that totke work, tells listeners not to worry, and that the enemy box (the sixth) will be reached later.

hindi: टोटके शत्रु के लिए काम करते हैं शत्रुओं के लिए सबको टोटके चाहिए
says: Totke remedies are mainly used against enemies; everyone wants a totka for the enemy matter, which belongs to the sixth box.
cells_derived_method: The sixth house covers enemies, disputes and debts; the sign in it gives the kind of enemy trouble, so remedy choice depends on the sign's lord.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries (6-6+1=1); Mercury-ruled sixth: enemies come through paperwork, trade or health, remedies lean to green items.
Derived: lagna Gemini (8-6+1=3); Mars-ruled sixth: open fights and sharp competition, red-coloured remedies.

ambiguity: The caption trails off; he mentions the enemy box only briefly.
classical_check: Agrees that the 6th house is for enemies; the claim that totke are for enemies is his remark.

hindi: यह मंगल यहां पर हो गया अब बुध को रख सकते हैं एक नंबर बुध कोई खास बढ़िया नहीं है बुध होता ही कागज है रेजगारी होती है बुध सारी
says: With the Mars sign settled, he turns to Mercury in box 1: Mercury is not particularly good in a Mars sign; Mercury means paper and loose change.
ambiguity: 'रख सकते हैं' means 'take up', not place.
classical_check: Mercury and Mars are mutual enemies by classical friendship tables only partly; Mercury is neutral to enemy of Mars, so a weak result is plausible.

hindi: लेकिन काम चलाओ अब क्या करेंगे क्योंकि परस ही आपका मंगल के कलर का होगा या इसमें तांबा होगा या इसमें सोना होगा आप उसमें रेजगारी भी ठोक दो
says: Mercury can be made to work: since the purse itself is in Mars's colour or holds copper or gold, you can also put small change into it; this is a workable compromise.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts.

hindi: कोई नहीं बाकी ग्रह पावरफुल बैठे हुए हैं अपने आप सेट कर लेंगे
says: Other planets that sit strongly in the chart will set things right by themselves, so the weak Mercury need not worry the person much.
ambiguity: It is unclear which planets he means; it is a general reassurance.
classical_check: Agrees with the view that a strong lagna or dispositor can offset a weak planet; stated loosely.

hindi: मंगल शुक्र के साथ जब जब मिलता है तो आकर्षण बहुत देता है तो उस व्यक्ति को क्या करना चाहिए
says: When Mars joins Venus it gives a great deal of attraction; for a person who wants everyone to look at them, with Venus in Mars's box 1, this combination is the cause.
cells_derived_method: Venus in a Mars sign adds charisma in the house it holds; the house names where people are drawn to the person.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries; Venus in the first house gives a magnetic, striking appearance.
Derived: lagna Libra (1-7+1=-5, so 7); Venus lagna lord in the seventh in Mars's sign brings magnetic attraction in partnerships.
Derived: lagna Cancer (1-10+1=-8, so 4); Venus in the tenth in Mars's sign brings public charm and visibility at work.

ambiguity: He opens with 'if a person wants everyone to see him', which is a parenthesis, not a separate rule.
classical_check: Agrees that Mars-Venus contact gives passion and attraction.

hindi: अपने पर्स के अंदर सुगंधित कुछ रखे ऑटोमेटिक खुशबूदार कुछ अब क्या रखें कोई भी खुशबू थोड़ा सा पफ मारे सेंट परफ्यूम का और अपने पर्स में छोटा सा एक कागज गीला करके रख ले
says: The Venus-in-Mars-box person should keep something fragrant in the purse: spray a little scent on a small piece of paper, dampen it and keep it there.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; perfume is a Venus item.

hindi: पड़ा रहे फूल गुलाब पत्ती वगैरह रखले लाल रंग का फूल हो जाए उसकी पत्ती रख लो जब तक सूखे ना वो शुक्र का ही फल देती रहेगी
says: A flower such as a rose, preferably red, can be kept as petals in the purse; as long as it has not dried it keeps giving Venus's result.
ambiguity: The sentence crosses the chunk boundary.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; flowers are Venus items.

hindi: शनि नेगेटिव हो गया राहु लेड होता है राहु और इसका नहीं आ सकता राहु लेड है सिक्का धातु वेरी वेरी इंपॉर्टेंट
says: Saturn is negative in box 1, and Rahu stands for lead, the metal called sikka; the lead point is very important.
ambiguity: 'इसका नहीं आ सकता' is garbled; it may mean lead cannot be used with this sign. 'सिक्का' is read as lead, not coin.
classical_check: Lead is given to Saturn or Rahu in various lists; Rahu is often assigned lead in modern lists.

hindi: राहु का तो मजा ही कमाल है केतु धुएं का बादल है उसका कोई लेनदेन नहीं
says: Rahu has curious, striking effects, while Ketu is a cloud of smoke with no transactions, so nothing material can be done with Ketu in this scheme.
ambiguity: 'Rahu ka maza kamaal hai' is a vague remark and gives no rule for Rahu.
classical_check: Ketu as smoke is a common image; the no-dealings claim is his own.

gist: Says he is dealing with these items in a small, subtle way.

hindi: इस प्रकार छोटे तौर सूक्ष्म तौर पर बात होही यहां पर व्यक्ति को यह खचर पचर थोड़ी प्लस माइनस करने मात्र से जीवन के अंदर बरकत आएगी तो लोहे की अलमारी ना ले काला परस तो यूज ही ना करे
says: Just by this small adding and removing of odds and ends, prosperity enters life; so in a Mars box 1 the person should not take an iron cupboard and should never use a black purse.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts.

gist: Says swear off the black purse and cupboard, then a stray remark like happy birthday; garbled and joking.
Says box 1 is done, now box 11 and then box 12 will come; he will take one box at a time as far as he can, and the exercise will go on.
Insists this is very important and that even doing this much will bring benefit like a rocket.

hindi: पॉकेट में क्या है 12 नंबर यह किसका स्थान है केतु का है और कौन अच्छा है यहां पर बृहस्पति
says: For sign 12 (Pisces) the pocket holder here is taken as Ketu's place; besides Ketu, Jupiter is the other good planet for this sign.
ambiguity: Whether '12 नंबर' is sign 12 or house 12 is not stated; he began by calling it a sign (12 number in lagna).
classical_check: Pisces is Jupiter's sign classically; Ketu as co-lord is a modern or Gautam attribution.

hindi: सबसे बढ़िया फल कौन देता है शुक्र शुक्र उच्च का होता है य 12 नंबर में शुक्र बेस्ट टेस्ट होता है
says: The best result in sign 12 comes from Venus, because Venus is exalted in Pisces and is at its best there.
cells_derived_method: Exalted Venus lifts the house it sits in: love, comforts and money flow where it sits.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Virgo (12-7+1=6); exalted Venus in the seventh gives a loving, refined spouse and strong partnerships.
Derived: lagna Gemini (12-10+1=3); exalted Venus in the tenth gives career in beauty, arts or hospitality.
Derived: lagna Taurus (12-11+1=2); lagna lord Venus exalted in the eleventh brings gains and a wide social circle.

ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Agrees: Venus is exalted in Pisces.

hindi: शुक्र सारा परफ्यूम है खानपान है
says: Venus stands for perfume and for food and drink.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Perfume is classical; food and drink are standard Venus items in later lists.

hindi: जिसके 12 नंबर य होता है ना उसके पर्स में कार्ड होंगे खाने के रेस्टोरेंट के अपने आप होंगे अगर किसी को हम बता देते हैं यह तो राशि देखते हैं हम एजेक्ट कि आपके परस में खाने पीने के फूड रेस्टोरेंट के कार्ड पड़े हुए हैं
says: A person who has sign 12 will automatically carry restaurant and food cards in the purse; he says he reads this exactly from the sign and astonishes clients by telling them so.
ambiguity: Sign 12 as lagna is assumed because the chain started with 12 in the lagna; not stated outright here.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; an observational claim, not validated.

gist: Describes asking the client to pull the cards out, with an amount like 1100 per question mentioned; garbled but a fee or demo remark.

hindi: वो रसिक व्यक्ति होता है लेकिन शुक्र की पोजिशनिंग पर डिपेंड करता है
says: The person with sign 12 is a pleasure-loving, sensual type, but how strongly depends on where Venus is placed in the chart.
cells_derived_method: Venus's house and sign shift how this shows: Venus in a kendra in own or exalted sign amplifies it, a weak Venus mutes it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Scorpio (2-7+1=-4, so 8); Venus in own sign in the seventh adds a refined, comfort-loving partnership side.
Derived: lagna Libra (6-12+1=-5, so 7); Venus lagna lord debilitated in Virgo in the twelfth makes pleasures costly and spending heavy.

ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Consistent with Venus governing enjoyment.

gist: Says he is talking only about signs now; when planets roam around it becomes a different story, and then the navamsha chart will come.

hindi: इसमें एक इंपॉर्टेंट जो नौवें भाव कृपा से लिंक्ड है ना चार्ट कहते हैं उसे नवांश
says: The navamsha chart is tied to the ninth house and to grace; it is an important companion chart.
ambiguity: The sentence is slightly garbled; the link between navamsha and the ninth house is clear.
classical_check: Agrees: navamsha is linked to dharma and the ninth house, and is the main divisional chart.

hindi: उस कुंडली को साथ देखा जाता है इसके उसकी राशि के साथ इसकी राशि जॉइंट की जाती है और वो किया जाता है जो दोनों में कॉमन हो नहीं तो भाग्य हानि भी होती है
says: The navamsha is read together with the birth chart: the signs of both charts are joined, and you act on what is common to both; otherwise there can be loss of fortune.
cells_derived_method: Compare the sign of each planet or house in D1 with its D9 sign and use the overlap of their natures; if D1 and D9 signs conflict, the promise is reduced.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries lagna in D1; if D9 lagna is also Aries the nature is doubled and clear, but a clash such as a Capricorn D9 lagna lessens the result.
Derived: lagna Aries (7-7+1=1); a D1 seventh-house Libra reading is confirmed only if D9 also supports Venus and partnership themes.

ambiguity: Not stated whether he joins signs of the same planet or of the same house in the two charts.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit with reading the navamsha for confirmation (vargottama and D9 strength).

hindi: अब यहां शुक्र है शुक्र बेस्ट फल देगा बेस्ट फल के लिए शुक्र का क्या करना है हैकी पे परफ्यूम की फिश फिश लगाओ जेब में रखो खत्म
says: With Venus here giving the best result, the remedy is to spray perfume on the clothes or neck and keep the scent in the pocket; that is all.
ambiguity: 'हैकी पे' is garbled; I read it as on the neck or on the person.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; perfume is a Venus item.

gist: Recalls old-style showy habits of dabbing a little attar from a cotton plug with flourish, and says that is just drama.

hindi: यहां क्यों करते हैं यही गले का एरिया है आपके गले में चैन कौन सी पहनी है उस पर डिपेंड करता है यह 12 नंबर है
says: The scent is applied around the neck because that is the throat area, and what chain you wear at the neck matters for sign 12.
ambiguity: It is unclear if the throat link comes from sign 12, Venus, or the second house; he states the neck link only.
classical_check: Venus and the second house relate to throat in classical lists; this fits loosely.

hindi: शुक्र प्लैटिनम की चैन पहन लो यहां पर आप प्लैटिनम की चैन पहन सकते हैं
says: Venus rules platinum, so a person with sign 12 and Venus can wear a platinum chain at the neck.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Classical texts give silver or white metals to Venus; platinum is a modern equivalent.

hindi: बुध स्टील है अगर स्टील की पहनो आपके गले की प्रॉब्लम स्टार्ट हो जाएगी बड़ी अजीब अजीब कहानिया है
says: Mercury is steel here, and a steel chain worn by this person is said to start throat trouble; he calls these odd stories. Throat problem is his claim, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: Why Mercury's steel harms the sign-12 person is not explained.
classical_check: Classical lists give Mercury bronze or brass, not steel; his assignment differs.

hindi: अब शुक्र य हो जाने से सुगंधित द्रव्य रखो और आपका जो गल्ला है उस गल्ले के अंदर परफ्यूम की शीशी पड़ी रहे
says: With Venus in play, keep fragrant substances, and let a vial of perfume lie inside your cash box.
ambiguity: The sentence continues into the next chunk.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts.

gist: Someone says yes Guruji, a 500 note perfumed; garbled audience remark.

hindi: 500 के नोट को क्यों कुर्बान कर रहे हो उसको अलग रख लो और परफ्यूम लहंगी अलग ले लो ना नोट ब्लॉक हो जाएगा ये नहीं कर सकते हम
says: Do not spray perfume on currency notes; keep the notes separate and the perfume separate, since a perfumed note will get blocked and money flow suffers.
ambiguity: 'नोट ब्लॉक हो जाएगा' may be a joke about a girlfriend refusing the note; I read it as a caution.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts.

gist: Jokes that someone would give a perfumed note to a girlfriend, and that every note has to go to a girlfriend.

hindi: परफ्यूम का वो ड्रामा नहीं है कि हम परफ्यूम अकेले पे लेके चलेंगे अगर आप सुंदरता शुक्र बहुत सुंदर व्यवस्थित पर्स रखेंगे तो भी काम होगा
says: Perfume is not the only route; keeping a very beautiful, well-arranged purse also does the work, because beauty and order belong to Venus.
ambiguity: The first half is a complaint about the drama of carrying perfume; the practical point is the beautiful purse.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; beauty and order are Venus qualities.

hindi: शुक्र का कलर वाइटिस होता है ऑफ वाइट कलर है इसका सारा यह कलर ऐसा यूनिवर्सल कलर है मजेदार पूरे घर में इस रंग को कहीं भी कर दो
says: Venus's colour is whitish or off-white, a universal colour that can be used anywhere in the whole house.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Agrees: white or off-white is Venus's colour.

hindi: थोड़ा सा क्रीमिश यह किसका है बृहस्पति पीला रंग होता है इसका पूरे घर में क्रीम कलर हो सकता है वास्तु दोष नहीं लगता
says: A slightly creamy shade belongs to Jupiter, whose colour is yellow; the whole house can be cream and no vastu dosha arises from it.
ambiguity: Cream is assigned to Jupiter and off-white to Venus, with both called safe anywhere.
classical_check: Yellow is Jupiter's classical colour; the no-vastu-dosha claim is his own.

hindi: बृहस्पति महाराज है देवताओं के गुरु और शुक्र दैत्यों के गुरु गुरु गुरु गुरु दते वर्ड पर ना जाए ऑफ वाइट कलर है पूरे घर में कहीं भी रख लो वास्तु दोष नहीं लगता
says: Jupiter is the guru of the gods and Venus the guru of the demons, but do not read anything bad into the word demon; both are gurus, and the off-white colour can go anywhere in the house with no vastu dosha.
ambiguity: 'दते' is a caption slip for daitya.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is guru of the devas and Venus of the asuras.

hindi: यह देवता लोग हैं सबसे टॉप टॉप है इनको दोष लगा के किसी असुर की किसी देवता की हिम्मत नहीं है
says: These two gurus are the top-ranking beings, so no demon or god dares to put a fault on them; their colours stay free of vastu fault.
ambiguity: The chunk ends with an unfinished remark about Indra and others being parrots.
classical_check: Silent in classical Jyotish; rhetorical backing for his vastu claim.

hindi: यहां शुक्र हो गया अब यहां पर शुक्र के बाद शनि आ गया शनि इसका मित्र होता है यह व्यक्ति लोहे की अलमारी रख सकता है शनि मित्र है य लोहे की अलमारी रखी जा सकती है
says: With sign 12 in the box and Venus done, he takes Saturn next: Saturn is a friend of this sign's planet, so this person can keep an iron cupboard without harm.
cells_derived_method: Saturn in Pisces behaves as a neutral-to-friendly guest; the house names the area it governs, with delay and discipline in that area.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Scorpio (12-5+1=8); Saturn lord of the 3rd and 4th in the fifth gives steady but slow progress with children and study.
Derived: lagna Gemini (12-10+1=3); Saturn lord of the 8th and 9th in the tenth makes career slow, disciplined and tied to long hours.

ambiguity: 'इसका मित्र' refers to the planet Venus who owns the box in his scheme; Saturn is a friend of Venus classically.
classical_check: Agrees that Venus and Saturn are friends; the iron-cupboard permission is his own application.

hindi: प्लास्टिक की अलमारी रखी जा सकती है हालांकि प्लास्टिक तो बहुत अनसेफ है लेकिन प्लास्टिक के छोटे-छोटे कैबिनेट लोग बना लेते हैं वो रखे जा सकते हैं प्लास्टिक के
says: Plastic cupboards are also acceptable for this person; plastic is not very safe in general, but small plastic cabinets that people make can be used.
ambiguity: He does not say which planet owns plastic here; the context suggests Saturn or the outer planets.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; plastic did not exist then.

hindi: जैसे आपके पास लकड़ी का गल्ला है लकड़ी के गल्ले में लोहे का छोटा सा एक कुछ भी बना लो ट्रे और उस ट्रे में पैसे रखो बाद में ढक्कन लगाया बंद आपका काम हो गया
says: If you have a wooden cash box, make a small iron tray inside it, keep the money on the tray and close the lid; the wealth will stay safe and grow nicely.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts.

hindi: फिर राहु हो गया राहु होता है लेड 12 नंबर में इसका कोई खास लंबा चौड़ा रोल प्ले नहीं है क्योंकि शुक्र अपने आप में बहुत पावरफुल काम करता है
says: Rahu is lead; in sign 12 Rahu plays no big role because Venus alone works very powerfully there, so lead need not be a worry.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Venus is exalted in Pisces, so Rahu's role is minor in this reading; lead as Rahu's metal follows modern lists.

hindi: 12 नंबर के अंदर लेड सिक्का धातु रख सकते रखें उससे कोई नुकसान नहीं वह उपाय के तौर पर इमरजेंसी नहीं है केतु है यह वैसे ठंडे बस्ते में
says: In sign 12 you may keep lead if you like, no harm comes, but it is not an emergency remedy; then Ketu is simply put into cold storage, meaning set aside.
ambiguity: The opening phrase 'हैं इनके आगे कोई लेनदेन नहीं' is the tail of the earlier Ketu remark; the Ketu line runs into the next chunk.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts.
