ambiguity: He calls wood an enemy because wood is the Sun's and the Sun is Saturn's enemy.
classical_check: Agrees that Sun and Saturn are enemies; the plastic choice is his compromise.

hindi: शनि भेदभाव कर रहा है शनि बैठा है यहां और प्लूटो बैठा पैरों में और दोनों भाई साथ हैं जब उकड़ बैठता है व्यक्ति पटी स्टाइल में बैठते ना तो पैर पंजे हि के पास आ जाते हैं
says: Saturn is said to sit at the knee and Pluto at the feet, and they are brothers who come close when a person squats in a Hindu style, since the feet then reach the knees.
ambiguity: The first words 'शनि भेदभाव कर रहा है' are unclear; the body-part mapping is not fully stated.
classical_check: Saturn rules knees classically; Pluto and the feet are Gautam's mapping.

hindi: यह दोनों साथ ही है लेकिन वो डिस्टेंस बहुत है आप कॉस्मस में देखेंगे तो शनि के बाद जितने प्लेनेट हैं उसे पुल करने वाले ही है इंद्र वरुण यम और प्लूटो
says: Saturn and Pluto belong together though far apart in space; in the cosmos the planets beyond Saturn, Indra, Varuna and Yama (Uranus, Neptune, Pluto), act as pullers of Saturn.
ambiguity: Lists Indra, Varuna, Yama and then Pluto again, which repeats Yama and Pluto as the same planet.
classical_check: Classical Jyotish does not use the outer planets; this is Gautam's extension.

gist: Last line says all of Indra, Varuna, Yama, Pluto are the same matter; the caption is garbled and the point is unclear.

hindi: इंद्र वरुण यम तीनों के तीनों वही साथ-साथ चलते हैं इसी के चक्र में सारे यही है काम क्रोध लोभ मोह अहंकार ईर्षा षड विकार सारे यही है
says: The three outer planets Indra, Varuna and Yama (Uranus, Neptune, Pluto) move together as one group, and within their cycle lie all the six vices: lust, anger, greed, attachment, ego and envy.
ambiguity: He lists kama, krodha, lobha, moha, ahankar and irshya as the six vikaras; the classical list has madha instead of irshya.
classical_check: Classical Jyotish has no outer planets; the shad-vikara list is from Vedanta, so linking it to these three is his extension.

hindi: इसलिए प्लूटो का कार्यक्रम थोड़ा डिफरेंट होगा लेकिन प्लूटो इतना बौना प्लेनेट है सूर्य है जीवन प्लूटो है डेथ जब तक जीवन है सूर्य है प्लूटो कुछ नहीं कर सकता
says: Pluto's programme will be a little different from the other two, because Pluto is a dwarf planet: the Sun is life and Pluto is death, and as long as life lasts the Sun rules and Pluto can do nothing.
ambiguity: This is a statement about symbolism, not a claim about death timing; it makes no prediction of death.
classical_check: Classical texts give death and Yama to Saturn and the 8th house; Pluto as death is a modern assignment.

hindi: प्लूटो बहुत दूर है सूर्य के आकर्षण के घेरे में उसको खींच के सूर्य ही ले जा रहा है उसकी औकात ही नहीं है कुछ भी
says: Pluto is very far away and inside the Sun's gravitational circle, with the Sun itself dragging it along, so Pluto has no standing or power of its own against the Sun.
ambiguity: An astronomical argument used to back the symbolic claim that Pluto is weaker than the Sun.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; uses modern astronomy as support.

gist: Says that with God's grace even death can do nothing, and that people who stay a disciple look young and keep their organs in order through anti-ageing.
Says learning begins when you become a disciple, one must be a student to become a guru, and saying I know everything blocks the inner guru.
Says a person who claims to know it all gets blocked and will not find out what follows.

hindi: जिस प्रकार एक पिता ने ये कमांड दे दी कोई बात नहीं हमारा बेटा बड़ा आदमी ना बने वो बड़ा आदमी नहीं बनेगा बाप के जिंदा रहते हैं
says: A father who casually speaks a command like 'it does not matter if my son does not become a big man' can block the son: while the father is alive, the son will not become a big man.
ambiguity: He says 'command' to mean a careless spoken wish that works like a binding order.
classical_check: Silent in classical Jyotish; it is a speech-power belief from his own experience.

hindi: इसलिए बाप को छोड़ के जब तक अमेरिका नहीं जाएगा वो कंगला ही रहेगा क्योंकि पिता ने ही अनजाने में ऐसा काम कर दिया है बोल के
says: Such a son stays poor until he leaves the father and goes away, for instance to America, because the father unknowingly caused the block by what he said. This records his claim only, not advice to emigrate.
ambiguity: America is an example of going far away, not a requirement.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts.

hindi: ऐसे ही अनजाने में हम गलत काम कर देते हैं हमारे ग्रहों की राशियों का हिसाब किताब का भट्टा बैठ जाता है
says: In the same way we unknowingly do wrong things and the accounts of our planets and signs get ruined; careless words and acts can undo what the chart promises.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Agrees with the view that karma in this life can change what the chart gives.

hindi: ये हमारे धन स्थान का प्लास्टिक रख सकता है अब यहां पर वो क्या कर सकता है मिट्टी का बर्तन लेगा मंगल एक्टिवेट करेंगे
says: For this chart (sign 11 box) plastic can be kept in the wealth place, and the further step is an earthen pot, which activates Mars.
ambiguity: The start of the sentence is garbled; I read it as plastic being allowed in the wealth place, and the box is still sign 11 from the previous chunk.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; clay as Mars's material is his assignment.

hindi: मिट्टी की गुल्लक लाल रंग की लॉकर उसके लॉकर में मिट्टी की गुल्लक छोटे बच्चों की मिट्टी की गुल्लक होती है अक्सर रखते हैं वो ऐसे मिट्टी की गुल्लक उसके अंदर रखे उसमें अंधा पैसा उठेगा उसका
says: Place a red earthen piggy bank, like the ones children use, inside the locker; with it, the person's money will rise strongly, blind profit as he puts it.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts.

hindi: और कुछ नहीं है तो आपका लॉकर जैसा मर्जी है लोहा लक्कड़ बना हुआ उसके अंदर आपने तांबे की प्लेट रख देनी है और उस तांबे की प्लेट के ऊपर अपना बॉक्स उसके अंदर आपने पैसे रखने हैं
says: If no piggy bank is available, the locker may be of any material, iron or wood, but place a copper plate inside and put your box with the money on top of that plate.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; copper is Mars's metal per his earlier statement.

hindi: लॉकर सपाट रखना है तांबे की प्लेट डाल दो कुछ समझ नहीं आ रहा लाल रंग का कपड़ा डाल दो काम ही खत्म
says: Keep the locker floor flat and lay the copper plate in it; if that is unclear, simply spread a red cloth, and the job is finished.
ambiguity: The red cloth is offered as the simplest fallback.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; red is Mars's colour.

hindi: अब आप कहेंगे जॉइंट लॉकर है तो क्या करें वो बहुत डिफरेंट कहानी हो जाएगी फिर दोनों की कुंडली देखनी पड़ेगी ये सिंगल लॉकर की बात हो रही है
says: For a joint locker the answer is different: both owners' charts must be examined, and what he describes here applies only to a single person's locker.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Agrees with the general idea that shared matters need both charts.

hindi: दुकान का गल्ला मकान का अपना घर का रखा हुआ दराज उस प्रकार की चीज लॉकर किसे मानेंगे हम घर जाते आप एक दराज खोलते हैं उस दराज में आप पर्स फेंकते हैं और चाबी डालते हैं वो आपका लॉकर का ट्रीट हो रहा है
says: A locker means any money-holding place: the shop's cash box, a drawer at home where you throw your purse and keys; whichever one you routinely use counts as your locker and becomes a second home for your money.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; it is his working definition.

gist: Banter about having multiple lockers because money is plentiful, telling the audience to adopt them quickly.

hindi: मल्टीपल का हम कुछ नहीं कर सकते सब जगह रूल लेकिन अप्लाई यही होगा यहां आपका मिट्टी का हिसाब बनेगा तो बेटर है
says: With several lockers he cannot do anything separately; the rule applies everywhere in the same way, and an earthen-pot setup in the locker is the better arrangement.
ambiguity: He says the rule applies everywhere but is applied to the main locker.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts.

hindi: तो यहां पर नेगेटिव राशि का असर नहीं मारेगा ये अगर लोहा रख लिया तो नुकसान करेगा
says: With the clay arrangement, the harmful effect of the negative sign will not strike; but if you keep iron there instead, it will do harm.
ambiguity: The sign meant is still the negative sign under discussion, Aquarius, not named in this sentence.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts.

hindi: अगर आपने लोहा रख ही लिया है तो यह बहुत कॉम्प्लिकेट होगा आपको देखना है घर के किस जोन के अंदर वो अलमारी रखी है लोहे की
says: If you have already kept an iron cupboard, the fix gets complicated, because you must check which zone of the house the iron cupboard stands in.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Vastu zoning is outside classical Jyotish.

hindi: वो लोहे की अलमारी जो है वो आपकी सारी की सारी आकाश की जोन में आती है जो वेस्टर्न जोनस आते हैं उसमें आपको यह देखना है यदि वो वेस्ट साउथ वेस्ट साइड आ रहा है
says: Among the zones, you particularly check the western zones: whether the iron cupboard falls in the west or south-west of the house, as these are where iron matters.
ambiguity: The phrase about the cupboard coming 'in the akash zone' is garbled, and its meaning is unclear.
classical_check: West is Saturn's direction, so checking the west zone for an iron item is consistent.

hindi: वेस्ट में आ रहा है तो नीचे आप उसके इसको ठीक करने के लिए आप तांबा नहीं रख सकते आप लाल पत्थर नहीं रख सकते क्योंकि उस जोन में नेगेटिव हो जाएगा
says: If the iron cupboard sits in the west zone, you cannot use copper or red stone beneath it as a correction, because those become negative in that zone.
ambiguity: The sentence continues from the previous chunk's west and south-west check.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; Mars things in Saturn's west zone clash by planetary enmity logic.

hindi: यह कॉम्प्लिकेटेड है काफी इस प्रकार से आप वहां पर सिर्फ लॉकर के अंदर अपना साजो सामान रख के देख लें कुछ नहीं तो मिट्टी रख लें और लाजवाब हो
says: This is quite complicated, so just place your belongings in the locker and see; if nothing else works, put some clay in it and the result will be excellent.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts.

hindi: अगर य हनुमान जी स्थापित हो जाए यानी इस लॉकर के अंदर आप यदि हनुमान को मानते हैं तो दो बंदर ले ले मिट्टी के और उनको वहां रख दे पड़े कुछ नहीं कर रहे वो हनुमान होंगे
says: If you believe in Hanuman, install him in the locker in a simple way: take two clay monkeys and leave them there doing nothing; they will stand for Hanuman.
ambiguity: The preamble about sacredness and not keeping God in a locker is garbled.
classical_check: Hanuman is linked to Mars and Saturn remedies in tradition; the clay monkeys are his own device.

hindi: आपके मन में आ सकता है यार पूजा करनी है अच्छी बात नहीं है और वो गलत भी नहीं है अगर आपके मन में इष्ट है भावना है तो भाई मत रखो
says: You may feel you must worship it, which is good and not wrong if you have devotion and an ishta; but if you do not feel that, do not keep the figures there.
ambiguity: The sentence is partly garbled; it reads as his permission to follow personal devotion.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts.

hindi: तो आपने वो दो बंदर मिट्टी के रख देने लाल रंग के होते हैं लाली लाली होती है मिट्टी में वो वाली लाली नीले पीले रंग की मिट्टी ना हो हनुमान का कलर देख के चलेंगे पेंट भी कर सकते हैं आप लाल रंग ले ले
says: The clay monkeys should be red, with the reddish earth colour and not blue or yellow clay; follow Hanuman's colour, and you may paint them red yourself.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; red is Mars's and Hanuman's colour.

hindi: यहां हो गया आठ नंबर तो यहां आ गया न नंबर यह आ गया जुपिटर का बृहस्पति और यहां केतु सबसे बढ़िया फल देता है बृहस्पति का घर है और केतु सब सर्वोत्तम फल देता है
says: After number 8 he moves to the next sign, apparently number 9, Jupiter's sign Sagittarius, where Ketu gives its best results since it is Jupiter's house.
cells_derived_method: Ketu in Sagittarius adds detachment, depth and spirituality to the house it holds.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries (9-9+1=1); Ketu in the ninth makes the person spiritual, indifferent to rules and prone to sudden insight.
Derived: lagna Leo (9-5+1=5); Ketu in the fifth gives deep intuition and an unusual relation to children and learning.
Derived: lagna Capricorn (9-12+1=-2, so 10); Ketu in the twelfth supports retreat, secrecy and liberation themes.

ambiguity: The caption says 'न नंबर', probably 'nau number' (9); the sign may instead be 12 (Pisces) if he is returning to Jupiter's and Ketu's sign.
classical_check: Ketu is exalted in Sagittarius in some traditions, so strong results fit; he calls it best because it is Jupiter's house.

hindi: तो यहां पर आपने क्या करना है कोई भी चीज रखनी है छुपा के रखनी है सीक्रेट का देवता है केतु सीक्रेट आपको जो भी पैसा रखा जैसा भी कुछ रखा उसके ऊपर कुछ और रख दो हमेशा ढक के रखो
says: Ketu is the god of secrecy, so whatever money or item you keep here should be hidden and always covered by placing something else on top.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Ketu as secrecy and the hidden is a standard signification.

hindi: थोड़ा सा पैसा ऐसा रखो जिसके ऊपर कुछ रखा है क्या रखा है अरे गत्ता रख लो गत्ता ही रख लो इसी से ही काम हो जाएगा आपका सिर्फ रखने के लिए गत्ता है वो और कुछ नहीं है क्योंकि केतु की राशि एक्टिवेट होती है
says: Keep some money with a simple piece of cardboard on top of it; the cardboard is just a cover, yet it activates Ketu's sign and gets the work done.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts.

hindi: बृहस्पति है सोना जरूर रखो लॉकर के अंदर गोल्ड और यहां लकड़ी भी रख सकते हो लकड़ी की अलमारी लोहे की अलमारी सारी प्लास्टिक की सारी ओके जुपिटर देवता है बृहस्पति यह बाप है सबका
says: Jupiter is gold, so keep gold in the locker; wood is also allowed, and wooden, iron or plastic cupboards are all fine because Jupiter is the father of all the planets.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter in its own sign Sagittarius is strongest in the angles, giving Hamsa yoga there and protection elsewhere.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Virgo (9-4+1=6); Jupiter lord of the 4th and 7th in own sign in the fourth gives home, property and comfort (Hamsa yoga).
Derived: lagna Gemini (9-7+1=3); Jupiter lord of the 7th and 10th in own sign in the seventh gives a wise partner and good partnerships (Hamsa yoga).
Derived: lagna Pisces (9-10+1=0, so 12); Jupiter lagna lord in own sign in the tenth gives a respected career (Hamsa yoga).

ambiguity: Whether wood is fine here despite Sun-Jupiter links is not discussed; he says all cupboard materials are fine.
classical_check: Agrees that Jupiter is the preceptor of the gods; Sagittarius is Jupiter's own sign.

hindi: यहां पर आप कोई सी भी अलमारी रख सकते हो आपको धले की भी प्रॉब्लम नहीं आने वाली है इसके अंदर आपको यहां नेगेटिव क्या करेगा राहु राहु जुपिटर की तैसी फेरता है
says: In this sign you can keep any cupboard without the slightest problem; the only negative here is Rahu, since Rahu spoils Jupiter's results.
cells_derived_method: Rahu in or aspecting Jupiter's sign dilutes Jupiter's wisdom in the house it touches (guru chandal type effect).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Virgo (9-4+1=6); Rahu in the fourth in Jupiter's sign unsettles home peace and mother's guidance.
Derived: lagna Pisces (9-10+1=0, so 12); Rahu in the tenth makes career unconventional or tainted with ambition.

ambiguity: The sentence trails into the next chunk, where he explains Rahu's lead and battery link.
classical_check: Agrees that Rahu afflicts Jupiter (guru chandal yoga).

hindi: तो यहां किसी भी हालत के अंदर आपके राहु ना हो राहु सिक्का धातु है सिक्का होता है जो बैटरी में डलता है आपकी बैटरी पता लगा ब्लड प्रेशर की मशीन है उसकी बैटरी आप खरीद के लाए और वो भी आपने वही रख रखी है
says: Under no condition should Rahu items be there; Rahu is lead, the metal that goes into batteries, so a spare battery, for example one bought for a blood pressure machine, must not be kept in the locker.
ambiguity: 'सिक्का' is lead, not coin; he links lead to batteries.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; Rahu as lead and batteries is a modern assignment.

hindi: आपका कैश नहीं बढ़ेगा सिर्फ बैटरी रखने से पैसा आएगा जाएगा भाग्य का लेकिन जेब में नहीं आएगा लॉकर में रखा है लॉकर में नहीं आएगा
says: Merely keeping a battery there will stop your cash from growing: fortune may bring money, but it will not land in your pocket or locker.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; an experience-based claim.

hindi: वहां राहु बैटरी नहीं रखनी इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स सारे आ गए जितने भी आपके इलेक्ट्रॉनिक के सारे मोबाइल नहीं उसमें मल्टीपल है मोबाइल चंद्रमा भी होता है उसकी स्क्रीन होती है
says: No Rahu item such as a battery should be kept there, and all electronics belong to Rahu; a mobile phone is mixed, because its screen is also the Moon's.
ambiguity: He says 'mobile नहीं उसमें मल्टीपल है', meaning it is not purely Rahu but has multiple planets.
classical_check: Electronics as Rahu is a modern assignment, not classical.

hindi: लेकिन राहु है इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स में राहु आ जाएगा जितनी भी इंफॉर्मेशन की चीजें हैं यह सारी की सारी राहु महाराज के पास है जितनी सीक्रेट एजेंसी राहु चलाता है सारा ईडी
says: Rahu runs electronics, all information-related things and the secret agencies, such as the ED (Enforcement Directorate), all of which fall under Rahu.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Rahu is linked with intrigue and foreign or secret matters in tradition; electronics and ED are his modern extension.

gist: An exclamation, oh my God, and a remark that he will explain it well later.

hindi: अच्छे से बैटरी वाली मत रखो वो नहीं लॉकर में नहीं रखनी नहीं वो अगर आपका यह दोष है तो नहीं
says: Do not keep any battery-powered item in the locker if you have this Rahu fault; the rule is to avoid it completely.
ambiguity: The sentence ends at the chunk end; the conditional about 'this fault' is the Rahu affliction.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts.

gist: Banter about asking the audience for a spare locker and money, saying he feels no shame in asking.
He says as a Brahmin he has begged from God, mother and father since childhood and is now asking the audience for grace.
Joke that Brahmins digest everything, coins and metals included, and are the original ED (a pun he sets up for the next point).

hindi: अब जो ईडी की प्रॉब्लम है वो ईडी की सारी की सारी की प्रॉब्लम आपकी गवर्नमेंट के जितने पंगे हैं यह सारे राहु के पास है
says: Trouble with the Enforcement Directorate (ED) and in general every kind of fight or entanglement with the government is Rahu's department; Rahu is the karaka of government-agency trouble.
cells_derived_method: Rahu's government-trouble significance is stronger when Rahu sits in houses of authority and law (6th, 10th, 12th) or conjoins Sun (government karaka); weaker in 3rd or 11th where Rahu usually gives gains. Sign nature of the placement (fixed or earthy signs) makes the pressure slow and bureaucratic.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Rahu in the 10th in Capricorn would tie career to government rules and audits; scrutiny shows up through work.
Derived, not said by him: Rahu in the 6th in Gemini gives disputes, notices and paperwork conflicts that can be fought off with effort.
Derived, not said by him: Rahu in the 12th in Aquarius points to hidden dealings, foreign links and losses through legal or tax exposure.

ambiguity: ED is the Indian Enforcement Directorate here; he uses it as an example of any state-agency pressure.
classical_check: Classical texts give Rahu foreign and unconventional matters and Sun the government; modern attribution of agency raids to Rahu is a later extension, so classical text is silent on ED.

hindi: अब अगर राहु आपका प्रसन्न नहीं है और राहु आपने ठीक नहीं सेट किया हुआ
says: Sets the condition for the next claim: if your Rahu is unhappy (afflicted) and has not been set right in the chart, in the home or by remedy, the problems follow.
ambiguity: The sentence is cut across the caption chunk and completes in the next one. Whether 'set' means astrologically or in the house is unclear until the next sentence.
classical_check: Classical texts speak of Rahu as papa graha being afflicted by placement; the phrase 'Rahu not set' is his own idiom.

hindi: आपके ऊपर ईडी का हमला होगा और इसके लिए आपको घर का नॉर्थ वेस्ट सेट करने की जरूरत है और पितरों की कृपा चाहिए
says: An unsettled Rahu brings an ED-style raid on you; the remedy he gives is to correct the north-west of the house (Rahu's vastu zone) and to seek the grace of ancestors (pitru).
cells_derived_method: none: the remedy is vastu and ancestor based, not house or sign dependent as stated.
ambiguity: He links Rahu to north-west of the house, which is not the usual vastu lord of that corner (Vayu or Moon in most texts); this is his own mapping.
classical_check: Classical Jyotish silent on north-west for Rahu; pitru dosha is classically tied to Sun, 9th house and Rahu, so the ancestor link partly agrees.

hindi: अब ऐसी स्थिति में आपके ऊपर फालतू के केस बन जाते हैं सारे कोर्ट कचहरी के केस
says: With an afflicted Rahu, baseless cases and court and legal litigation get created against a person; Rahu is linked to false or senseless legal cases.
cells_derived_method: Legal cases are the 6th house (disputes) and 7th (opponents), with 8th and 12th for hidden or prolonged matters; Rahu influencing these houses raises false-case risk. Sign nature decides the form, for example air signs bring paper and notice cases, water signs bring family or emotional disputes.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Rahu in the 6th in Virgo gives nitpicking technical cases over documents and accounts.
Derived, not said by him: Rahu in the 7th in Aries invites aggressive opponents or partner-linked disputes.
Derived, not said by him: Rahu in the 12th in Pisces gives cases that drag, with hidden enemies and expenses.

ambiguity: He says no house number; house 6 is recorded as the standard litigation house, not stated by him.
classical_check: Classical texts agree that 6th house and its afflictions give litigation; Rahu as source of false cases is common in later practice.

hindi: राहु सारे टाइम राहु का लफड़ा है आपको और आप राहु के कारण परेशान हो ... यही खोपड़ी यह राहु के दोष है जब भी आपकी खोपड़ी खचर खचर खचर खा रखी है
says: Rahu's signature is constant mental churning and anxious looping (what will happen to my case, where will money come from); the gnawing worry in the head is itself the Rahu dosha, not only external events.
cells_derived_method: Rahu in the 1st, 4th (peace of mind) or with Moon strengthens the mental-worry reading; in the 3rd or 11th the same restless drive turns into effort and gain rather than anxiety.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Rahu in the 4th in Cancer disturbs the mind and home peace, with worry looping at night.
Derived, not said by him: Rahu in the 1st in Gemini gives a restless overthinking nature that talks and plans without settling.
Derived, not said by him: Rahu in the 11th in Aquarius turns the obsessive drive towards networks and gains, so worry is milder.

ambiguity: He mimics the worried client, so the exact claim is the mental symptom as Rahu's mark; not a medical statement.
classical_check: Classical texts give Rahu delusion, fear and confusion (bhrama); agrees in spirit.

hindi: ईडी से ही इंग्लिश वर्ड बनता है इरेक्टाइल डिस्फंक्शन पुरुषों को ये प्रॉब्लम होती है मिडिल एज क्राइसिस के टाइम पर
says: Wordplay: the same letters ED stand for erectile dysfunction, which he says men face during midlife crisis when sexual upset sets in; he treats the ED pun as a parallel Rahu theme. Only recording his claim, no medical diagnosis implied.
ambiguity: It is a pun, not a derivation; the astrological content is only in the next sentence.
classical_check: Classical texts silent; the pun has no textual basis.

hindi: यह भी राहु का दोष है जब शुक्र पर आता है तो आपके कुंडली के अंदर आपको सेक्सुअल अपसेट
says: Sexual dysfunction is also Rahu's fault: when Rahu falls on or afflicts Venus in the horoscope, sexual upset results. Recorded as his tradition claim, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: Rahu-Venus conjunction or aspect matters more when it falls in 2nd, 5th, 7th or 8th, which carry desire, partner and intimacy. Sign changes the nature: Venus in own Taurus or Libra resists, Venus debilitated in Virgo is weakened more by Rahu.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Rahu with Venus in the 7th in Libra (Venus own sign) gives strong desire but troubled or unconventional partnership.
Derived, not said by him: Rahu with Venus in the 8th in Taurus points to secret or intense intimate matters and instability.
Derived, not said by him: Rahu with Venus in the 5th in Virgo (Venus debilitated) strains romance and creativity.

ambiguity: Conjunction versus aspect on Venus is not said; 'आता है' only says Rahu comes on Venus.
classical_check: Classical texts treat Rahu or Ketu on Venus as a spoiler of marital and sensual happiness; agrees broadly.

hindi: सारी की सारी जो खोपड़ी में टेंशन दौड़ रही है यह सब राहु महाराज की वजह से
says: All the tension racing through the head, whether about sex, money or cases, he attributes entirely to Rahu; Rahu is the single cause of mental tension in this teaching.
ambiguity: 'Entirely Rahu' is an overstatement in spoken style; Moon and Mercury are the classical mind significators.
classical_check: Classical texts give mental tension to Moon and Mercury afflicted; his Rahu-only claim differs.

hindi: तो आपके जुपिटर का एरिया नॉर्थ ईस्ट का एरिया आपके घर के बड़े आदर करने
says: Jupiter's zone in the house is the north-east, and it stands for the elders of the home and the feeling of respect (adar) towards them.
cells_derived_method: none: a vastu zone and karaka link, not house or sign dependent as stated.
ambiguity: The sentence is cut at the chunk boundary; the object continues as 'feeling of respect' in the next chunk.
classical_check: Classical Vastu gives north-east (Ishanya) to Jupiter, agrees; Jupiter as karaka of elders and gurus agrees.

hindi: की फीलिंग यह बृहस्पति है गुरु गुरु कोई भी गुरु यानी जो आपको कुछ बता रहा है उसके प्रति नेगेटिव फीलिंग यह राहु एक्टिवेट कर देती है
says: Respect for any teacher (anyone telling you something useful) is Jupiter; Rahu activates the opposite, a negative feeling or disrespect towards the guru.
cells_derived_method: Rahu-Jupiter conjunction or aspect shows this most; location tunes the area: 9th (guru, dharma), 5th (learning), 2nd (family elders), 4th (home teachers). Signs of Jupiter strength (Sagittarius, Pisces, Cancer) reduce the effect.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Jupiter with Rahu in the 9th in Gemini gives doubting, argumentative attitude to teachers and religion.
Derived, not said by him: Jupiter with Rahu in the 5th in Aries gives self-taught rebellion against formal teachers.
Derived, not said by him: Jupiter in own Pisces in the 4th with Rahu keeps respect but confuses home teachings.

ambiguity: Jupiter-Rahu is guru-chandal yoga in classical terms; he does not name it here.
classical_check: Classical texts agree: Guru Chandal yoga gives disrespect to teachers and unorthodox views.

hindi: गाली बकरे हो से यार डॉक्टर साला कमीना है लूट लिया इसने ठीक तो कर दिया भाई नो प्रॉब्लम पर लूट लिया ... गुरुजी गुरुजी गुरु घंटाल
says: Example of Rahu on Jupiter: after a doctor or teacher has cured or helped you, you still abuse them for taking fees; resenting your helper once the need is over is the behavioural mark.
ambiguity: Illustrative mimicry, not a separate rule.
classical_check: Classical texts silent on this behavioural example.

hindi: थी ग्रह की गुरुद्वारे में सबसे बढ़िया वो गुरुद्वारे में फेंकते हैं किसको ब्लेम करे किसी को नहीं किसी ने नहीं लिए गुप्त दान हो गया जिगरा है तो गुरुद्वारे में फेंक के आओ पैसे
says: Remedy for this resentment: throw the money into the gurudwara collection box so that nobody can be blamed and nobody receives it; this is a secret donation (gupt daan), do it if you have the courage.
ambiguity: First words are garbled ('थी ग्रह की') and likely 'the grace of the planet'; the instruction is clear from the rest.
classical_check: Classical texts praise anonymous charity (gupta daan); a gurudwara is a modern context, not classical.

gist: A woman in Australia told him she was now on the right path and had seen truth; he said ask a question instead of wasting his time.
He says he does not want darshan-seeking people, only people with a direct question so the work is done and finished.
Continuing the story, she said she had saved money and wanted to donate to a worthy recipient.
He says if she had not used the word worthy recipient (supatra) he would have named himself, so he had to think about who.

hindi: मैंने कहा सुपात्र बताओ होता कौन है ... वो भी आपकी खोपड़ी डिसाइड करेगी कि जायज कर रहा है ... आप होते कौन हो बीच में इंटरफेयर करने वाले
says: Who is a worthy recipient is decided only by the giver's own mind; once given, you have no right to interfere in how the recipient uses it, even for drink or gambling. Worthiness-checking is just ego.
ambiguity: Ethical opinion on charity, close to a dana rule but not tied to a planet.
classical_check: Classical dharma texts advise giving to a worthy recipient (supatra); his view differs from or sharply challenges that.

hindi: मैंने कहा गुल्लक में पैसे फेंक आओ देकर मत आना फेंक के ना दिए तो दान की महिमा बन जाएगी और आप में पहले पहले घमंड है कि मैं तो सुपात्र को दूंगी
says: Advice to the donor: throw money in the box, do not hand it over personally; handing over builds the glory of charity and pride (I gave to a worthy person) and then you tell four people or post on Facebook.
ambiguity: No planet named; it follows the Jupiter and Rahu ego theme.
classical_check: Classical texts value dana without ego; agrees in spirit with gupta daan.

gist: That very day her third eye opened and she saw how low her talk had been.
She realised she had turned into a salvation seeker, and all her knowledge was left useless.

hindi: यह राहु का दोष है कि आपका बृहस्पति मैं बहुत ज्ञानी हूं मैं बहुत ज्ञानी हूं मैं बहुत ज्ञानी हूं इसमें लगे हुए हैं और खोपड़ा खराब
says: It is Rahu's fault that Jupiter, the knowledge planet, turns into pride (I am very knowledgeable); Rahu on Jupiter converts wisdom into ego and makes the head disturbed.
cells_derived_method: Pride effect is stronger when Jupiter is in 1st, 5th or 9th (self, learning, guru roles) with Rahu; Jupiter in Cancer (exalted) holds more dignity, Jupiter in Capricorn (debilitated) with Rahu turns knowledge into rigid show.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Jupiter with Rahu in the 1st in Sagittarius gives a big self-image as a teacher and a preaching tone.
Derived, not said by him: Jupiter exalted in the 5th in Cancer with Rahu gives real learning with pride in intellect.
Derived, not said by him: Jupiter debilitated in the 9th in Capricorn with Rahu gives dogmatic or hollow claims of wisdom.

ambiguity: Conjunction is implied but not stated.
classical_check: Agrees with Guru Chandal yoga results of arrogance in knowledge.

hindi: यह आपकी सेक्स लाइफ खराब करता है करेगा ही करेगा इनएविटेबली चाहे कुछ भी हो जाए होनी ही है क्योंकि ति के पास ही आपका सेक्स चक्र है
says: This Rahu-on-Jupiter affliction will inevitably spoil sex life, because the sex chakra (svadhisthana) belongs to Jupiter's area; the word before 'ti' is garbled and probably Brihaspati. Recorded as his claim, not a prediction rule for individuals.
cells_derived_method: Chakra mapping implies the effect carries wherever Jupiter sits; the sign decides how it shows, e.g. watery signs bring emotional trouble in intimacy, fiery signs bring impulsiveness.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Jupiter with Rahu in the 7th in Scorpio would intensify intimacy troubles in marriage.
Derived, not said by him: Jupiter with Rahu in the 2nd in Pisces would show it through family and speech rather than intimacy.

ambiguity: Garbled caption 'ति के पास' may be Jupiter (Brihaspati) or progeny (santati) since it flows into 'new progeny'; marked low confidence.
classical_check: Classical Jyotish assigns Jupiter to progeny (putra karaka) and Venus to sex; Jupiter-to-sex-chakra is not classical.

hindi: इसी के पास प्रजनन की क्षमता है यही हमें नई संतति देता है यही हमें आशीर्वाद के तौर पर जीवन में कृपा दिलाता है
says: This chakra and its planet hold the reproductive capacity; it gives new offspring and brings grace into life as blessing. Jupiter is again the implied karaka of children and blessing.
cells_derived_method: Child and blessing results are read from the 5th house, its lord and Jupiter; Jupiter in own or exalted signs in 5th favour children, in Capricorn or Gemini they are delayed or strained.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Jupiter in the 5th in own Sagittarius is a strong sign for children and blessing.
Derived, not said by him: Jupiter debilitated in the 5th in Capricorn would delay or burden progeny.

ambiguity: The subject 'this' is not named in the caption; 5th house recorded as classical child house, not said.
classical_check: Classical texts agree Jupiter is putra karaka.

hindi: यही एक पोर्टल है हमारा स्वाधिष्ठान जहां से हमारा अहंकार ऑन होता है मेरा वजूद होता है मेरी ग्रेविटी बनती है हड्डियां मजबूत होती है
says: Swadhisthana chakra is our portal where ego switches on, our sense of existence and gravity arise, and bones get strong; he treats it as the seat of personal identity.
ambiguity: Chakra physiology claim, not part of classical Jyotish; no planet is named in this sentence.
classical_check: Classical Jyotish silent; chakra linking comes from yoga tradition, which usually places ego in manipura and bones with Saturn.

hindi: यहीं से लाइट की सी स्क्वायर की स्पीड से आपके कॉस्मस में इलेक्ट्रोमैग्नेटिक सिग्नल जा सकता है एक्सेप्ट हार्ट चक्र दो ही चक्र है
says: Claims signals can leave from here into the cosmos at c-squared speed as electromagnetic signals, and that besides the heart chakra only this one can send them (two chakras only); pseudo-physics, not Jyotish.
ambiguity: The physics wording (speed of light squared) is garbled and scientifically wrong; only the chakra claim is recorded.
classical_check: Classical texts silent; physics statement is not valid.

gist: Listener says sir, as you said, sexual related issues and his food is different; and Gautam adds it is in the other part.

hindi: अगर वो खाना सपोर्ट करेगा तो जैसे तैसे बचे रहोगे दवाई से नहीं तो खोपड़ी खराब रहेगी
says: If the house (khana) supports it you somehow survive with medicine, otherwise the head stays disturbed; the house placement decides if the Rahu-Jupiter damage is contained.
cells_derived_method: If the house where Jupiter sits is supportive (friendly sign, benefic aspects, not 6/8/12) the damage is contained; in dusthana houses or enemy signs it stays disturbed.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Jupiter-Rahu in the 9th in Pisces, own sign in a trine, is supported and the effect is contained.
Derived, not said by him: Jupiter-Rahu in the 8th in Capricorn, debilitated in a dusthana, is unsupported and the mind stays disturbed.

ambiguity: 'खाना' is the Lal Kitab word for house; whether he means a specific house or any supporting house is unclear and the caption is noisy.
classical_check: Classical idea of house strength modifying a yoga agrees; the Lal Kitab wording is his.

hindi: खाना तो सा सातवा है पांचवा है इफेक्ट ही नहीं आ रहा पांच और सात हा तो यहां से भी न करेगा राहु राहु खिचड़ी मारेगा
says: Houses 5 and 7 are the relevant ones for sex and relationship, and Rahu will mess up (khichdi) from here too; Rahu in or aspecting the 5th and 7th disturbs Jupiter or related matters.
cells_derived_method: Rahu in the 5th disturbs romance, children and learning; Rahu in the 7th disturbs partnership and marriage; sign decides the style of disturbance.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Rahu in the 5th in Leo gives dramatic, ego-driven romance and unstable creative drive.
Derived, not said by him: Rahu in the 7th in Taurus gives a materialistic, sensual partner and fixed expectations.

ambiguity: Numbers 5 and 7 are houses (khana), but the audience crosstalk makes it unclear if these are aspects of Rahu (5th, 7th, 9th) or placements.
classical_check: Rahu aspects on 5th, 7th, 9th appear in some traditions; the effect on those houses agrees.

gist: Audience asks if the planet works according to its own property in that house, and he says yes, as the segment of the chart.

hindi: राहु तो कहीं भी बृहस्पति को डिस्टर्ब कर रहा है पंगा डालेगा ही तभी तो एक्स्ट्रा मेरिटल अफेयर्स होते हैं ज्ञान हिला देता है ना कोई भी गुरु
says: Wherever Rahu is, if it disturbs Jupiter it will cause trouble; that is why extra-marital affairs happen. Rahu shakes the knowledge and standing of any guru.
cells_derived_method: Affair risk rises when the Rahu-Jupiter link touches 5th, 7th or 2nd; house of Jupiter decides which area of life the guru's standing is shaken.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Rahu with Jupiter in the 7th in Gemini suggests outside attachments for the partner or oneself.
Derived, not said by him: Rahu with Jupiter in the 10th in Sagittarius shakes professional reputation of a teacher or advisor.

ambiguity: Whether Rahu disturbs by conjunction, aspect or both is not said.
classical_check: Classical texts link Rahu-Jupiter to unorthodox conduct; extramarital link is a later or his own gloss.

hindi: आप सोच कर चलो केतु क्या है बादल है गुरु क्या है ज्ञान प्रकाश वो बादल आ जाता है केतु और बृहस्पति साथ रखे हुए हैं
says: Think of Ketu as a cloud and Jupiter as light of knowledge; when Ketu and Jupiter are together the cloud covers the light and knowledge is dimmed.
cells_derived_method: Dimming matters most in 5th and 9th (intelligence and dharma) and 2nd (speech); Ketu in own-type signs such as Scorpio or Pisces gives intuitive or spiritual insight instead of pure confusion.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Jupiter with Ketu in the 9th in Sagittarius gives deep but detached or non-conformist religion.
Derived, not said by him: Jupiter with Ketu in the 5th in Gemini gives scattered learning and uncertain judgement.

ambiguity: None; the cloud and light metaphor is explicit.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical view that Ketu with Jupiter gives spiritual detachment but weakens worldly wisdom or progeny.

hindi: सेक्स के सपे में सारे बाबों की पिटाई होती है बदनामी उनको स्त्री करती है
says: Spiritual gurus (babas) get beaten and defamed over sex scandals, and women are the cause of the disgrace; he ties this fall to the Jupiter-Ketu or Jupiter-Rahu affliction.
ambiguity: Generalisation about babas; not a testable chart rule; caption 'सपे' probably 'सिलसिले' (matter of sex).
classical_check: Classical texts silent.

hindi: अगर जुपिटर प्लेस भी उनका किसी ऐसी जगह पर है जहां पर सेक्स का लिंक ही नहीं है तो भी इफेक्ट अगर राहु पंगे ले रहा है तो जुपिटर को छोड़ेगा नहीं ... जिस भाव में जुपिटर प्ले ता है वहां पर इफेक्ट
says: Even if Jupiter sits in a house with no sex link, if Rahu is troubling it Rahu will not spare it; the effect shows in the house where Jupiter sits, with whatever that house stands for.
cells_derived_method: The area damaged is the house topic of Jupiter's placement: 2nd family and wealth, 4th home, 6th service, 10th career, 11th gains, 12th expenses; sign of Jupiter adds its quality.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Jupiter with Rahu in the 10th in Libra damages career reputation and partnership-based work.
Derived, not said by him: Jupiter with Rahu in the 2nd in Aquarius disturbs family values and the handling of wealth.
Derived, not said by him: Jupiter with Rahu in the 11th in Scorpio spoils the stability of gains through secretive or risky means.

ambiguity: Whether this is conjunction only is not stated.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical principle that a karaka afflicted spoils the house it occupies.

hindi: आप ये समझ लो कि राहु नाम उसको दिया गया उस हैपनिंग को दिया गया जिसमें च जो चंदा है एक्लिप्स कर देता है सूरज को ग्रहण लगाता है
says: Rahu is the name given to the happening in which the Moon eclipses the Sun and causes the grahan; Rahu is the eclipse event, not a physical planet.
ambiguity: Technically a solar eclipse is the Moon covering the Sun; he gives it as the nature of Rahu, though classically Rahu is the node and eclipses occur near it.
classical_check: Classical astronomy: Rahu and Ketu are lunar nodes where eclipses happen; this agrees in spirit.

gist: Rhetorical question who is bigger than the Sun in our solar system, cut off by the end of the slice.

hindi: नहीं तो व सूरज को भी खा जाता है हमारे को सूरज दिखता है कहीं चंदा मामा बीच में आते हैं ना और चांद पर रहते हैं सारे के सारे पितर ऐसी कहानियां है
says: Continuing the eclipse image: the Moon comes between us and the Sun and hides it, and by the old stories all the ancestors (pitrs) live on the Moon; so he links Rahu-the-eclipse, Moon and pitrs together.

hindi: तो पि ही है जो ढक देते हैं भगवान को भी अगर पित कृपा ना हो और भगवान की आप पूजा कर रहे हो मंदिर में सिर मार रहे हो

cells_derived_method: Ancestor grace is read from the 9th house (father line and dharma), the 5th (purva punya) and Sun, with Rahu or Saturn on them showing pitru dosha. Sign of the 9th lord and any affliction by Rahu set the nature of the block.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Rahu in the 9th in Aquarius would block luck and father-line grace despite worship.
Derived, not said by him: Rahu in the 5th in Leo shows ancestral karma held back in children and blessings.

ambiguity: 9th house is not stated here; recorded as the classical pitru house.
classical_check: Classical texts: pitru dosha blocks results of other worship and remedies; agrees.

gist: He asks who is my ishta and jokes east and west, everything is worst, a failed rhyming line he admits did not work.

hindi: आपको पितरों के ही पांव पकड़ने पड़ेंगे पितर याद दिला दिए आपको अपने नाना दादा
says: Remedy: you will have to hold the feet of the ancestors themselves, that is, pay respect and remember the maternal and paternal grandfathers before the gods.
ambiguity: Not stated how (shraddh, tarpan or simple remembrance); only that ancestors come first.
classical_check: Classical remedy for pitru dosha is tarpan and shraddh; agrees in direction.

hindi: कहते हैं एक शब्द अच्छा नानी मर गई यानी पितरों की कृपा नहीं मिल रही यह कृपा का खेल है सारा का सारा

gist: Audience question about a joint family with four brothers in one house and whose wardrobe, pocket and common purse should be counted.
He praises the question and jokes that a wife has a secret locker that even the husband does not know about.
Joke about the demonetisation when wives brought out hidden 2.5 lakh and husbands never got it back.

hindi: मंदिर गुरुद्वारे में ऑप्शन होती है पर्ची कटाओ या गोलक में डालो ... फेंक आओ तो हमें नहीं पता अननोन किसको मिलेगा किसको नहीं मिलेगा अपनी तरफ से कर
says: At temples and gurudwaras you can take a receipt or drop money in the collection box; throwing it in the box means you do not know who gets it, which is why he recommends it: give from your side to an unknown recipient.
ambiguity: 8th house link is made only a few sentences later (secret donation lifts the 8th); recorded here as the intended house.
classical_check: Classical dana texts favour anonymous giving; agrees broadly.

hindi: यह हमारा आठवां घर है मृत्यु स्थान क्या किसी को पता चला मृत्यु कब होगी नो यह गुप्त स्थान है गुप्त
says: The 8th house is the house of death and secrecy: nobody knows when death will come, so it is the secret (gupt) place; death timing is hidden, he is not giving a date.
cells_derived_method: 8th house secrecy shows in different forms by sign: fixed signs hold secrets long, water signs bring hidden emotional matters, fire signs sudden events. Planets there add: Saturn long-hidden, Mars sudden, Rahu mysterious.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: 8th house in Scorpio holds deep secrets, occult interest and sudden transformation.
Derived, not said by him: 8th house in Gemini shows secrets tied to talk, documents and hidden sibling or communication matters.

ambiguity: None; 'eighth house' is a house number here, not a sign number.
classical_check: Agrees: 8th house is randhra, ayu, hidden and occult.

hindi: अगर स्थान में गड़बड़ होती है तो हमारी पोटी के अंदर प्रॉब्लम आती है हमारे को एनल फिशर्स होते हैं
says: If the secret place (8th house) is disturbed, problems come in the stool and anal area, such as anal fissures; recorded as his tradition link between the 8th house and the excretory region, not a medical diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: Affliction of the 8th by malefics (Mars, Saturn, Rahu) is the trigger; signs Virgo and Scorpio add digestive or excretory sensitivity.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: 8th house in Virgo with malefics would show digestive and excretion problems.
Derived, not said by him: 8th house in Aries with Mars afflicted would show sharp, inflammatory problems.

ambiguity: Medical link is a tradition claim; 8th house for the excretory area is not found in classical body-part tables, which place it on genitals and the anal region in some lists.
classical_check: Classical body mapping gives the 8th the anus and genitals in some texts; partly agrees.

hindi: यह हमारा साउथ साउथ वेस्ट होता है यही मृत्यु का स्थान है
says: The 8th house corresponds to the south-south-west direction of the house (vastu), and it is the place of death in the layout.
cells_derived_method: none: a direction mapping, not sign dependent.
ambiguity: Vastu mapping of the 8th house to SSW is his own assignment; 'this' refers to the 8th house.
classical_check: Classical Vastu does not map houses to directions this way; south-west is Nairuthi, tied to Rahu and ancestors; partly agrees.

hindi: आपके जीवन में मल त्यागने में समस्या बैठ रही है तो आपके अष्टम भाव का दोष है
says: If you are having trouble passing stool in life, that is a sign of a fault in the 8th house; the simple mapping of bowel trouble to the 8th house.
cells_derived_method: none beyond the previous sentence: the dosha is read from whichever malefics or lord afflict the 8th.
ambiguity: Medical claim as tradition only; sentence spans the chunk boundary.
classical_check: Classical texts silent on bowel trouble as an 8th house sign; not a validated rule.

hindi: अष्टम भाव का क्या मतलब है सीक्रेट एस ई सी आर ई टी सीक्रेट और सीक्रेट नाम से बुक भी आई थी जो कहती थी कैसे मेनिफेस्ट करना है
says: The 8th house means Secret; the book The Secret (about manifesting) belongs to the same theme, so manifestation techniques are 8th house knowledge.
ambiguity: Link to a self-help book is his analogy.
classical_check: Classical texts say the 8th is hidden knowledge (gudha vidya); silent on manifestation.

hindi: आपके जीवन के अंदर सारा ऑल्ट का ज्ञान ऑल्ट का मतलब परा विज्ञान जो विज्ञान से परे जिसको विज्ञान द्वारा समझाया नहीं जा सकता
says: All occult knowledge in your life, meaning para-vigyan beyond science that science cannot explain, is the 8th house; it cannot be described, like the taste of gulab jamun.
cells_derived_method: Occult talent is stronger with Scorpio influence, Ketu, Saturn or Pluto on the 8th, and weaker where the 8th is empty and aspected only by worldly planets.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: 8th house in its own sign Scorpio gives natural occult depth.
Derived, not said by him: 8th house in Pisces gives intuitive and mystic leanings.

ambiguity: 'Alt' in the caption is occult.
classical_check: Agrees: 8th house is occult, hidden science (gudha vidya).

gist: Describing gulab jamun taste cannot be done; sings a jhoom barabar jhoom line and apologises.

hindi: रेकी से ठीक कर रहे हैं ... एक बाबा है ये तुम्हारा हेडेक ठीक हो गया ऐसे कैसे होता है ये सारा अष्टम भाव का है
says: Reiki-type healing, sending shakti and a baba curing a headache without touching are all 8th house matters: unexplainable energy work belongs to the 8th. Reported claim, not endorsed as medical treatment.

classical_check: Classical texts silent on Reiki; agrees only that 8th is occult.

hindi: ऑल्ट की कृपा से ही आपकी सेटिंग होगी
says: Your setting (arrangement of life, getting things aligned) will come only by grace of the occult, the 8th house force; in his usage setting means putting life in order through unseen help.
ambiguity: 'Setting' is slang; meaning inferred from context.
classical_check: Classical texts silent.

hindi: अब ये गुप्त दान किया जाए तो जो भी आप गुप्त कर रहे हैं आपको पता नहीं है वो आपके अष्टम भाव को लिफ्ट कर रहा है
says: Secret donation (gupt daan), where you do not know who gets it, lifts and strengthens your 8th house; it is the remedy for the 8th house.
ambiguity: No planet named; the remedy is for the house as a whole.
classical_check: Classical texts give donation for pacifying malefics; the 8th-house link is his.

hindi: यानी मौत कम से कम तड़प के होगी
says: Result of a strong 8th house from gupt daan: at least death will not be a tortured or painful one; he promises an easier end, not a date.
ambiguity: Remedy promise about manner of death; no date given.
classical_check: Classical texts judge manner of death from the 8th house and its lord; the donation link is his.

hindi: जो लोग सारे टाइम किसी काम वाले को कुछ देते हैं फिर देने के बाद कहते हैं तेरे को सूट दिया था पिछली बार वो देना व्यर्थ हो गया
says: Giving to a servant and then reminding them of it (I gave you a suit last time) makes that giving wasted; giving that you keep track of or mention loses its value as daan.
ambiguity: Ethical principle, no planet or house.

hindi: आपको पता ही ना हो कहां दिया किसको दिया ये है जो एक्चुअली दान है इसे गुप्त दान कहते हैं ये अष्टम भाव को सॉलिड करता है

ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Classical texts silent on this exact definition; agrees with spirit of gupta daan.

hindi: आपको ज्ञान आया कहां से आया हमें धेला नहीं पता कहां से आया यह गुप्त है पता ही नहीं कहां से इतनी बकबक चल रही है
says: Knowledge and ideas arrive from unknown source; he himself does not know where his talk comes from, and that unknown origin is the 8th house secret. The 8th is the channel for intuition and inspiration.
ambiguity: Self-reference, said half in joke.
classical_check: Classical texts silent on inspiration as 8th house.

hindi: गुरुद्वारे में भी इसलिए गुल्लक में फेंका पची से आ जाती है ... पची कागज तो बु एक्टिवेट होता है नहीं नहीं कोई लेनदेन नहीं उसे फेंक दो ना
says: At the gurudwara this is why he said to throw it in the box: a receipt (parchi) brings a record and paper trail, so no transaction should be involved, just throw it. A slip can be taken only if you need karah prasad.

classical_check: Classical texts silent.

hindi: ह्यूमन कॉन्शसनेस सबसे ऊपर है इससे ऊपर कुछ भी नहीं है हां ईगो तो आएगी मुन्ना ईगो आएगी उसे आने दो और उसे ऑब्जर्व करो शैतान बच्चा आया उसे देखो

ambiguity: Spiritual advice, not astrology.

hindi: यह गुप्त कर देने से मात्र आपका अष्टम भाव स्ट्रांग होता है और आपकी मृत्यु सहूलियत की होती है
says: Merely doing the donation in secret makes the 8th house strong and your death comfortable; the benefit comes from secrecy itself.
ambiguity: Sentence crosses a chunk boundary and is repeated in the next lines.
classical_check: Classical texts silent on this remedy.

hindi: सारी जिंदगी सहूलियत की मृत्यु का काम करो यार मौत तगड़ी और बढ़िया होनी चाहिए इसलिए गुप्त दान करो
says: Work through life towards a comfortable death; death should be strong and good, so do gupt daan as the practical step.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Classical texts silent.

Audience asks if gupt daan can be food items.

hindi: गुप्त दान का मतलब हमें कोई लेनदेन नहीं हमें पता ही नहीं पैसा और अगर आप कॉन्शियस में इतनी अवेयरनेस रखते हैं माइंडफुल कहते हैं इसे कि आप सामने किसी को कुछ दे रहे हो और आपको फर्क नहीं पड़ा वो भी गुप्त दान ट्रीट होगा
says: Gupt daan means no dealing and not knowing the money's fate; also, if you give face to face with full mindfulness and feel no attachment or effect, that too counts as secret donation.

gist: Audience says people at the gurudwara ask what is needed and bring soap or milk; he says that makes no difference.

hindi: उसमें फर्क पड़ता है अगर आपकी कुंडली लावनी करती है ... अगर चंद्रमा का दोष है और आपने चावल दूध दे दिया
says: Giving does make a difference depending on the chart: if your Moon is afflicted (Moon dosha) and you donate rice and milk, which are Moon items, it backfires; remedy items must suit the planet's condition.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Moon debilitated in the 8th in Scorpio, so rice or milk donation would be avoided in his scheme.
Derived, not said by him: Moon in own sign in the 4th in Cancer is strong, so Moon items are safer to give.

classical_check: Differs from the classical view that donating the planet's articles pacifies it, though some Lal Kitab ideas warn against giving items of an afflicted planet.

gist: He says we will soon reach the 9th house in the walk through the houses.

hindi: तो अगले दिन से आपका डब्ल्यूबीसी कम हो जाएगा वाइट ब्लड सेल कम बीमार पड़ जाओगे
says: Consequence of giving Moon things with a Moon dosha: from the next day your white blood cell count falls and you fall ill; reported as his claim, not a medical statement.
ambiguity: Medical effect is an unvalidated tradition claim.
classical_check: Classical texts silent; not supported.

hindi: ऐसे लोग हैं जो कहते हैं जैसे ही मैं तीर्थ से होके आता हूं बीमार पड़ जाता हूं ... हम उनकी पूजा पाठ बंद कर आए ते हैं कि तुम मत करो भाई तुम्हें कुछ और करना है तुम्हारे पता नहीं कुल देवता का लफड़ा है
says: Some people fall ill every time they return from a pilgrimage; he stops their puja and says their problem lies elsewhere, perhaps with the family deity (kuldevta) or vastu deity, so they need something else.

classical_check: Classical texts silent; kuldevata matters appear in the 5th and 9th houses in some practice.

hindi: देवता बहुत सारे हैं हमारे यहां पिन पॉइंटेड है कि ये जैसे डॉक्टर कहता है ये वाले ऑर्गन की प्रॉब्लम है
says: There are many deities in our system and the remedy is pinpointed to the specific one, like a doctor pointing to the specific organ at fault; each problem has its own deity or planet.

Housekeeping: counting which house is left, nine done, seven here, eight here.

hindi: यहां आठ नंबर में चंद्रमा सबसे खराब होता है तो चांदी ना रखें सफेद रंग के चीज ना रखें कोई भी वाइट चीज आपके पर्स में नहीं होनी चाहिए
says: At sign number eight (Scorpio) the Moon is at its worst (debilitated), so in that zone do not keep silver or any white-coloured items, none in your purse. He treats Moon in this place as the most damaging.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Moon debilitated in the 8th in Scorpio, the strongest case for avoiding white and silver.
Derived, not said by him: Moon exalted in the 8th in Taurus, the weakest case for his prohibition.

says: Wood may be suitable instead, and for number eight (Scorpio) he begins to mention Mars, its lord; the caption is cut off, so the exact statement about Mars and eight is not available.

hindi: की राशि है लगभग इंद्र की होती है वैसे यहां पर शनि नहीं होना चाहिए
says: Carrying on from number eight: this sign is Mars's and roughly also belongs to Indra (Uranus) in his scheme; Saturn should not be present in this zone.

Derived, not said by him: Saturn in the 11th in Scorpio gives slow but real gains with cold, secretive networks.

hindi: लोहे की अलमारी बंदा गलती से भी इस्तेमाल ना करे काला पर्स गलती से भी इस्तेमाल ना करें काले रंग रुमाल के अंदर प्रिंट तक ना हो
says: For the number-eight zone (Scorpio) do not use an iron almirah, a black purse or even a black print on a handkerchief; Saturn's material and colour are to be avoided.

hindi: लोहे की अलमारी ना यूज करें यहां पर वो नेगेटिव होगी आपके लिए और आपके चंद्रमा यानी कि सिल्वर ना रखा जाए गोल्ड जरूर रखें कैसा भी हो
says: In this number-eight zone an iron almirah is negative for you, silver (the Moon's metal) should not be kept, and gold must be kept, in any form or quality; gold (Jupiter) is the supportive metal here.

hindi: अगर आपके पास गोल्ड नहीं है तो क्या करें पीतल रख ले

hindi: 90 पर लोगों को पीले रंग का एक पेपर वेट ले लेना चाहिए गोल्डन और आपको अपने वर्क प्लेस पर वेस्ट साउथ वेस्ट में रखना चाहिए वह आपके जीवन के अंदर गोल्ड को अट्रैक्ट करेगा ऑटोमेटिक

hindi: यह परमानेंट रूल बुक में डाल लो
says: He tells students to note it in the permanent rule book: the brass or yellow paperweight remedy for gold is to be treated as a standing rule.

classical_check: Classical texts silent on astro-vastu as a branch.

hindi: इसलिए आप पीतल रखें पीतल रख सकते हैं कुछ नहीं है तो पीले रंग का कागज रख ले सिर्फ कागज वो कलर की थेरेपी है उसी से काम हो जाएगा जुपिटर का
says: So keep brass; if you have nothing, keep plain yellow paper, which works as colour therapy and that is enough for Jupiter's work.
ambiguity: None.

hindi: यह शुक्र का है सात नंबर शुक्र का होता है शनि उच्च का होता है इसमें सूर्य नीच का होता है
says: Number seven is Venus's sign; Saturn is exalted in it and the Sun is debilitated in it. This is simply Libra's dignities, correct as classically given.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Saturn exalted in the 10th in Libra gives career with strong discipline and fair dealing.
Derived, not said by him: Sun debilitated in the 4th in Libra weakens home peace and mother-linked comforts.

ambiguity: Number seven is the sign Libra here, confirmed by the exaltation facts.
classical_check: Agrees with classical dignity: Libra is Venus's own sign, Saturn exalted, Sun debilitated.

hindi: सात नंबर में डर्टिस्ट लकड़ी की अलमारी बिल्कुल ना रखी जाए किसी हालत में भी लकड़ होई ना लोहा लाजवाब कैसा मर्जी हो आप इसमें लकड़ी की कोई चीज नहीं रखें

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Saturn exalted in the 7th in Libra, so iron objects suit and support partnership matters.
Derived, not said by him: Saturn debilitated in the 1st in Aries would reverse the advice and make iron a burden.

ambiguity: He uses wood as a marker of Jupiter or Mars material; not stated why wood is bad for Libra.
classical_check: Classical texts silent; Lal Kitab style object remedy.

hindi: यहां सूर्य से रिलेटेड ऑरेंज कलर ना हो ऑरेंज कलर बिल्कुल ना हो आपके लॉकर के अंदर आपके पर्स में ना हो
says: In the Libra zone there should be no orange colour related to the Sun, not in the locker and not in the purse, since the Sun is debilitated here.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Sun's colour as orange or copper-red is classical-adjacent; the ban is his.

hindi: प्योर काला पर्स ले सकते हैं लेकिन इसमें एक ही डिफेक्ट है यहां आठवें घर पे अगर सात नंबर यहां है तो यहां एक नंबर होगा तो यह पैर की प्रॉब्लम दे देगा
says: A pure black purse is allowed in the Libra zone, with one defect: when the seven falls in the 8th house with a one (Aries) next to it, it will give leg problems. Garbled sentence, the exact condition is unclear. Medical claim recorded as tradition only.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Libra in the 8th means lagna Pisces; the 12th (feet) is Aquarius, Saturn's sign, so Saturn items like a jet-black purse would hit the feet in that chart.

ambiguity: Very garbled: either 7 in the 8th house and 1 in the 12th (feet), or 7 and 1 as adjacent numbers. Foot is the 12th house classically, which matches 12 from lagna Taurus being Aries (1). Low confidence.

hindi: इसको काउंटर करने के लिए आप ऐसा ऐसा ऐसा पर्स ले जो ब्लू ब्लैकिश हो ब्लू कलर राहु का होता ब्लू ब्लैकिश जेट ब्लैक आपको तंग कर सकता है
says: To counter the leg problem take a bluish-black purse; blue is Rahu's colour, whereas jet black can trouble you.
ambiguity: The reference to number seven carries over from the prior chunk.
classical_check: Classical colour for Rahu is dark blue or smoky, partly agrees; the purse remedy is not classical.

hindi: अगर यहां कोई प्रोटेक्टिव प्लेनेट ना हो अगर यहां मंगल वगैरह है सूर्य है बृहस्पति है तो टक्ट हो जाएगा फिर कोई टेंशन नहीं है नहीं तो अदर वाइज पैर की तकलीफ

hindi: हमारा काम क्या है हम देखते हैं ये पंगा है फट से पकड़ लिया कि भैया ... पैर में नसों की दिक्कत है शनि एक्टिवेट करता है ओ यार तेरा परस काला है क्या बस इसको चेंज कर ले खत्म बात
says: His working method: spot the problem quickly; if the client has leg cramps or vein trouble, Saturn is activated, so ask if the purse is black and just change it; case closed. Medical symptoms are linked to Saturn as his tradition claim.

hindi: लकड़ी की अलमारी ले ले लोहे की मत ले जो भी जैसे हो इसको तो लकड़ी सूट नहीं करेगी वो परिवर्तन करा दीजिए उससे ही रिलीफ नजर आता है

says: Number six (Virgo) is Rahu's house in his scheme, is Mercury's sign where Mercury is exalted, and Venus is debilitated here.

says: Arrange a rod of lead and keep it in your locker where it will just lie; a battery cell is also acceptable. He moves on to pencil lead as another form.

says: Here it is Rahu's sign and Rahu will eat everyone, so hold this: only Mars can stay in this zone, meaning copper can be kept.

hindi: मंगल हनुमान जी अकेले हैं जो इससे बच सकते हैं यानी आपको कोई भी दोष है नहीं है कुछ भी है
says: Mars as Hanuman is the only one who can escape Rahu, so whatever dosha you have or do not have, Mars and Hanuman worship holds.

hindi: यह 4 पर अग्नि है हमारी नाभी यह स्वयं है पितरों का है नहीं है मामा का है भाई का है भगवान का है स्वयं नाभी सांस चलती रहती है
