gist: He says they must talk most about love since their talk is reverse of others who say do not do vices or bad things, and asks what else to do on earth.
Joke about a man with several marriages and a girlfriend who still wants to marry God (pun on lagan, devotion and marriage).

hindi: भगवान की फोटो रख सकते हैं कौन से भगवान की रखनी है भगवान दुर्गा की रख सकते हैं यहां दुर्गा की फोटो आ सकती है बहुत सुंदर बात दुर्गा की फोटोग्राफ रख सकते हैं आपके लॉकर में
says: A god's photo may be kept here, and specifically Goddess Durga's photograph in the locker is allowed and good for the sign-six zone.
ambiguity: Durga is the deity usually for Rahu; he does not say so in this sentence.
classical_check: Durga worship for Rahu is a common remedy, not classical Jyotish.

hindi: मान लो मेरे लिए यदि आप गुरु भावना रखते हैं और बृहस्पति ऑन करते हैं और बृहस्पति बन गया यहां रखा तो इसकी पांचवी दृष्टि एक्टिवेट होगी ये बहुत मजेदार चीज है
says: If you hold a guru feeling for him and keep that photo here, Jupiter is switched on in this zone, and Jupiter's fifth aspect gets activated; he calls this a very interesting point.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter's 5th, 7th and 9th aspects fall on the signs 5, 7 and 9 counted from its own sign; from Virgo these are Capricorn, Pisces and Taurus, and the house they fall on depends on the placement of Jupiter.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Jupiter in the 5th in Virgo (lagna Taurus) aspects the 9th house, Capricorn, with its 5th aspect, lifting luck and dharma.
Derived, not said by him: Jupiter in the 1st in Virgo (lagna Virgo) aspects the 5th, 7th and 9th houses, which are Capricorn, Pisces and Taurus.

ambiguity: Whether it is a photo or the mental feeling that makes Jupiter is unclear; the second half of the sentence is garbled.
classical_check: Jupiter's 5th, 7th and 9th aspects are classical; the idea that a guru photo makes a Jupiter zone is his.

gist: A run of numbers counted aloud (six, ten, twelve, one, two, three) as he counts the aspect targets; caption cannot be reliably parsed.

hindi: आपने गुरु की फोटोग्राफ रख ली इसकी पांचवी दृष्टि य अटैक मारेगी यह आपकी कमर है रीड की हड्डी बैक बोन और यह आपका एक पैर है यह आपकी कोट कचहरी है शत्रु है
says: If a guru's photo (Jupiter) is kept in the sign-six zone, its fifth aspect attacks three areas: the waist and spine, one foot, and the court-case or enemy area; he names these body and life areas as the damage points.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter in Virgo aspects Capricorn (5th), Pisces (7th) and Taurus (9th). Capricorn rules the back and knees and Pisces the feet in the body zodiac, which matches his spine and foot; enemies and court belong to the 6th house, which is Virgo itself when the lagna is Aries. The place the aspect falls in a chart depends on Jupiter's house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Jupiter in the 6th in Virgo (lagna Aries) aspects the 10th, 12th and 2nd, which are Capricorn, Pisces and Taurus, so enemies grow while career, feet and family are touched.

Derived, not said by him: Jupiter in the 10th in Virgo (lagna Sagittarius) aspects the 2nd, 4th and 6th houses, which are Capricorn, Pisces and Taurus, so Capricorn (back) and the 6th house enemies in Taurus come under its gaze.

ambiguity: Which of 'this is your waist', 'this is your foot', 'this is court' maps to which sign is not stated; the mapping by body zodiac is inferred. Possibly a medical-type claim, recorded only as tradition.
classical_check: Jupiter's 5th, 7th and 9th aspects are classical; Capricorn for back and Pisces for feet agree with the body zodiac; a guru photo causing these is not classical.

hindi: जितना गुरु की शरण में जाओगे पर्स में लॉकर में रखोगे उतना आपके शत्रु बढ़ जाएंगे उतना आपकी कमर टूट जाएगी एक पैर खींच जाएगा डेंजर बहुत खतरनाक
says: The more you surrender to the guru and keep his photo in your purse or locker, the more enemies grow, the back breaks and one foot pulls; he calls it dangerous. A warning against guru photos in the sign-six zone.
ambiguity: Physical effects are his tradition claim, not medical.
classical_check: Silent; contradicts the usual view that a guru's photo is protective, though Jupiter in the 6th house is classically weak for protection.

gist: Word play on cancel and pencil: he says he himself cancels at will, then tells the audience to cancel the guru's photo from here.

hindi: लेकिन यहां पर अगर आप देख रहे हैं तो ये 12 नंबर आपको मृत्यु का भय उड़ा देगा ये मृत्यु पूछ के आएगी बीमार भी नहीं पड़ोगे आप ऑटोमेटिक
says: On the other side, number twelve (Pisces, Jupiter's seventh aspect from Virgo) will remove the fear of death; death will come only after asking and you will not even fall ill. Recorded as his claim, no date given.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter's 7th aspect from Virgo falls on Pisces, its own sign and the natural 12th; it gives moksha and a peaceful end. In a chart the house reached depends on Jupiter's house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Jupiter in the 6th in Virgo (lagna Aries) aspects the 12th house Pisces, giving a calm, spiritual ending and foreign or ashram links.
Derived, not said by him: Jupiter in the 3rd in Virgo (lagna Cancer) aspects the 9th house Pisces, linking luck and dharma to a peaceful end.

ambiguity: '12 number' is Pisces by sign counting; the connection to fear of death is his assertion about the 12th and Jupiter.
classical_check: Jupiter's 7th aspect and the 12th as moksha house are classical; promising freedom from illness is not.

hindi: यह गुरु की भक्ति प्रॉब्लम और शत्रुता बहुत देगी लेकिन हर कष्ट से निकलोगे ... कई लोग ऐसे जो कहते हैं हम भगवान की भक्ति कर रहे बहुत समस्या है लेकिन बचते रहे ये अलग-अलग एक्टिवेशन है
says: Guru devotion here brings many problems and enmity but you will come out of every hardship; this explains devotees who say they worship God and have many troubles yet survive; each sign aspect is a different activation.
ambiguity: Combines the two aspects (hardship from the 5th, survival from the 7th).
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अब यहां पर हम एक धागा बनवाते हैं इसलिए आपको फोटो रखनी है तो बता देना धागा बता
says: For anyone who still wants to keep the guru's photo, he makes a protective thread (dhaga); he says to tell him and he will give the thread.
ambiguity: Sentence ends at the chunk boundary; the thread details come next.
classical_check: Silent; thread amulets are a folk remedy.

hindi: एक पैर में एक धागा बंधाया जाता है उस रंग का करने से यह प्रोटेक्शन हो जाएगी आपकी यहां पर डेड हो गया इफेक्ट
says: A thread of the matching colour is tied on one leg; with that the protection is done and the harmful effect is dead. The colour is not stated here.
ambiguity: Which colour and which leg are not clear; the colour is presumably the planet's colour (yellow for Jupiter) but he does not say.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यह मल्टीपल रेमेडीज की जाती है डॉक्टर आपको जब एक दवाई देता है बीमारी के लिए तो उसके साथ दो गोली और ठोक देता है ये इस वाले का साइड इफेक्ट के लिए
says: Multiple remedies are given together, just as a doctor gives one medicine and two more tablets to cover its side effects; a second remedy shields against the side effect of the first.
ambiguity: Analogy to prescribing.
classical_check: Silent; the idea of paired remedies is a modern practice.

gist: Joke about keeping the guru's photo in the heart and your wife's photo instead, or she will find out and beat you.
He says do not make anyone your guru, be a lamp unto yourself (Appo deepo bhava of Buddha) and know yourself; he says people ask him do this and that.
People have got caught in the Jyotish and vastu circle and ask for steps; he says know yourself, learn, and not just attend classes.
He says many good teachers and videos exist and they teach for fun, not for the fee; ego is under observation.
Ocean analogy: what he can say is one drop of an ocean; the subject is vast and lovely.

hindi: किसी जन्म में आपके इंटू ऑन होगी हम ये क्लासेस करने के बाद एक क्लास कर लेंगे इंटू के ऊपर कि जब वो इंटू का खाना आप ऑन कर लेंगे अपना वो भी यही है
says: Plans a later class on intuition: when you switch on the intuition house (khana) in your own chart, you can extract the essence of everything you have heard. Which house or sign it is is not said.
ambiguity: 'इंटू' is intuition (garbled); the house is not named.
classical_check: Silent; intuition is classically tied to the 5th house and Moon.

gist: An audience member says two relationships (rishte) remained from the earlier question and asks for them.

hindi: रिश्ते भी यहीं से देखते हैं अगर यहां दोष हो तो आपके रिश्ते खराब होते रहेंगे और कैश भी खराब होता रहेगा
says: Relationships and cash are both read from this zone (the second), so if it has a dosha relationships keep going bad and cash keeps getting spoilt.
cells_derived_method: Second house afflictions show in the sign: Taurus gives stubborn money or family issues, Gemini gives speech and sibling-linked troubles, Aries gives rash spending and sharp words.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: 2nd house in Taurus afflicted by Rahu shows family and bank-balance problems together.
Derived, not said by him: 2nd house in Aries afflicted by Saturn shows hard speech and strained family purses.

ambiguity: He says 'यहीं' without naming the number; the pairing of family, cash and speech points to number two (second house or sign Taurus), which matches later items. Cells recorded as the 2nd house.
classical_check: Agrees: the 2nd house rules family (kutumba), wealth and speech.

hindi: रिश्ते और कैश से एक साथ कंगला होता है मनुष्य रिश्ते और कैश दोनों से ही मौज भरी होती है शक्ति स्पीच सब स्पीच यही है वो भी यही है
says: A man becomes poor in relationships and cash together, and enjoys both together; strength and speech also come from this same zone, so cash, relatives and speech are one cluster.
ambiguity: Same location as the previous row; the word 'shakti' may be 'bhakti' or 'sampatti'.
classical_check: Agrees with the 2nd house as wealth and speech.

gist: Today's topic is cash and its giving; what to give and what to keep will be discussed.

hindi: हमने रिश्तेदारों को भी जो दिया और उनसे कुछ मिला नहीं तो बोलो रिश्ते निभ रहे हैं वो देने से वो रिश्ते निभ नहीं रहे हैं वो रिश्ते जबरदस्ती के हैं जब तक दे रहे तभी तक रिश्ते हैं वन साइडेड रिश्ते हैं
says: If you keep giving to relatives and get nothing back, the relationship is running only on your giving; such ties are forced and one-sided and last only while you give.
ambiguity: Social observation, not a technique.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: पर्स कौन कलर का होगा पर्स तो इसमें ब्राउन ब्लू ब्लू ब्राउन बहुत बढ़िया कलर आता है अच्छा है गन ग्रीन भी बहुत ही बढ़िया है लेकिन ग्रीन य 12 नंबर एक्टिवेट कर देगा
says: For this zone the purse should be brown or blue, which suit it very well; gun-green is also very good but green would activate number twelve, so it brings that side effect.
ambiguity: Whether this is the sign-two zone or still sign six is unclear; brown and blue repeat the Rahu colours given earlier. Why green activates twelve is not explained.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अगर आपके पास कैश दे लेकर रिश्ते चल रहे हैं तो वो रिश्ते नहीं है वह देने लेने से चल रहे हैं अगर कैश नहीं दिया और फिर भी है तो रिश्ता मानेंगे उसमें गरमाई है
says: If a relationship runs only on exchange of cash it is not a real relationship but a transaction; if it survives with no cash given then it is a relationship and has warmth.
ambiguity: Test of a real relationship; not a chart rule.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Counting off the zones: this is four and this is five.

hindi: यहां सूर्य अच्छा है शनि बुरा है यहां लकड़ी का ओके है यहां पर लोहे की खराब है अलमारी
says: In the number-five zone (Leo) the Sun is good and Saturn is bad, so a wooden almirah is fine and an iron one is bad.
cells_derived_method: Sun in its own sign Leo is strong; Saturn is its enemy, so iron (Saturn's metal) clashes. The effect of Saturn in Leo is worst in the 1st, 5th and 10th, where the Sun's matters are central.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Sun in own sign in the 5th in Leo is strong for children and learning; Saturn there would cloud it.
Derived, not said by him: Saturn in the 10th in Leo gives heavy, delayed authority and conflicts with the boss, so iron-heavy work items clash.

ambiguity: The numbers are signs, confirmed by the Sun being good (own sign) in number five.
classical_check: Sun-Saturn enmity is classical; the object rules are Lal Kitab style.

hindi: यहां चार आता है यहां पर आप मिट्टी की कुछ भी चीज नहीं ले सकते यह चंद्रमा की राशि है मंगल ऑन नहीं कर सकते
says: In number four (Cancer) you cannot keep anything made of clay, because it is the Moon's sign and you must not switch on Mars here (Mars is debilitated in Cancer).
cells_derived_method: Mars is debilitated in Cancer, which weakens it hardest in the 1st, 4th, 7th, 10th; Moon in Cancer is strong everywhere.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Mars debilitated in the 4th in Cancer disturbs home and land matters; so Mars items are avoided.
Derived, not said by him: Mars debilitated in the 10th in Cancer weakens authority and drive at work.

ambiguity: Clay as Mars's material is his assumption (earth); he does not state the link in this sentence.
classical_check: Moon's own sign Cancer and Mars's debilitation agree; clay as Mars-related is Lal Kitab style.

hindi: कोई भी लॉकर बनाए उसमें चांदी जरूर रखें चंद्रमा का ऑन है गुड यहां बृहस्पति ऑन है
says: Whatever locker you make in the Cancer zone must hold silver, switching on the Moon, which is good, and Jupiter is also switched on here (exalted in Cancer).

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Moon in own sign and Jupiter exalted in the 4th in Cancer give a happy home, so silver in the locker supports the mother and comfort.
Derived, not said by him: Jupiter exalted in the 9th in Cancer gives strong fortune and guru support.

ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Moon's silver and Jupiter's exaltation in Cancer agree classically.

hindi: आपको सबसे ज्यादा सबसे ज्यादा बढ़िया रहेगा क्रीम कलर का पर्स पूरा पीला क्यों नहीं ले रहे क्योंकि बृहस्पति की यहां 10 नंबर दृष्टि हो जाएगी
says: The best purse for the Cancer zone is cream coloured; full yellow is avoided because that would give Jupiter's aspect on number ten (Capricorn, its debilitation sign), which causes harm.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter in Cancer casts its 5th aspect on Scorpio, 7th on Capricorn and 9th on Pisces, so the aspect on number ten is the 7th, falling on Capricorn where Jupiter itself is weak.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Jupiter exalted in the 4th in Cancer (lagna Aries) aspects the 10th house Capricorn with its 7th aspect.
Derived, not said by him: Jupiter exalted in the 10th in Cancer (lagna Libra) aspects the 4th house, Capricorn, with its 7th aspect.

ambiguity: '10 number' is the 7th aspect from Cancer, a sign counted target.
classical_check: Jupiter's 7th aspect is classical; the purse colour link is his.

hindi: यहां 10 नंबर दृष्टि बृहस्पति की होने से आपको फैटी लीवर रहेगा इसीलिए 50 से 60 पर लोग फैटी लीवर से ग्रसित है क्योंकि जुपिटर डिस्टर्ब है सारा फैटी लीवर का स्यापा है
says: Jupiter's aspect on number ten gives a fatty liver, and that is why 50 to 60 percent of people have fatty liver, because Jupiter is disturbed. A medical and statistical claim of his, unvalidated and not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter is the liver and fat karaka classically; Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn, or afflicted in the 6th (disease) or 10th, would be the places his idea points to, with sign deciding the form.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Jupiter debilitated in the 6th in Capricorn (lagna Leo) puts the liver karaka weak in the disease house, matching his liver-trouble idea.
Derived, not said by him: Jupiter debilitated in the 9th in Capricorn (lagna Taurus) weakens fortune and guru support rather than the body, so the liver link would be milder.

ambiguity: The 50 to 60 percent figure is not data. The jump from the aspect to fatty liver is his own.
classical_check: Classical texts give the liver and fat to Jupiter; the statistic and mechanism are not classical.

hindi: उसके लिए गुरु को जो देना चाहे दे आप क्योंकि वो बृहस्पति प्रसन्न रहेगा तो सब बढ़िया रहेगा
says: The remedy for a disturbed Jupiter is to give whatever you wish to your guru, since a pleased Jupiter means all goes well.
ambiguity: He then jokes about being the guru; a self-interested remark.
classical_check: Donation to a guru for Jupiter is classical.

gist: He jokes he does not get pleased easily and is very greedy, that nobody agrees to give him anything, and a nani-dies joke.
Counting zones: this is two, this is three.

hindi: तीन नंबर में राहु उच्च है सिक्का धातु रखें रेजगारी रखें सिक्का धातु रेजगारी खूब सारी रेजगारी पैसा रखे नोट नोट रखो
says: In number three (Gemini) Rahu is exalted in his scheme, so keep lead metal, lots of loose coins, cash and notes.
cells_derived_method: Rahu exalted in Gemini works best in the 3rd, 6th, 10th and 11th, where growth and risk-taking pay; in the 8th or 12th it intensifies secrecy and loss.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Rahu exalted in the 11th in Gemini gives large networked gains.
Derived, not said by him: Rahu exalted in the 8th in Gemini gives strange events, hidden money and sudden turns.

ambiguity: Exaltation of Rahu in Gemini is a tradition (Taurus in others); he states it as his scheme.
classical_check: Rahu's exaltation is Taurus or Gemini in different texts; Gemini is accepted by some.

hindi: खूब सारे टिन होता है ये स्टील होता है स्टील टिन रांगा कल कराते थे ना वो रांगा होता है यूज तीन नंबर सब बुध का
says: Tin, steel and the rangaa used to coat utensils are all Mercury's for the number-three zone, so such items can be used.
ambiguity: Garbled start; the metals meant are tin and steel.
classical_check: Classical Mercury metal is bronze or brass and sometimes tin; steel is Lal Kitab.

hindi: यहीं पर लेड भी रख सकते हैं लेकिन लेड रखने से नौ नंबर यहां ऑन होगा तो इसलिए लेड ज्यादा अच्छा नहीं है बुध की समान रखो
says: Lead can be kept too, but then number nine gets switched on, so lead is not better; keep Mercury's own items.
cells_derived_method: Number nine (Sagittarius) is the 7th from Gemini, the Mercury-Jupiter axis, so lead (Rahu) activating it would stir that opposite sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Rahu in the 3rd in Gemini would stir its opposite, the 9th house Sagittarius, so luck and father matters get disturbed.
Derived, not said by him: Rahu in the 9th in Gemini stirs its 3rd, Sagittarius, shaking courage and the dharma front.

ambiguity: Why lead turns on nine is not explained; he possibly means the 7th aspect.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: हरे रंग का पर्स ले लो यहां ले सकते हैं आप हरे रंग का हरा टाइप कुछ भी हो जाए वो चलेगा
says: For the Gemini zone take a green purse, any type of green will do; green is Mercury's colour.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Green for Mercury is classical.

hindi: यहां लकड़ी भी ओके है वुड भी ओके है आयरन भी ओके है हालांकि यहां आयरन की वजह से एक अलग दृष्टि आएगी इसलिए वुड बेटर आयरन ओके ओके नॉट बैड
says: In the Gemini zone wood is fine and iron is also fine, though iron brings a different aspect (Saturn's), so wood is better and iron is acceptable, not bad.
cells_derived_method: Saturn's aspects are the 3rd, 7th and 10th; a Saturn object in the Gemini zone would cast these onto Leo, Sagittarius and Pisces.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Saturn in the 3rd in Gemini (lagna Aries) aspects the 5th, 9th and 12th houses, which are Leo, Sagittarius and Pisces, so an iron item adds a Saturn gaze on those houses.

ambiguity: 'Different aspect' is not specified.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: He announces the last number has come: this is one, this is two.

hindi: यह भी शुक्र का आ गया चंद्रमा उच्च का है चांदी रखेंगे तो अष्टम भाव प्रोटेक्ट करना पड़ेगा लेकिन य चांदी रखने से जबरदस्त रिश्ते चलेंगे और जबरदस्त तरीके से आपके जीवन के अंदर कैश बढ़ेगा
says: This sign, number two (Taurus), is also Venus's and the Moon is exalted in it; if you keep silver you must protect the 8th house, but silver makes relationships run very well and brings a big growth of cash.
cells_derived_method: Moon exalted in Taurus is strong in kendras and trikonas; the same Moon in the 8th or 12th from the lagna in Taurus would be exalted but in a dusthana, which is why the 8th house needs protection.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Moon exalted in the 2nd in Taurus (lagna Aries) gives wealth and sweet speech; silver supports it.
Derived, not said by him: Moon exalted in the 8th in Taurus (lagna Libra) is strong but in the house of hidden loss, so the 8th needs shielding.

ambiguity: Number one or two is unclear from the caption; Venus's sign with Moon exalted is Taurus. 'Protect the 8th house' presumably from the zone's own 8th, which is not specified.
classical_check: Moon exalted in Taurus and Venus as lord agree; silver for cash growth is a remedy claim.

hindi: अब यही सारी बातें हम रिश्तों पर लगा लेंगे तो रिश्तेदारों को क्या देना है यहां रिश्तेदारों को आप उसी राशि के अनुसार काली चीज सफेद चीज लकड़ी का गिफ्ट आइटम लोहे का मेटल का गिफ्ट आइटम दे सकते हैं
says: Now apply all these item rules to relationships: what to give relatives depends on the same sign zone; you can give them black or white things, wooden or iron gift items according to what suits that sign.
cells_derived_method: Gift choice follows the sign-zone item table: for example, Libra allows iron and no wood, Leo allows wood and no iron, Cancer wants silver and no clay.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: for a Libra-zone relative, an iron gift is suitable and a wooden one is not.
Derived, not said by him: for a Leo-zone relative a wooden gift is suitable and an iron one is not.
Derived, not said by him: for a Cancer-zone relative a silver gift is suitable and a clay pot is not.

ambiguity: How the relative's zone is chosen (their lagna or Moon sign) is not stated.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: उसी प्रकार से आप उनको कैश दे सकते हैं या नहीं दे सकते हैं सोना दे सकते हैं चांदी दे सकते हैं आप अपने जानकारों को सोने चांदी के सिक्के बांटते रहते हैं
says: Similarly the same table says whether you can give a relative cash, gold or silver; you may give gold or silver coins to acquaintances.
ambiguity: Whether gifts to acquaintances follow the same table is unclear.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ये मित्र रिलेशनशिप्स है ये फैमिली रिलेशनशिप्स है फैमिली रिलेशनशिप्स को अगर आप ऐसे दे देते तो पंगा पड़ता है
says: He separates friend relationships from family ones: the rule is for family relationships, and if you give to family without following the table you get trouble.
ambiguity: Friends versus family distinction is a new point; why family is more sensitive is not given.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Sentence beginning 'number twelve sign, suppose twelve is Mercury, Mercury' is cut off at the end of the slice.

hindi: नीच और बुध के पास सारा रुपया है यहीं पर आपके वर्कर्स भी है हेल्प आपकी काम वाली है
says: Continuing number twelve (Pisces): Mercury is debilitated here and Mercury holds all the rupees (cash); your workers and domestic help also come from this zone.
cells_derived_method: Mercury debilitated in Pisces is weak for trade and calculation, strongest effect in the 2nd, 10th and 11th (money and work); in the 12th it points to expenses and foreign dealings, in the 6th to servants and employees.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Mercury debilitated in the 2nd in Pisces (lagna Aquarius) gives cash that slips away through vague speech and loose accounts.
Derived, not said by him: Mercury debilitated in the 6th in Pisces (lagna Libra) makes workers unreliable and disputes over paperwork.
Derived, not said by him: Mercury debilitated in the 12th in Pisces (lagna Aries) gives leakage of cash through hidden expenses.

ambiguity: The sentence continues from the cut-off line 'number twelve is Mercury' in the earlier chunk; the caption says debilitated (नीच) and that matches Pisces. Servants and workers are classically the 6th, so linking them to number twelve is his own.
classical_check: Mercury is debilitated in Pisces classically; Mercury as the karaka of money and trade agrees; servants in the 6th, not the 12th.

hindi: अगर सैलरी के अलावा आपने उसको कुछ एक रुपया भी दे दिया रुपया कागज नोट तो अगले दिन से छुट्टी प हो जाएगी हरे रंग का कोई सूट दे दिया वो आएगी नहीं
says: If you give the maid even one rupee beyond her salary, in paper note form, she will take leave from the next day; if you give her a green suit she will stop coming. Paper cash and green are Mercury items and go wrong in this zone.
ambiguity: Whether the rule needs a debilitated Mercury in the maid's or the employer's chart is not stated; 'number twelve zone' is carried over.
classical_check: Classical texts silent; Lal Kitab style behavioural rule.

hindi: मैं इसको साड़ी दिलाई थी य नहीं आती बहन उसम हरा रंग था और कैश रखा था ने हैंड टू हैंड दिया था तो कैसे दो यू रख दो वो खुद उठा ले देना है कला है
says: Complaint example: I gave her a saree and she no longer comes, because it had green and I handed cash hand to hand; so the way to give is to put the item down and let her pick it up herself, which is an art.
ambiguity: Mimics a client; the reason for not handing over directly is not stated.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपको अपने फैमिली रिलेटिव्स को रुपया कैश नहीं देना है चीज्जी दे सकते हो क्योंकि पैसा जो है फ्री एनर्जी है वह कन्वर्टेबल्स है
says: Do not give family relatives rupee cash; give them things instead, because money is free energy that is convertible, so it carries your energy into them.
ambiguity: Not clear if limited to this zone or general for family.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Nikhil told him they were doing a class on donation but entered money; he says the next half will be about donation, and that it is unpredictable where things start.
Nikhil said to apologise today for repeatedly saying throw the money, so the meaning behind it should also be known.

hindi: पैसे फेंक के आने का भाव समझने का मतलब यह है कि आप बिल्कुल उससे कुछ दे सकते हैं तो वो औकात गलती से भी ना सोचे यानी कि छोड़ आए और भूल गए ये सोच के चलना कि फेंक दिया तो हाथ के मैल जैसी बात हुई
says: The meaning of throwing money is that you give and never think you have any standing as the giver; leave it and forget, and think of it as the dirt of your hand, nothing to hold on to.
ambiguity: Clarifies that throw means detachment, not disrespect.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical ideal of detached giving.

gist: Apologises on a personal level if anyone's religious feelings were hurt by the word throw.

hindi: आपको धन देकर आना है तो यह सोचना नहीं कि मैंने दिया मैं कोई देने वाला हूं लेने वाले की कृपा अगर ले भी लेता है यह गुप्त धन देने की बात हुई
says: When you go to donate do not think I gave or I am the giver; it is the receiver's grace that he takes it at all, and that is the point of secret giving.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Classical ethics agree: giving without ego.

gist: Wordplay: donation becomes two nations joining, mine and the one above, and joining himself to the divine, white matter.
People ask him to do this class or that one; he says donation is not within your own power and only the other one makes it happen.

hindi: यह हमारा धर्म स्थान है जहां से हमने शुरुआत की थी बात ... यह धर्म स्थान है यानी कि आपको अपने धर्म स्थान में आपके टीले वाले बाबा हैं आपके पूजा पाठ के लिए कोई आपने छोटा सा सड़क के किनारे नुकड़ का मंदिर बना रखा है
says: The place of worship (dharma sthan) is the starting point of the discussion; it is whatever your own religious place is, from a baba on a mound to a small roadside corner shrine you have made for your puja.
ambiguity: He calls it dharma sthan, which in Jyotish is the 9th house; he links the 9th later in the next chunk.
classical_check: Agrees: the 9th house is dharma bhava.

gist: Refers back to the retrograde planets class where they got derailed, and jokes Karan Arjun will come after two classes.

hindi: आप किसी प्रकार से गुरुद्वारे जाते हैं मंदिर जाते हैं किसी भी छोटे मोटे कोने पर लगे पत्थर जो देवता का नाम भी आप ही जानते हो अगर आप अपने कुल देवता के मंदिर जा रहे हो तो वह भी आपका धर्म स्थान माना जाएगा
says: A gurudwara, a temple, even a stone at a small corner whose deity only you know, or your family deity's temple, all count as your dharma sthan.
ambiguity: Wide definition of a place of worship.
classical_check: Agrees with the 9th as place of worship.

hindi: धर्म स्थान में जो भी ग्रह की राशि पड़ी है उस ग्रह की राशि का सामान आपके हाथ से टच होकर जाता है तो वो आपके नाइन हाउस में पावर भरता है
says: Whichever planet's sign falls on the dharma sthan (the 9th house), if you donate goods of that sign's planet that have first touched your own hand, it fills power into your 9th house.
cells_derived_method: Take the sign in the 9th house of the chart (lagna sign plus eight), find its ruling planet, and donate that planet's items; the planet changes with every lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Aries in the 9th (lagna Leo), so Mars items are donated.
Derived, not said by him: Taurus in the 9th (lagna Virgo), so Venus items are donated.
Derived, not said by him: Pisces in the 9th (lagna Cancer), so Jupiter items are donated.
Derived, not said by him: Sagittarius in the 9th (lagna Aries), so Jupiter items are donated.

ambiguity: He says sign number (1, 8 etc.) in the following sentences, so 'the sign in the 9th house' is an inference; it could also be the sign numbers of a sign diagram.
classical_check: Classical remedy: donate items of the 9th lord or the planet involved; partly agrees. Use of the sign's own lord matches.

hindi: इसलिए आप यहां पर एक नंबर मंगल की चीजें देते हैं अगर एक नंबर है तो मंगल की चीज दे सकते हैं आप मीठा लाल लाल शकर पारे लाल गुलाब जामुन
says: So if it is number one (Aries) you give Mars's things: sweets that are red, red shakarpara and red gulab jamun.
cells_derived_method: Aries in the 9th means lagna Leo; Mars is then the lord of the 4th and 9th, a yogakaraka, so Mars items help luck. Other sign cases follow the lord of the sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Aries in the 9th (lagna Leo) makes Mars the 4th and 9th lord, so red sweets given at the dharma sthan support fortune.

ambiguity: 'Number one' as sign Aries in the 9th house is inferred.
classical_check: Mars's colour red and sweets for Mars are common remedy items; agrees with remedy lists.

hindi: काला गुलाब जामुन नहीं किसी हालत में नहीं इस एक नंबर से नौ नंबर यहां पर एक्टिवेट होता है तो यहां पीला भी दे सकते हैं आप पीले रंग का शकरपारा भी दे सकते हैं पीले लड्डू दे सकते हैं
says: Not the black gulab jamun in any condition, because black is Saturn's and clashes with Mars; from number one the number nine (Sagittarius, Jupiter's sign) gets activated, so yellow items such as yellow shakarpara and yellow laddu may also be given.
cells_derived_method: Aries and Sagittarius are in trine (1st and 9th from each other), so Jupiter's signs support Mars's sign; Saturn is debilitated in Aries so black items are excluded.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Aries in the 9th (lagna Leo) is supported by Jupiter as 5th lord and yellow gifts also feed it.
Derived, not said by him: Aries lagna with Saturn debilitated in the 1st would make black items hard on the person, so they are avoided.

ambiguity: Whether 'nine activated' means the sign Sagittarius or the 9th house is not clear.
classical_check: Mars and Jupiter are friends classically; Saturn is Mars's enemy; agrees.

gist: He says whether the signs there are nine, ten or eight is a secondary subject he will take up when they reach degrees.
He says this is a broad grasp for now and the syllabus will become more complicated gradually, step by step.

hindi: यहां पर आप सर्वोत्तम दान होता है यदि यहां पर एक नंबर है के सोना दान कर दो किसी भी धर्म स्थान में गुरुद्वारे में देना भी इसलिए अच्छा है
says: The best donation, if the number is one (Aries), is gold, given at any place of worship; giving at a gurudwara is also good.
ambiguity: Gold is a Jupiter metal, linked via the activated number nine. Gold donation is a financial act; recorded only as his tradition claim, not advice.
classical_check: Gold donation for Jupiter is classical.

hindi: गुरुद्वारे में रहता है मंदिर में यूज हो जाए तो बहुत अच्छा क्योंकि हमारे यहां मंदिरों का उस प्रकार का उत्थान नहीं है इसलिए हो सकता है कार्य करने वाले मजबूर हो कि वही रखें यूज करें पर दान दान है
says: A gurudwara uses what it receives for its langar, which is why it is good; temples may not use gifts well and the staff may keep them, but a donation is still a donation.
ambiguity: Comparison of gurudwara and temples is his opinion.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जिसे हम फेंक के आए बोलते हैं कि बाद में हमने पूछा भी नहीं किसका था क्या किया पंडित जी ने अपनी बेटी के विवाह में लगा दिया बहुत अच्छा किया कोई फर्क नहीं है आपका काम देना था उसकी नजर रखना नहीं
says: The throw-it kind of donation means not asking later whose it was or what was done; if the priest used it for his daughter's wedding that is fine; your job was to give, not to watch it.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Agrees with the detached-giving ideal.

hindi: हम संतान पैदा करते हैं उसके बाद सारा दिन खून पीते रहे कि संतान ने क्या किया उससे नहीं चलेगा ध्यान रख सकते हैं आगे उसका भाग्य ये एक नंबर में मंगल की चीज दान की जा सकती है
says: Like parents who bear a child and then nag it all day, watching what the donation did will not work; you may keep awareness while its fortune unfolds; in number one, Mars's items can be donated.
ambiguity: Combines a parenting analogy with a restatement of the Mars donation.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: शनि का काम नहीं हो सकता चंद्रमा का काम नहीं हो सकता एक नंबर राशि में नेगेटिव फल देगा
says: In number one (Aries) Saturn's and the Moon's donation cannot be done; they give a negative result in this sign. Saturn is debilitated in Aries and the Moon is a neutral or unsupportive planet to Mars.
cells_derived_method: Saturn debilitated in Aries is weak everywhere, worst in the 1st, 7th, 10th; the Moon's donation clashes in the Aries zone because the Moon is not strong there either.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Saturn debilitated in the 10th in Aries (lagna Cancer) weakens work and authority, so Saturn donations here do not help.
Derived, not said by him: Saturn debilitated in the 9th in Aries (lagna Leo) would weaken fortune, so Saturn items are avoided in dharma matters.

ambiguity: Why the Moon is negative in Aries is not given; Moon has no debility in Aries.
classical_check: Saturn debilitated in Aries is classical; the Moon claim is his own.

hindi: चंद्रमा अगर आपने यहां पर चावल दिया दूध दिया पानी दिया सफेद वस्त्र दिया कि जी हम सफेद चादर दे देते हैं मंदिर में आपकी जिंदगी नर्क है चांदी दे देते हैं नर्क है
says: If you give rice, milk, water, white cloth, a white sheet or silver (Moon's items) at the temple in this zone, your life becomes hell; Moon donations are harmful here.
ambiguity: A very strong prediction; applies only to the Aries and Scorpio zones as he goes on to say.
classical_check: Classically Moon items are donated to pacify a weak Moon; he states the opposite for this zone.

hindi: चंद्रमा आपके शरीर के लिंफ को खत्म कर देगा डब्ल्यूबीसी का सबसे बड़ी प्रॉब्लम आएगी घुटने बोल जाएंगे आपके शनि महाराज यह हड्डी पकड़ता है बाया घुटना भी है यह स्पेसिफिक आएगा
says: The Moon will destroy your lymph, with a big white-blood-cell problem, and your knees will give way as Saturn holds the bones, the left knee in particular. Health predictions recorded only as his tradition claim, not diagnosis.
ambiguity: Medical claims, unvalidated.
classical_check: Classical body mapping gives bones and knees to Saturn and fluids to Moon; the specific harm is his.

hindi: खास तौर से सिक्का तेल का दान बिल्कुल ना करें शिव और शनि की पूजा ना करें ये शिव है ये शनि है
says: In this zone never donate lead or oil, and do not worship Shiva or Saturn; he names Shiva and Saturn as the offerings to avoid.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Contradicts common advice of Saturn oil donations and Shiva worship for Saturn troubles; for a debilitated Saturn many texts do advise donation.

hindi: यहां पर यदि आठ नंबर राशि होगी तो भी आपका यही कार्यक्रम चलेगा आठ नंबर में भी चंद्रमा और शनि की पूजा नहीं की जा सकती इनका दान नहीं हो सकता
says: If number eight (Scorpio) is the sign at the dharma sthan the same rules apply: Moon and Saturn cannot be worshipped and their items cannot be donated.
cells_derived_method: Scorpio in the 9th means lagna Pisces, where the Moon is 5th lord but debilitated in Scorpio; so the Moon's donation is avoided and Mars-Jupiter items suit.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Scorpio in the 9th (lagna Pisces) has Moon debilitated, so Moon donations are avoided.

ambiguity: Number eight is the sign Scorpio, Mars's second sign; carries over from the previous rules.
classical_check: Moon debilitated in Scorpio agrees; the donation ban is his own.

hindi: इसलिए जो हर कोई बैठा होता है ना हम तो शनि का तेल चढ़ा रहे तेल चढ़ा रहे हैं ऐसी की तैसी हो जाती है जिंदगी नर्क हो जाती है यह रुकावट आनी शुरू हो जाती है भाग्य आपका अटकना शुरू हो जाता है
says: That is why those who are offering Saturn's oil at Saturn temples ruin their lives when the sign is Aries or Scorpio at the dharma sthan; obstacles begin and fortune gets stuck.
ambiguity: Sweeping statement about a common practice.
classical_check: Opposite of the common Saturn remedy; contradicts general practice.

hindi: आपने दान दान किया है डोनेशन की है भाग्य का ही रुकावट आनी शुरू हो जाएगी
says: Even though you made a donation, the wrong donation will begin to block your fortune itself; the harm falls on the 9th house, bhagya.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Agrees that the 9th is fortune; a wrong donation causing obstruction is his.

hindi: इसलिए किसी हालत में भी सिक्का तेल का शनि का शिव की पूजा रुद्राभिषेक इत्यादि बिल्कुल नहीं करेंगे शिवालय नहीं जाएंगे
says: So under no condition will lead, oil, Saturn, Shiva puja, rudrabhishek and the like be done, and one will not go to a Shiva temple, for the Aries or Scorpio dharma-sthan case.
ambiguity: It is a prohibition he applies only in this specific case.
classical_check: Differs from common practice; Shiva worship is considered universally beneficial.

gist: Objection that one cannot simply stop worshipping Shiva; he says it is not like that and suggests worshipping Ganesh or Durga.

hindi: यह स्पेसिफिक केस स्पेसिफिक क्यों है क्योंकि यह बहुत डेप्थ वाली साइंस है तो बहुत ही क्लेश है इन चक्रों में नहीं पड़ना निराकार की पूजा करो जो मर्जी दो जो मर्जी करो निराकार समर्पित
says: It is a specific case because the science is deep and full of conflict; do not get into these circles, worship the formless (nirakar) and give or do as you like as an offering to the formless.
ambiguity: Advises formless worship as the safe default.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: किसको आपने जब शिव को दिया शनि मंदिर में दिया तो एक कारण बन गया यहां गुरुद्वारा शब्द स्पेशली कब है क्योंकि एक और आठ नंबर राशि है बृहस्पति बृहस्पति होता है गुरु बृहस्पति का मित्र ग्रह है
says: When you gave to Shiva or at a Saturn temple a cause was created for the harm. A gurudwara is special for the signs one and eight (both Mars's), because Mars is a friend of Jupiter and the word guru links to Jupiter.
ambiguity: Wording is garbled but the logic is clear: guru means Jupiter and Mars is Jupiter's friend.
classical_check: Mars and Jupiter are friends classically; agrees.

hindi: अगर यहां नेगेटिव राशि होगी तो गुरुद्वारे में दान देने से रोगे क्योंकि वोह गुरु शब्द जुड़ गया है वहां दुर्गा मंदिर में खास चीज दोगे बुध की दोष आएगा तो वो नुकसान हो आपका
says: If the sign here is a negative one, donating at the gurudwara will cause or stop something because the guru word is attached; at a Durga temple giving a certain item brings a Mercury dosha and loss to you. The exact consequence is garbled.
ambiguity: The verb after gurudwara is garbled and the Durga-Mercury link is unclear; which signs count as negative is not said.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यह हो गया एक और आठ नंबर मंगल मीठा लाल शनि पीली चीज आप दान कर सकते हैं क्योंकि बृहस्पति की चीज है दोनों बृहस्पति और सूर्य दोनों के दोनों
says: Summary for signs one and eight, which are Mars's: Mars's sweet red items and yellow things can be donated because they are Jupiter's items; both Jupiter and the Sun suit these signs. A word in the caption (shani) is probably garbled.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter and the Sun are friends of Mars, so their items (yellow, gold, copper, red) are safe in both Mars signs; Saturn and the Moon items are not.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Aries in the 9th (lagna Leo), the Sun being lagna lord, so Sun and Jupiter items suit the dharma donation.
Derived, not said by him: Scorpio in the 9th (lagna Pisces), Jupiter being lagna lord, so Jupiter's yellow items suit.

ambiguity: The word 'शनि' next to Mars items is probably a caption error (perhaps सोना or 'और'), since he just banned Saturn items; flagged low-risk.
classical_check: Sun-Mars-Jupiter friendship is classical; agrees.

hindi: सूर्य दोनों लाजवाब चलेंगे पर परमानेंट जुपिटर स्थापित कर दो बृहस्पति और सूर्य सूर्य एक नंबर का हो गया
says: Either Sun option would work well, but for a lasting fix he wants Jupiter established as the anchor, paired with the Sun, with the Sun counted as the number-1 item of this remedy list.
ambiguity: 'Sun is number one' may mean Sun is first in his remedy list, or the first house/Aries; caption does not settle it.
classical_check: Classical texts treat Jupiter as the natural benefic and Sun's friend; the permanent-anchor wording is his own.

hindi: जुपिटर आपका एक पान तीनों घरों को रॉकेट की तरह बांध देगा जुपिटर रॉकेट की तरह बांध देगा
says: Jupiter's single placement/aspect ties together three houses at once, like a rocket carrying them all; he is pointing to Jupiter's 5th-7th-9th special aspects as the three houses bound.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter in house H aspects houses H+4, H+6, H+8 (5th, 7th, 9th from itself), so the three bound houses shift with H. Sign nature of the three target houses colours what gets lifted.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in own sign in house 1 binds houses 5, 7 and 9, so self, children/learning, spouse and fortune get pulled together.
Derived: Jupiter exalted in house 10 binds houses 2, 4 and 6, so career lifts family wealth, home and service/debts.

ambiguity: Caption says 'ek paan'; likely 'ek drishti' (one aspect). Whether he means all three aspects or the 3 houses of a trine is unclear.
classical_check: Agrees with Parashari special aspects of Jupiter (5, 7, 9); 'rocket' image is his.

hindi: आप गुरुद्वारे में आपकी लाइफ में मान लो यह दो प्लेनेट का हिसाब है
says: He links the Sun-plus-Jupiter pair with the gurudwara as the place for the remedy and calls this the working of two planets together.
ambiguity: Sentence is a run-on in captions; the gurudwara link is clear but the grammar around it is not.
classical_check: Silent; gurudwara as a remedy venue is a modern syncretic choice, not classical.

hindi: इसके साथ और राशि आती है एक आ गई आठ आ गई नौ नंबर भी यही करती है
says: Besides the two planets, the sign also decides the remedy: signs 1 (Aries), 8 (Scorpio) and 9 (Sagittarius) are the ones that fall in this Sun-Jupiter-Mars group and behave the same way for this remedy.
cells_derived_method: The remedy is tied to the sign, not the house, so the same gurudwara/yellow-gift advice holds in any house where these signs fall; house topic changes only what problem is being fixed.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries in house 6 puts the remedy against debts/enemy trouble.
Derived: Sagittarius in house 10 makes the same remedy serve career obstacles.

ambiguity: 'ek aa gayi aath aa gayi' could be sign numbers or house numbers; Aries=1 numbering confirmed for this series.
classical_check: Aries and Scorpio are Mars signs, Sagittarius is a Jupiter sign; grouping them is his scheme, not a classical grouping.

hindi: नौ नंबर यहां पर है मान लेते हैं नौ नंबर भी मान लो यहां पर है अगर तो यहां से एक नंबर कर देगा एक्टिवेट और यहां पांच नंबर
says: If sign 9 sits in the chart spot he marked, it activates sign 1 and sign 5 as well; this is the fire trine of Sagittarius, Aries and Leo moving together.
cells_derived_method: Trine signs 1-5-9 are the fire group; a remedy or planet in one lights the other two, and the houses they fall in depend on lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: with Aries as lagna the trine lights houses 1, 5 and 9.
Derived: Sagittarius in house 4 lights the Aries and Leo houses 8 and 12 (lagna Virgo), a heavier trine.

ambiguity: Whether he is counting signs or house positions from the sign he drew is unclear; the 1-5-9 set is a trine either way.
classical_check: Fire trine 1-5-9 is standard; the 'activation' idea is his.

gist: He changes the marker colour on the board while drawing.

hindi: आपकी लाइफ में कैसी भी कोई भी प्रॉब्लम है गुरुद्वारे जाओ सोने का टुकड़ा डाल दो बहुत भयंकर बड़ी बीमारी है बड़ी समस्या है कोर्ट कचहरी है
says: Any life problem, whether a very serious illness, a big trouble or a court case, can be handled by going to a gurudwara and putting in a small piece of gold. This is his tradition remedy only; no medical or legal claim is verified.
classical_check: Gold is Jupiter's metal in classical lists; gurudwara as venue is not classical.

hindi: गुरुद्वारे में जाकर के सोने का टुकड़ा नौ महीने तक दान करो नाइन 9 महीने तक गुरुद्वारे में सोने का
says: The gold piece must be given for nine consecutive months, not once; nine is the stated duration of the remedy.
ambiguity: Unclear whether a fresh piece is given each month or one piece offered once a month; the sentence continues into the next chunk.
classical_check: Silent; nine-month cycles are a folk number, partly tied to Jupiter's 9th-house link.

hindi: टुकड़ा दो अच्छा सोना नहीं दे सकते चलो पीतल का ताला दे दो
says: If gold cannot be given, a brass lock is the fallback gift; brass is the cheaper yellow-metal substitute for Jupiter.
classical_check: Brass as a Jupiter-type substitute for gold appears in folk remedy lists; no classical text prescribes a lock.

hindi: अगर उस ताले में लोहे का हिसाब किताब गड़बड़ है तो एक नंबर राशि होगी आठ नंबर तो नहीं दे सकते नौ में दे सकते हो
says: If the lock has an iron-related problem (iron being Saturn's matter), then for sign 1 the lock is an issue, for sign 8 it cannot be given, but for sign 9 it can.
cells_derived_method: Iron and locks are Saturn items. Where Saturn is weak or hostile in the sign (Aries, its debilitation; Scorpio, Mars-ruled enemy sign) the iron-bearing gift is avoided; in Sagittarius, Jupiter's friendly sign, it is tolerated.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries in house 3 means Saturn-type gifts weaken courage matters, so avoid the lock.
Derived: Sagittarius in house 9 keeps the brass lock acceptable because Jupiter rules the sign.

ambiguity: Caption garbled around 'lohe ka hisab kitab'; sign-by-sign verdicts (1 unclear, 8 no, 9 yes) are low-confidence readings.
classical_check: Saturn debilitates in Aries and has Mars as an enemy; consistent in outline with his verdicts, though no classical text addresses locks.

hindi: कुछ नहीं है एक राशि और है यहां 12 नंबर राशि है यहां 12 नंबर यहां आएगी तो यहां चार आ जाएगी य आठ आएगी तब भी दे सकते हैं पीतल का ताला दे दो
says: One more sign matters: sign 12 (Pisces). When 12 comes, signs 4 and 8 come with it (the water trine Pisces-Cancer-Scorpio), and in those cases too the brass lock can be given.
cells_derived_method: Water-trine signs 4-8-12 share the permission to give the brass lock; the house they fall in only changes which life area the remedy is meant to support.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pisces in house 2 uses the brass-lock gift for family and money matters.
Derived: Cancer in house 7 uses it for marriage and partnership matters.

ambiguity: He says 12 and then 4 and 8 'come'; the water trine reading is inferred. It conflicts with his earlier ban on sign 8, so treat sign 8 as unclear.
classical_check: Water trine 4-8-12 is standard; the permission claim is his and contradicts the earlier 'sign 8 cannot give' line.

hindi: कुछ नहीं आ रहा पीतल के बर्तन दे दो अच्छा कुछ नहीं हो रहा यार 9 किलो बेसन दे दो
says: If even the lock is not possible, give brass utensils; if that does not suit either, give 9 kg of gram flour (besan). It is a ladder of cheaper substitutes for the gold gift.
classical_check: Yellow grains and brass are Jupiter items in folk lists; silent in classical texts.

hindi: सर बुक्स वगर बुक्स दे सकते हैं धर्म ग्रंथ धार्मिक पुस्तक
says: Books can also be given, specifically scriptures and religious books, as a Jupiter-type donation.
classical_check: Books and scriptures are Jupiter karakas in classical texts; consistent.

hindi: न नंबर में धर्म स्थान में पैसे की हा दो 12 नंबर होगा तो कृपया कैश नहीं दे सकते
says: In the sign-9 case money can be given at the religious place, but if the sign is 12 then cash cannot be given and a material gift must be used instead.
cells_derived_method: Sagittarius allows cash donation; Pisces does not. House changes only the life area the donation protects.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sagittarius in house 5 permits a cash offering linked to children or study.
Derived: Pisces in house 11 requires a material gift instead of cash for gains-related troubles.

ambiguity: 'n number' is a garbled 'nau number'; reason for the cash ban in sign 12 is not given.
classical_check: Silent; no classical text splits cash versus kind by sign.

hindi: चने की दाल चने की दाल दे दो बेसन दे दो पीली दे दो
says: Chana dal, besan, or anything else yellow can be offered as the gift; yellow is the controlling colour, not one exact item.
classical_check: Chana dal and yellow items are Jupiter karakas in lal-kitab style lists; not in Parashara.

hindi: आटा वाइट मेंगा आटा तो आटा सूर्य का आ गया ये वाइट नहीं है आटा ऑफ वाइट कलर में आएगा ये आटा आप क्रीम कलर है बेसिकली
says: Wheat flour belongs to the Sun, not to a white (Moon) category, because flour is really off-white or cream; so flour counts as a Sun item in this remedy.
ambiguity: Caption 'mainga aata' is unclear; the main point (flour = Sun, colour cream) is clear.
classical_check: Wheat as a Sun grain is classical; the colour argument is his.

hindi: महीने तक न किलो दे दो वजन बराबर दे दो तो सर्वोत्तम अदर वाइज 9 महीने तक न
says: Giving the item for nine months in nine-kilo lots is ideal, ideally matching your own body weight; the exact weight is the best form of the remedy.
ambiguity: 'vajan barabar' could be your own weight or equal weight each time; most natural reading is each month's quantity equal to the giver's weight.
classical_check: Weight-equal donation (tula-dana) exists in puranic tradition; the nine-month cycle is his.

hindi: किलो दो अदर वाइज मिनिमम 9 किलो कुछ भी समझना है तो 900 ग्राम यह इसका टोटका है न की फिगर लेते हुए
says: Otherwise give at least 9 kg for each of the nine months; if nothing else is feasible, 900 grams is the floor. The number nine here is the folk-rite symbol, not an exact weight.
ambiguity: 900 grams versus 9 kg is a contradiction; he reconciles by calling it a totka, not a measurement.
classical_check: Silent; scaled-down quantities are folk practice.

hindi: यह आप दे सकते हैं धर्म स्थान में आपका ऑटोमेटिक यह बेटरमेंट कर देगा बेसन दे दो
says: All these gifts are given at a religious place, and the gift improves your situation on its own once given; the simplest choice remains besan.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसमें मजे की बात क्या है आप पीला मीठा दे सकते हो अगर 12 नंबर राशि और आठ नंबर है
says: Yellow sweet items are allowed as a gift when the sign is 12 (Pisces) or 8 (Scorpio); the sign decides whether sweet is safe.
cells_derived_method: Sweet is tied to Mars in his scheme; in Pisces and Scorpio that is tolerated, so sweet yellow gifts (laddoo, boondi) are allowed regardless of house; the house only sets which life area benefits.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pisces in house 4 allows yellow sweets for home and mother matters.
Derived: Scorpio in house 8 allows yellow sweets while working on hidden troubles.

classical_check: Silent; no classical text links sweet/salty gifts with sign.

hindi: मीठा मंगल होता है नमकीन नमक सूर्य है
says: In his taste scheme, sweet belongs to Mars and salty (salt) belongs to the Sun.
classical_check: Differs from classical rasa assignment: Sun is pungent and Mars bitter or hot in Jyotish texts, sweet usually goes to Venus or Jupiter; his assignment is non-classical.

hindi: अब आपकी एक नंबर राशि है अगर आप पीला नमकीन देते हो तो एक नंबर राशि में डाल दिया लेकिन यहां तीसरे घर पे इसकी दृष्टि सात नंबर राशि पर आ जाएगी
says: For sign 1 (Aries), giving yellow salty food loads the Sun element into sign 1; its effect then falls through the 3rd house and its aspect lands on sign 7, which brings the damage described next.
cells_derived_method: The salty (Sun) gift activates the Sun's seventh aspect from the house it sits in. From house 3 that aspect reaches house 9; from other houses it reaches H+6. So the damage area changes with the house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries in house 3 sends the Sun's seventh aspect to house 9, hitting fortune and father rather than courage alone.
Derived: Aries in house 7 sends the aspect to house 1, so salty gifts press on self and health.

ambiguity: He says 3rd house and sign 7, which do not match for lagna Aries; the sentence is garbled between house and sign counting.
classical_check: Sun's seventh aspect is classical; the salt-gift mechanism is not.

hindi: प्रॉब्लम क्या होगी आपके पराक्रम खत्म कर देगा भाई बहन भतीजे चाचा मामा किसी से झगड़ा करा देगा कंधे में प्रॉब्लम कर देगा कान को खराब कर देगा
says: The result of that mistake falls on third-house matters: loss of courage, quarrels with brothers, sisters, nephews, uncles and maternal uncles, trouble at the shoulder and damage to the ears. Body-part statements are his tradition claim, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: These are the classical 3rd-house topics (courage, siblings, shoulders, ears). The same Sun-salt error in another house would hurt that house's topics instead.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Gemini on house 3 makes ears, hands and sibling talk the sensitive spots.
Derived: Scorpio on house 3 makes sibling quarrels sharper and more hidden.

classical_check: Agrees with classical 3rd-house significations (siblings, courage, ears, shoulders).

hindi: तो इसलिए नमकीन नहीं दे सकते पीला
says: Because of that harm, yellow salty food is ruled out as a gift in the sign-1 case.
cells_derived_method: Same ban in every house for Aries, because it comes from the sign, not the house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries in house 1 means no salty yellow snacks to be gifted.
Derived: Aries in house 9 keeps the same ban; offer plain items.

ambiguity: Whether the ban covers only sign 1 or also other Sun-linked signs is not stated.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: पीला मीठा आप इन दोनों में दे सकते हो
says: Yellow sweets are acceptable in the two cases he named (signs 12 and 8), the opposite of the salty rule for sign 1.
cells_derived_method: Repeats the sweet allowance for Pisces and Scorpio in all houses.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pisces in house 12 allows sweets in a donation for sleep and expense troubles.
Derived: Scorpio in house 6 allows sweets in a donation for health/debt matters.

ambiguity: 'In dono' may refer to signs 12 and 8 or to sign 8 and 9.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यहां नौ नंबर राशि है अगर नौ नंबर राशि होने से आपने यहां पर पीला मीठा दिया मीठा तो चार नंबर है यहां पर मंगल एक्टिवेट हो जाएगा
says: If the sign is 9 (Sagittarius) and you gave yellow sweet, the sweet (Mars) wakes up Mars in the 4th place, which is the problem he explains next.
cells_derived_method: Sagittarius as sign 1 puts Pisces in house 4; Mars there is a mismatched activation. Same sign in another house moves where Mars is woken.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pisces in house 4 (lagna Sagittarius) is where sweet-activated Mars sits, hitting heart and home peace.
Derived: Sagittarius in house 8 (lagna Taurus) shifts the Mars activation to a different house, so tension appears in other areas.

ambiguity: 'Char number' may be house 4 or Cancer, sign 4; he says Mars activates in 4 so either reading is possible.
classical_check: Mars is exalted in Capricorn and debilitated in Cancer; sign 4 would be a weak spot for Mars, which fits his claim. The sweet-Mars link is non-classical.

hindi: मास से ज टेंशन शुरू हो जाएगी चेस्ट में प्रॉब्लम शुरू हो जाएगी
says: The Mars activation brings mental tension and chest trouble, matching 4th-house topics of heart and mind. This is his tradition claim, not a medical diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: 4th house stands for mind, heart, chest and home peace. A hot planet there raises those troubles; sign decides the style.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars debilitated in Cancer in house 4 gives the heaviest tension and home friction.
Derived: Mars exalted in Capricorn in house 4 gives drive and a sharp temper at home.

ambiguity: 'maas se ja' is garbled; read as 'mansik' (mental).
classical_check: 4th house = mind and chest is classical; Mars here is a classical Mangal dosha placement.

hindi: और मंगल चूंकि ब्लड को देखता है इसलिए ब्लड प्रेशर की शिकायत हो जाएगी एक हाई बी बीपी लो बीपी का चक्कर होता है वो अलग बात होगी
says: Mars governs blood, so the Mars activation can bring blood-pressure complaints, high or low; he calls the high/low split a separate matter. Tradition claim, not a medical diagnosis.
classical_check: Mars as blood karaka is classical; the BP link is a modern translation.

hindi: ये बी बीपी का कार्यक्रम शुरू कर देगा आपको इसलिए आप पीला मीठा पीला नमकीन देखते हैं भाड़ में गया मीठा और नमकीन आप फीका दे दो सादा सबसे आसान
says: Because both yellow sweet and yellow salty can start the BP trouble, he drops both: just give plain items with no sweet or salty taste, the easiest and safest choice.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: बेसन सबसे बढ़िया चने की दाल पीले रंग का कुछ भी दे दो नहीं तो पीले नमकीन दुनिया भर के आते हैं वोह आप दे सकते हैं यह हो गया एक नंबर
says: Plain besan is best, then chana dal, or any yellow thing; otherwise the many yellow savoury snacks are also allowed. This closes item number 1, though allowing salty snacks sits oddly with his earlier ban.
ambiguity: Contradicts the earlier salty ban unless he means the snack only for signs where salty is allowed.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: He moves on to number 2 on the board and writes it up.

hindi: दो नंबर में आपका सर्वोत्तम क्या बैठेगा दो नंबर में सर्वोत्तम बैठता है चंद्रमा
says: For number 2 (the 2nd house/sign slot), the planet that fits best for the remedy is the Moon.
cells_derived_method: House 2 is wealth, speech and family; Moon there is a food/family karaka. Sign changes Moon's strength: Taurus is exalted, Cancer own, Scorpio debilitated.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon exalted in Taurus in house 2 gives the strongest family/wealth support.
Derived: Moon in its own sign Cancer in house 2 gives steady family support.
Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in house 2 makes the same remedy riskier.

ambiguity: 'Do number' may mean house 2 or sign 2 (Taurus); Moon is exalted in sign 2, which fits either.
classical_check: Moon as 2nd-house friend/karaka for family and food is consistent with classical karakas.

hindi: चंद्रमा शिव जी है शिव मंदिर में दे जम के दूध चढ़ाओ
says: The Moon is Shiva in his scheme, so for the Moon remedy go to a Shiva temple and offer plenty of milk.
classical_check: Moon as the crescent on Shiva's head is classical symbolism; the Moon-equals-Shiva identification is devotional, not Parashari.

hindi: जितना मर्जी कोई बोले दूध बर्बाद कर रहे हो नाली में जा रहा है आप चिंता ना करें आपका दूध नाली में जा रहा है
says: Critics will say the milk is wasted down the drain; he tells the listener not to worry and carry on offering it.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: गरुण पुराण के पुराण के अनुसार तीन प्रकार के जीव है अंडज पिडज उद्ज
says: Citing the Garuda Purana, he says living beings are of three kinds: egg-born, womb-born and plant-born, as part of his argument for milk offerings.
classical_check: Differs from the usual classical list of four classes (jarayuja, andaja, svedaja, udbhija); he names three.

gist: A big controversy happened about milk being wasted and Hindus being made fools of; he complains about that campaign.
The critics' line is that the milk should instead feed a poor person with bread.

hindi: किसी गरीब को रोटी खिलाने से भी क्या नुकसान होगा कई ऐसे योग होते हैं बहुत से लोग दान करके बर्बाद हो गए
says: Even feeding a poor person bread can do harm in some yogas, and many people have been ruined by donating; so donation must match the chart, not be done blindly.
ambiguity: He does not say which yogas turn charity harmful.

gist: He asks what the Raymond owner, once worth 10000 crore and then thrown out of his house by his son, could have done wrong.

hindi: क्या हो जाता है कुछ गलत दान हो जाते कुछ गलत पंगे यह भला करने का चक्कर
says: His answer to the fall of such rich men: wrong donations and wrong involvement in 'doing good' can cause a downfall; the urge to help others can backfire.
ambiguity: It is his inference about named businessmen; no chart is shown.
classical_check: Silent; not a classical claim.

hindi: चिंता मत करो किसी को देकर पुण्य कमाएंगे नो आप कहीं हो ही नहीं कोई पुण्य नहीं कमा सकता है

hindi: ऐसे और पाप और पुण्य होता ही क्या है फील नहीं करो कोई पाप नहीं कोई पुण्य नहीं है बीच में से हट जाओ

hindi: पुण्य भी मैंने नहीं किया पाप भी मैंने नहीं किया मैं तो प्रारब्ध भोगने आया हूं जो मेरे बस कि कर जाऊंगा
says: The right attitude: I did neither merit nor sin; I came to live out my prarabdha (destined karma) and will do whatever is in my power.

hindi: और पैसे से धन को कन्वर्ट नहीं करूंगा पैसा चिजी आशीर्वाद में करूंगा एनर्जी लेवल पर करूंगा इसलिए पैसा हटा दो बीच रास्ते से पिक्चर से

ambiguity: Caption 'paisa chiji ashirvad' is rough; core idea is cash-free remedy.
classical_check: Silent; contrasts with classical hiranya-dana (gold gifts).

hindi: दो नंबर शिव शिवालय के अंदर खूब पूजा होगी
says: For number 2, the remedy is plenty of worship inside the Shiva temple; the Moon is propitiated by presence and prayer.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: खूब बैठ के शिव जी पर जल चढ़ाओ खूब शिवजी को दूध चढ़ाओ

classical_check: Rudrabhisheka with water and milk is standard devotional practice.

hindi: शिव जीी को जल की धारा प्रिय है
says: A continuous stream of water is what Shiva likes best, so water abhishek is the core offering.
classical_check: Jaladhara priya Shiva is a classical devotional line.

hindi: शिव क्या है सारे बॉडी का लिंफ वाइट ब्लड
says: He equates Shiva/Moon with the lymph and white fluid of the body, so water-type offerings match the Moon's body domain.

hindi: हमारी बॉडी में एक्चुअली खून लाल नहीं होता है वाइट खून होता है जिसके अंदर हमारे आरबीसी होते हैं इसलिए वो खून लाल दिखता है

hindi: आपके वाइट ब्लड सेल्स जो है वो आपके सोल्जर्स हैं डब्ल्यूबीसी वाइट ब्लड कॉपर सिकल्स इसमें बहुत सारे हैं जो गड़बड़ होते हैं तो प्रॉब्लम क्रिएट करते हैं

classical_check: Silent; modern anatomy mapped to a classical karaka.

hindi: सारी बॉडी में लिंफ जितना भी है वह सारा का सारा हमारा चंद्रमा के पास है इसलिए जल जल की धारा सब सर्वोत्तम शिव जी का
says: All the lymph in the body belongs to the Moon, which is why a stream of water is the best offering to Shiva; this closes his physiological argument for water abhishek.
classical_check: Moon governs fluids and lymph in classical body-part assignments; consistent.

hindi: तो यहां पर आठ बैठेगा वहा प वहा नेगेटिव हो जाएगा पराक्रम स्थान बिल्कुल बैठेगा उसका उपाय करेंगे ना अलग
says: If sign 8 sits in this number-2 slot the result turns negative (Moon's debilitation sign), and the 3rd (courage) place also gets hit; he will give a separate remedy for it.

says: Saturn gives excellent results in this slot in both signs 7 and 2, because those are Venus's signs (Libra and Taurus) and Venus is Saturn's friend.

classical_check: Saturn exalted in Libra and friendly to Venus signs; consistent.

says: The planet that gives no fault of any kind here is Venus, which is the best fit for this slot.

hindi: इसलिए आपका ये दो बनता है तो शुक्र क्या है लक्ष्मी आप लक्ष्मी की पूजा करो

hindi: उसके बाद आ गया अगला बुध रुपया चढ़ाओ न्यूट्रल है कोई लेनदेन नहीं है

hindi: फिर बृहस्पति बृहस्पति का बहुत बड़ा लफड़ा है आप यहां पर सोना नहीं दे सकते क्योंकि ये यहां से उठाकर सीधा इस वाले घर में 10 नंबर राशि एक्टिवेट होती है
says: Jupiter is the big complication: gold cannot be given in this slot because the effect jumps straight to the house holding sign 10, which gets activated.

Derived: Jupiter in Virgo in house 6 aspects house 2 with its ninth, so a gold gift acts on family and speech.

ambiguity: He says 'sign 10' and 'house' together; here house 2 and sign 2 are treated as the same slot (lagna Aries).
classical_check: Jupiter's fifth, seventh and ninth aspects are classical; Capricorn is its debilitation.

hindi: यहां से रे बृहस्पति की नौ दृष्टि बृहस्पति का समान दिया नौ अगर मंगल का दिया होता कि आपने चीनी दे दी
says: The jump happens through Jupiter's ninth aspect when a Jupiter item is given; he contrasts this with giving a Mars item such as sugar.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a Jupiter gift in house 2 sends the ninth aspect to house 10.

ambiguity: Caption jumbled around 'sama diya nau'.
classical_check: The aspect lists are classical; treating gift items as seating the planet is his method.

hindi: चीनी सफेद रंग की है शुक्र इवॉल्वड है तो चीनी का इफेक्ट यहां आएगा एक दोती च पा 6 सा आ ये आठवी दृष्टि है य नौ नंबर राशि है

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars gift from Taurus reaches Leo (4th), Scorpio (7th) and Sagittarius (8th).

hindi: नौ नंबर यहां चीनी दोगे बढ़िया है यहां से पांच नंबर आएगा ये मंगल एक्टिवेट हुआ है चा सा आ ये तीन राशिया है
says: Giving sugar here is fine because Mars's 8th aspect lands on sign 9 (Sagittarius, Jupiter's sign), and the 4th aspect reaches sign 5; Mars is awakened across its three aspect signs.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars gift from Taurus sends 8th aspect to Sagittarius (friendly) and 4th to Leo (friendly).
Derived: Mars exalted in Capricorn in house 10 gives a sugar gift broader reach to houses 1, 4 and 5.

ambiguity: Caption 'cha sa aa' = 4, 7, 8; reading of 'paanch number' as sign 5 assumed from the 4th aspect.
classical_check: Sagittarius and Leo are friendly to Mars; consistent.

hindi: अगर बृहस्पति पीली चीज दे रहे हो तो ये वाला घर एक्टिवेट होगा ये होगा ये होगा और ये वाला अब यहां नीच की दृष्टि हो जाएगी ये हाईली नेगेटिव है

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in Taurus aspects Virgo, Scorpio and Capricorn; the Capricorn aspect is the debilitated one.
Derived: Jupiter in Scorpio in house 8 aspects houses 12, 2 and 4, so no debilitation sign is hit and the verdict changes.

ambiguity: He points at the board with 'ye wala ghar'; the three houses are read from Jupiter's aspect list.

hindi: इसलिए पीली चीज आप नहीं दे सकते पीला लड्डू नहीं बेसन के लड्डू देते हैं लोग

hindi: गलती से भी नहीं देना हाईली नेगेटिव सबसे बढ़िया घी दे दो जाओ कुछ नहीं करना और पैसा दे दो

hindi: बृहस्पति हो गया शुक्र हो गया शनि हमने दे ही दिया लोहा दे सकते हो लोहे की ग्रिल लगवा दो

hindi: अच्छा यहां लोहे की ग्रिल क्यों लगा सकते हैं हम यहां पे शनि कार्पण नहीं करेगा ये एक और कहानी है

hindi: ज्योतिष का एक बहुत भयंकर और बड़ा सूत्र है शनि की तीन तीन दृष्टियां है एक नंबर सबकी होती जहा बैठा है एक तीन सा और 10

hindi: मंगल की बृहस्पति की भी तीन दृष्टियां है बृहस्पति की है एक पा सात न

hindi: मंगल की है एक चर सात आ ये अलग अलग दृष्टियां जहां बैठे हम अलग-अलग चार खानों में और नजर रखते हैं वेरी वेरी पावरफुल
says: Mars aspects the 4th, 7th and 8th from its seat; so each of these planets watches three extra houses plus its own, four boxes in all, and this is very powerful.

hindi: अब इसको एक टॉर्च की तरह मान के चलिए आप ये टॉर्च बनी हुई है और टॉर्च में से यहां से रोशनी जा रही है आगे यह रोशनी

hindi: तो यह हो गया तीसरा घर यह चौथा मान लो सातवा आठवा नौवां और दसवां ऐसे ऐसे तो शनि की दृष्टि आ रही है

hindi: यहां शनि की दृष्टि है यहां शनि यूं देखता है टेढ़ा कहते है ना टेढ़ी आख से देख रहा है शनि महाराज शनि देखता है टेढ़ा शनि की वक्र दृष्टि बहुत डेंजरस
says: Saturn looks at his target houses sideways, the famous crooked look; the saying about Saturn's vakra drishti being very dangerous comes from this slanted aspect.

hindi: ये शब्द बने हुए हैं यूं देखता है शनि की यूं बीम है इतनी बड़ी बीम तो बीच में आते आते आते काफी हल्की पड़ जाती है हल्की पड़ती है कितनी अपने से सातव घर

hindi: यह तो वन है वन नंबर सातव घर में शनि की 25 पर दृष्टि है यहां 100% पावर है शनि की यहां भी 100% पावर है और सामने वाले में 25 पर डैमेज है कोई खास है नहीं

hindi: बृहस्पति की दृष्टि पांचवे पर है बृहस्पति ने यू डाल दिया 5 सान तो बृहस्पति की बीम और ज्यादा स्ट्रांग है तो बृहस्पति ने क्या किया 100 पर पावर यहां मारी 100% पावर यहां मारी

hindi: तो इसके बीच में कहां कितनी मारी इसने इसने मार द यहां पर 50 पर ये हो गया

hindi: अब मंगल की पावर क्या है मंगल यूं गया चार और आठ अब मंगल ने म पर कितनी पावर मारी 75

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Gemini in house 3 hits houses 6 and 10 at full strength and house 9 at 75 percent.

hindi: तो हमारे पास सामने वाले घर में मंगल सबसे ज्यादा पावर फुली काम करता है 100% नहीं करता है बृहस्पति उससे कम करता है 100 नहीं करता शनि 25 पैसे करता है
says: On the house directly opposite, Mars works hardest at 75 percent, Jupiter is lower at 50 percent, and Saturn only 25 percent; none of them is at 100 percent there.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Aries in house 1 presses house 7 at 75 percent; Saturn in the same place would press at 25.
Derived: Jupiter exalted in Cancer in house 10 presses house 4 at 50 percent.

hindi: यानी कि कई जगह हम डैमेज हो लेने देते हैं ताकि बाकी जगह फायदा हो यह अलग टेक्निकल है इसकी
says: He says in a remedy we sometimes accept damage in some houses so that other houses gain; this is a separate technical subject.

classical_check: Silent.

hindi: एक्टिवेट करें केतु है केतु को य डालने से कोई लाभ नहीं है नेगेटिव कुछ नहीं होगा

hindi: गुरु के प्रति सेवा पिता के प्रति सेवा व सब चलेगा

hindi: प्रथम बार संभोग होने के पश्चात माता के अंडाणु और पुरुष पिता के शुक्राणु के साथ जुड़ने पर नाभी पर जुड़ता है जो जुड़ा आता है यहीं प्लेसेंटा बनता
says: After conception, the mother's egg joins the father's sperm and the embryo attaches at the navel, where the placenta forms; this is his own account of how the navel-link starts.
ambiguity: His embryology is loose: the cord attaches to the baby's navel, not the egg.
classical_check: Silent; a medical claim recorded as his, not verified.

hindi: है यहीं से उस बच्चे को पोषण दिया जाता है तो यहीं से पितृ जो है डीएनए सेट करते हैं नाभि से और यह नाभि ही हनुमान कॉन्शसनेस है
says: The child is nourished through the navel, so the ancestors set the DNA through it; the navel is the seat of Hanuman consciousness.
classical_check: Silent; DNA through the navel is his own explanation.

hindi: ये नाभि पर ही आपका मंगल ग्रह स्थापित है यही जठराग्नि है यहीं से जाके सब जाकर नष्ट हो जाता है
says: Your Mars is established at the navel; this is the digestive fire (jatharagni), where everything we take in gets destroyed and processed.
classical_check: Mars as fire and digestion is consistent with classical Mars significations; the navel seat is his mapping.

hindi: इस मंगल के अंतर्गत आप दारू भी डालते हैं ना यह मंगल उसे भी धो देता है लोग कहते हैं ना दारू पी यह खराब हुआ वो खराब हुआ अगर आपका मंगल पावरफुल चल रहा है
says: Even alcohol you drink falls under this Mars, which washes it out; if your Mars is powerful, the usual warnings about liquor damage do not apply as much. A tradition claim, not health advice.
classical_check: Silent; this is not a classical statement and conflicts with medical consensus.

hindi: ना भी जठराग्नि आप हर चीज को भाड़ में जाए जानते हो और निष्ठावान हो आपकी जठ रागनी गजब जलेगी और आप दारू पियो कुछ भी करो फर्क नहीं
says: If you keep your faith and stop worrying over every item, your digestive fire burns very well, and then drinking or anything else makes no difference. His claim, not medical advice.
classical_check: Silent; not a medically supported claim.

gist: He says he talks about liquor a lot, that the fight is not about liquor but about breaking very old myths.

hindi: हम कितना ही बोले दारू मत पीना पीते हैं 36000 लोग पीते हैं कम से कम उन्हें करेक्शन तो दे दो कि भैया तुम पी रहे हो तो वहम में तो ना मरो डर के पियोगे तुम्हारा लिवर पर लोड पड़ेगा
says: People will drink whatever you say, so at least give them a correction: do not drink in fear and delusion, because fear puts extra load on the liver. A tradition claim, not medical advice.
classical_check: Silent; a health claim that is his own.

hindi: और पीनी तो तुमने है तो भैया तरीके से पी जब पूर्व जन्म का संस्कार सेट होगा या कोई गुरु कृपा आएगी तुम दारू भी छोड़ दोगे
says: If you are going to drink anyway, drink in a proper way; when a past-life samskara sets in or a guru's grace arrives, you will leave liquor on your own.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: दारू पीना या ना पीना भी कोई मुद्दा नहीं है बहुत लोग ये चीज का अभिमान कर रहे हैं हम तो दारू नहीं पीते
says: Drinking or not drinking is not the real issue; many people are proud that they do not drink, which he treats as ego, not virtue.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ये कहते हैं ये बड़े गंदे कर्म कर रहे हैं गंदा कर्म कोई होता ही नहीं अच्छा कर्म कोई होता ही नहीं यदि रिजल्ट गंदा है तो कर्म गंदा है रिजल्ट अच्छा है तो कर्म अच्छा ही है
says: No act is dirty or good in itself; an act is judged only by its result: a bad result makes it a bad karma and a good result makes it a good karma.
classical_check: Consequentialist; differs from the classical dharma-based view of right and wrong action.

hindi: कृष्ण जी ने सारे टेढ़े मेढ़े तरीके से मरवाएगी बनता है जो आदमी वह सीधे रास्ते से बनता है सफल होता है

ambiguity: Caption mixes two ideas; Krishna example is clear, rest is garbled.
classical_check: Krishna's strategy in the Mahabharata is classical; the success argument is his.

hindi: बहुत बड़े पद पर जाता है नाम करता है बहुत सीधे रास्ते से बनता है 90 पर से ऊपर लोग हैं जो टेढ़े मेढ़े से ही जाते हैं
says: Very few reach a high post and fame by a straight path; over 90 percent of people who get there do so by crooked routes.
ambiguity: The 90 percent figure is his estimate, not measured.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: तुम्हारे घर की एंट्रेंस है e3 की एक जहां जयंत नाम का देवता है और वो साम दाम दंड भेद के लिए ही रिस्पांसिबल है अंधा पैसा देता है
says: If your house entrance is at E3 on the east side, the Vastu deity there is Jayant, who is responsible for using any means (saam, daam, dand, bhed) and who gives blind, unearned money.
ambiguity: 'E3' is a vastu pada label; the exact pada numbering scheme is not stated.
classical_check: Jayant is a recognised vastu devata on the east side; his 'blind money' association is not in classical texts.

hindi: आप बताओ कैसे करेंगे यह
says: He challenges the listener to say how one could manage such crooked dealing on one's own, setting up the next point.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: नाजायज काम तो परमात्मा ने और वास्तु पुरुष ने और ब्रह्मा ने किया हुआ है हमारे जीवन में डाल रखा है कि करो
says: Such unfair dealings are set up in our lives by God, the Vastu Purush and Brahma, as an instruction to carry them out; in his view they are not a personal sin.
classical_check: Contradicts classical dharma ethics; a fatalist reading.

hindi: ऐसे ही फ्री फंड में अमीर बनाते हैं साउथ के तीन डायरेक्शन मेहनत करो ना करो आपको बैठे बिठा मल्टीनेशनल में लॉटरी लगेगी
says: Three south-side directions are said to make a person rich for free: with or without effort, a windfall like a multinational job or a lottery arrives. This is a vastu claim and not financial advice.
ambiguity: Which three south pada he means is not given; 'lottery' is figurative.
classical_check: Silent in Jyotish; south-direction wealth claims differ from mainstream vastu, which prefers north for money.

hindi: एस टू डायरेक्शन से एंट्री हो ये बहुत डिफरेंट हिसाब किताब है लंबा चलता है
says: An entry from the S2 direction follows a very different calculation and lasts long; it is a stable position compared with the E3 case.
ambiguity: S2 is a vastu pada label; his meaning of 'different calculation' is not explained.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: वायलेट कलर जो है नीले से बनता है मिक्स हो ये वॉयलेट कलर में ब्लू प्लस रेड है रेड बहुत कम है
says: Violet is made by mixing blue with a very small amount of red.
ambiguity: The first words of the sentence are garbled.
classical_check: Silent; colour mixing is used as an analogy.

hindi: कम पर्पल में भी ब्लू और रेड है इसमें ब्लू बहुत कम है रेड बहुत ज्यादा है मिक्स इसमें दोनों में राहु है मंगल रेड हो गया
says: Purple also contains blue and red but with little blue and a lot of red; in both mixes Rahu is present, with Mars standing for the red.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: मंगल वायलेट में ब्लू हो गया आपका राहु अब यह राहु की प्रचुरता लेनी है वायलेट कलर लो ये धागों प आएगा काम
says: In violet the blue part is your Rahu; to get a lot of Rahu's strength, use the violet colour, which will come in the thread remedy.
classical_check: Silent; colour thread remedies are folk practice.
