He demonstrates a body gesture while the captions only show broken phrases about the throat and bending.

hindi: ये बच्चा जब पैदा होता है तो ये उकड़ होता है यहां वायलेट बना है यहां ब्लू है नीचे रेड ये गोली गठरी की तरह होता है बच्चा तो ये दोनों मिले हुए हैं
says: A newborn lies curled up like a bundle: violet at the top, blue in the middle and red at the bottom, with the colours mixed together in the body.
ambiguity: He points to body parts on himself; the mapping is read from partial captions.
classical_check: Silent; chakra colours are partly yogic, not astrological.

hindi: यहां से ही दोनों से ये कलर बने के पर्पल वगैरह वायलेट इंडिगो दोनों कलर इसी से मिले हैं जिसमें प्रचुरता में थोड़ा सा मंगल टच हो गया
says: Purple, violet and indigo all arise from this blue-red mix, and in the richer shade there is a slight touch of Mars.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जब हम कहते हैं ना मुन्ना के पास जाके डिप लेके आओ और फिर ऊपर जाओ वापिस शक्ति मुन्ना के पास ही है लाल रंग तो चाहिए बिना उसके तो ईश्वर प्राप्ति भी नहीं होगी
says: When we say go down to the base centre, take a dip and come back up, the power lies at the base; the red colour is needed, for without it even God-realisation will not happen.
ambiguity: 'Munna' is a caption error; read here as the muladhara or base centre.
classical_check: Muladhara red and kundalini at the base is standard yoga; the Mars link is his.

hindi: वही आप जो बता रहे हैं ना कि तमस चाहिए तमस तो चाहिए यह तो कहने की बात है जिनमें तमस नहीं है वह लोग बहुत जल्दी मर जाते हैं
says: Tamas is needed in life; people who have no tamas die very early, so the idea of removing all tamas is only talk.
ambiguity: A lifespan claim; no chart rule is given.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts treat tamas as a quality to reduce.

hindi: तमस तो थोड़ी चाहिए कंट्रोवर्सी की बात है विवेकानंद जी भी नॉनवेज खाते थे जब उनका मन किया छोड़ने का तो छोड़ दी कोई कसम थी क्या
says: Some tamas is needed, though it is controversial; he cites Vivekananda, who ate non-vegetarian food and gave it up when he felt like it, without any vow.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: He mocks people who dig up the 'dirty past' of saints and says he has said so much nonsense himself that he would be dug up too.

hindi: मछली खाई खाओ ना आप भी तो खाते हो क्या हो गया मछली खाना पाप है घर के नीचे सांप है यह बना रखा है
says: Eating fish is not a sin in his view; the slogan 'fish is a sin, a snake lives under the house' is just a made-up warning.
classical_check: Silent; differs from strict vegetarian dharma traditions.

hindi: ऐसे ऐसे जगह है जहा अन्य ही नहीं हो नहीं यह पाप है तो पाप ना पाप मर जाए फिर भगवान ने पैदा क्यों की फिर भगवान से पूछे
says: There are places where no grain grows, so if eating animals were a sin, those people would die; then he asks why God created the animals at all.
classical_check: Silent.

He says they will finish the question round quickly and that Rahu in number 3 is done.

hindi: यहां पर सूर्य के खराब करेगा हिसाब किताब चंद्रमा का नेगेटिव जाएगा
says: In the number-3 slot the Sun's gifts go wrong and the Moon's accounts turn negative, so avoid Sun and Moon items for this slot.
cells_derived_method: House 3 is a non-natural house for both lights; effect also depends on sign: Sun is strong in Aries and Leo, Moon in Taurus and Cancer.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun exalted in Aries in house 3 reduces the 'goes wrong' effect.
Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in house 3 makes the negative verdict worst.

classical_check: Sun in the 3rd is classically good; his 'bad' verdict is about the gift remedy, not the placement.

hindi: मंगल ओके है बुध ओके है बृहस्पति काम चला हुआ है
says: Mars is acceptable, Mercury is acceptable and Jupiter just about works in the number-3 slot.
cells_derived_method: Mars and Mercury are friendly to house 3 topics; Jupiter is a mild fit. Sign changes the result.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in own sign Scorpio in house 3 is a strong, acceptable gift.
Derived: Mercury exalted in Virgo in house 3 is the strongest acceptable case.
Derived: Jupiter in own sign Sagittarius in house 3 'just about works' with some effort.

classical_check: Silent.

hindi: शुक्र खराब है शनि जो है बहुत बढ़िया है केतु नेगेटिव है
says: Venus is bad in this slot, Saturn is very good, and Ketu is negative.
cells_derived_method: Saturn tends to do well in the 3rd (an upachaya house), Venus is weak there, and Ketu needs sign context. The sign refines each.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn exalted in Libra in house 3 is excellent, matching his 'very good'.
Derived: Saturn debilitated in Aries in house 3 weakens the 'very good' verdict.
Derived: Venus in own sign Taurus in house 3 softens 'bad' to mild.

classical_check: Saturn in the 3rd is classically good and Venus is mixed; consistent with Saturn, partly against Venus.

hindi: इसलिए गणपति की पूजा बिल्कुल नहीं कर सकता मनुष्य यहां का जो है गणेश जी के मर में जाता है गणेश जी की पूजन करता है कुछ भी गणेश संबंधित करता है वो रोएगा केतु गणेश नेगेटिव हाईली नेगेटिव
says: Because Ketu is negative here, this person must not worship Ganesh at all; any Ganesh-related puja, including visiting his temple, will make him suffer, since Ketu is Ganesh and highly negative.
cells_derived_method: The ban on Ganesh worship applies when Ketu is negative in this slot; in other houses the same deity may be fine.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Gemini on house 3 with the Ketu-negative reading bars Ganesh puja.
Derived: Ketu is a friendly planet in house 8 in classical texts, so the ban would not follow there.

ambiguity: Caption 'mar mein jata hai' read as 'mandir mein jata hai'.
classical_check: Contradicts the common classical remedy of Ganesh worship for Ketu.

hindi: इसलिए धूप बत्ती अगर मंदिर में उस आदमी ने दिया जला धूप जला रखी है बत्ती जला रखी है खून के आंसू रोएगा कि अगर बत्तियां घुमा रहा है वो रोएगा बर्बाद हो जाएगा
says: So for this person, lighting a lamp or incense at a temple, or waving lamps in aarti, will make him weep tears of blood and ruin him, because incense and lamps are Ketu items.
classical_check: Silent; contradicts mainstream puja practice.

hindi: ये वाला ब्लॉक ढूंढेंगे कहां अपनी जन्म नवं चार्ट होता है नवांश में मज जाओ नवांश भी इसी रूल प रूल यही चलेगा ये आपकी मेन लगन कुंडली कहते हैं इसको
says: We will find this block in the birth chart; the same rule also runs in the navamsha chart, while the main lagna kundli is where the principal reading is done.
cells_derived_method: The same house-sign rule applies in D9 as in D1, so each chart's cell can fire separately.
classical_check: Using navamsha for the same rule is standard; applying gift remedies in D9 is his.

hindi: ये चार्ट जो है लगन कुंडली का खेल है यहां आ गई चार नंबर चार नंबर में चंद्रमा उच्च का है खूब शिव जी की पूजा कर सकते हो
says: Moving to number 4, he says the Moon is exalted-strong there and Shiva worship can be done freely.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in own sign Cancer in house 4 is strong and supports Shiva worship.
Derived: Moon exalted in Taurus in house 4 is the classical exaltation case.
Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in house 4 turns the 'Shiva puja freely' advice shaky.

classical_check: Moon is exalted in Taurus, not Cancer; his 'uchch' for sign 4 is own-sign strength, not exaltation.

hindi: बृहस्पति लाजवाब चलता है आपका यहां
says: Jupiter works excellently for you in the number-4 slot.

says: Mars is negative in the number-4 slot; negative Mars means do not give anything sweet. The sentence is cut off at the chunk end.

hindi: सकते लाल चीज नहीं दे सकते हनुमान पूजा बिल्कुल नहीं कर सकते बर्बाद हो जाओगे आप
says: Continuing the negative-Mars case of number 4: red things cannot be given and Hanuman puja must not be done at all, or the person will be ruined. The start of the sentence is cut.

Derived: Mars exalted in Capricorn in house 4 would soften the ban.

hindi: यहां पर अगर मंगल की चीजें दान करते हैं तो लड़कियों के लिए यह कमर का एरिया है सीधा ओवरी में सिस्ट देता है और संतान बाधा कर देगा

hindi: अगर लोर साइड में मंगल की राशि एक्टिवेट है तो पाइल्स दे देगा आपको यह और नेगेटिविटी बनती है लेकिन वो थोड़ा कॉम्प्लिकेटेड है

hindi: तुलादान से इसकी पद्धति होती है पहले पूजा की जाती है तराजू में बैठ के दान होता है तराजू तुला बड़ा तराजू लेकर जाता है पंखा उतार के उसके जगह लगता है
says: Method of tula dana: worship is done first, then the donation is made with the person sitting in the balance; a big scale is brought and hung in the place of the ceiling fan.
classical_check: Classical tuladana is performed on a balance; hanging it from a fan hook is his practical adaptation.

hindi: उस पंखे के स्थान पर तराजू टांग के एक तरफ अन्न रखा जाता है एक तरफ व्यक्ति बैठता है यह पांच मिनट का काम तराजू का होता है और साजो समान जो है इसकी पूजा करते हैं विष्णु की
says: The scale is hung where the fan was, with grain on one pan and the person on the other; the weighing itself takes five minutes, and the equipment and Vishnu are worshipped around it.
ambiguity: The sentence ends at the chunk break while naming the worship of Vishnu.
classical_check: Vishnu as the presiding deity of tuladana is classical; consistent.

hindi: छोटी सी प्रतिमा लेते हैं हम सोने का टुकड़ा मात्र विष्णु रूप मानते हैं वह दान किया जाता है सामान सारा का सारा गरीबों में दान किया जाता है
says: In the donation remedy he describes, only a small gold piece or small idol is treated as the Vishnu form and given to the Brahmin; every other item of the donation set goes to poor people.
ambiguity: The planet this donation set belongs to is not named in this slice; it follows the earlier talk about the scale (tula) donation.
classical_check: Classical daan texts do prescribe gold donation to a Brahmin; splitting the goods to the poor is his practice, not a specific classical rule.

gist: Caption about the poor being those whom some unknown group is called by a garbled name (Dako or similar); cannot be read reliably.

hindi: जो पंडित जी है वो दक्षिणा और सोने का टुकड़ा ले जाते हैं जो ब्राह्मण विष्णु स्वरूप माना जाता है जो सोने का टुकड़ा मात्र बाकी वो कुछ नहीं ले जाता
says: The priest receiving the donation is regarded as Vishnu himself and may take only the dakshina fee and the gold piece; he must carry away nothing else from the donated goods.
classical_check: Silent on this exact split; classical texts only say the recipient should be a worthy Brahmin.

hindi: सामान के अंदर अगर वो भी सामान ले जा रहा है तो ब्राह्मण भी गलत चुन लिया आपने
says: If the priest also walks off with the goods of the donation, the donor has picked the wrong Brahmin and the remedy is spoilt by that choice.
classical_check: Classical texts warn against unworthy recipients (apatra daan), which fits in spirit; the exact rule is his own.

hindi: लेकिन तराजू का ही महिमा है इसमें यह टोटका तराजू का
says: The real power of this remedy lies in the balance scale (tarazu) itself; he calls it the scale totka, so the weighing is the working part of the donation.
ambiguity: Scale links to Libra and Saturn in tradition, but he does not say so in this slice.
classical_check: Tuladaan (weighing a person against grain or gold) is a classical Puranic donation; the totka label is folk usage.

gist: Garbled caption about the thing having become entangled or lost nowadays; meaning cannot be recovered.

hindi: अगर आप साउथ के कई मंदिरों में जाएंगे तो वहां पर तराजू में दान किया जाता है तुलादान वगैरह वहां भी होता है
says: He supports the scale remedy by pointing out that many South Indian temples practise tuladaan, donating by weighing on a scale, so the idea is a living tradition.
classical_check: Agrees; tulabhara is documented in temple practice in South India and in the Puranas.

gist: Someone asks which South temple is most popular for this; answer Balaji, done in many places.
Garbled caption about this being donation goods, doing it every Saturday and something about an empty stomach; sentence cannot be separated reliably.
Audience question: what if a person recites the Mahamrityunjaya mantra daily; he praises it as a lovely question.

hindi: व्यक्ति को सबसे पहले तो उस देवता का आवान आना चाहिए फिर विनियोग विनियोग आना चाहिए यह सब बड़ी टेक्निकल चीजें हैं
says: Before chanting a mantra daily the chanter must first know how to invoke the deity (avahan) and the viniyog formula; he stresses these are technical procedures, not optional extras.
classical_check: Agrees; viniyog (rishi, chhand, devata, purpose) and avahan are standard preliminaries in mantra sadhana.

hindi: देवता को बुलाओ उसे स्थापित करो
says: The deity has to be called and then installed (established) in the practitioner or the seat before the mantra work can begin.
classical_check: Agrees with avahan and pratishtha steps of puja.

hindi: आसन शुद्धि आनी चाहिए अंग नास युक्त विधि होती है अंग चार्जिंग करते हैं बॉडी की चार्जिंग की जाती है वो आनी चाहिए
says: The chanter must also know asana shuddhi (purifying the seat) and anga nyasa, which he explains as charging the body part by part before the mantra is recited.
ambiguity: Caption writes the word nyasa as nas.
classical_check: Agrees; anga nyasa and kara nyasa are classical mantra preliminaries.

hindi: फिर उस देवता को आवाज लगाओगे तब होगा जब तक देवता ऐसे ही थोड़ी सुन रहा है खड़ा कहीं भी
says: The result comes only after the deity is specifically called; he says the deity is not standing around listening to every voice, and uses the analogy of one person not answering the hundred random calls reaching him but responding to a special call or a specific notification.
ambiguity: Long phone-call analogy is merged here because it only illustrates this claim.
classical_check: Consistent with the tradition that a mantra needs proper initiation and procedure to bear fruit.

hindi: भगवान एक शक्ति है ऊर्जा केंद्र है ये तो ऊर्जा के केंद्र एक्टिवेट करने पड़ते हैं जब तक आप वो नहीं करेंगे काम नहीं होगा
says: He defines God as a power and an energy centre; such centres have to be activated through the proper method, and without that activation nothing works.
classical_check: Fits the tantric view of devata as shakti needing prana pratishtha; not a mainstream Jyotish text claim.

hindi: फिर आपने घर में वो स्टीरियो पर लगा दिया जो मंत्र है आपका
says: He implies that merely playing your mantra on a home stereo does not do the job of chanting, since the activation steps are missing; the sentence is cut off and the conclusion is inferred.
ambiguity: He does not state the verdict outright; inferred from context and from the next sentence.
classical_check: Classical texts require the sadhaka himself to recite (japa), so recordings are not equal; this is silent on partial benefit.

hindi: गायत्री मंत्र उसका एक पुरष चरण 24 लाख मंत्र का होता है अगर 24 लाख मंत्र आपने उसके जाप लिए तो
says: One full purascharana (a complete stage) of the Gayatri mantra is 24 lakh repetitions; if you complete 24 lakh japs the mantra begins to work for you.
classical_check: Agrees; Gayatri has 24 syllables and the classical purascharana is one lakh per syllable, so 24 lakh.

hindi: आपको सिद्ध होगा वह बाकी मंत्र सवा लाख में हो जाते हैं महामृतुंजय सवा लाख से पहले नहीं होता
says: After 24 lakh japs Gayatri becomes siddha for you; most other mantras are accomplished at 1.25 lakh, and Mahamrityunjaya in particular is not siddha before 1.25 lakh.
classical_check: Sava lakh for Mahamrityunjaya is a common tradition count; texts also give larger counts based on syllables (33 syllables, so 33 lakh).

hindi: कोई मंत्र 11000 में हो जाता है शनि इत्यादि के मंत्र 10 20 50 19000 कर लो हो गया
says: Some mantras become siddha at only 11,000 repetitions, and for planetary mantras like Saturn's a few thousand to about 19,000 may be enough; the numbers in the caption are garbled.
ambiguity: Caption string '10 20 50 19000' is garbled; the exact count for Saturn's mantra is unclear.
classical_check: Classical beej mantra counts for Saturn are 23,000 (kali yuga multiplier 4x), so his figure differs or is garbled.

gist: Says this is very technical and making a deity siddha is no joke.
Songs today last a week because they are made on computers, while old songs survive 40 years because real instruments put them in the air; he quotes an old song line.

hindi: साउंड से ही सारा का सारा सृष्टि बनी है ओम ओम जो कहते हैं ना ओम द प्राइमलस्टैबूसेक्स बिग बैंग ओम का मतलब है बूम
says: The whole creation was made from sound; he equates Om with the primal sound of the Big Bang, saying Om means the original boom.
ambiguity: Caption mangles an English phrase, probably 'the primal sound'.
classical_check: Nada brahma and Om as the origin of creation is Upanishadic; the Big Bang equation is his modern gloss.

hindi: सबसे पहले कोई छोटी सी चीज थी उससे बूम यूं फटा है हाइपर डेंस कुछ था जहां से सारी एनर्जी रिलीज हुई और ये कॉस्मो ब्लास्ट करके बढ़ता चला जा रहा है ग्रह बनते चले जा रहे हैं
says: He narrates creation as a tiny hyper-dense something that burst, releasing all energy in a cosmic blast, with the universe expanding and planets continuing to form from it.
classical_check: Modern cosmology language; Puranic texts describe creation from sound and bindu, which is similar in spirit only.

hindi: ये बूम ये जो साउंड है यहां से हुआ है इसीलिए हम ओम बोलते हैं
says: The sound of that first boom is the origin of Om, and that is the reason we chant Om.
classical_check: Consistent with the Upanishadic status of Om as the primal sound.

hindi: सूर्य की जो आवाज रिकॉर्ड की गई है वो बोलता ही वही ओ हमिंग साउंड है सूर्य भी यही बोलता है
says: The recorded sound of the Sun is an Om-like humming tone, which he cites as proof that the Sun itself utters Om.
ambiguity: Refers to a popular claim about NASA recordings of solar oscillations; he does not cite a source.
classical_check: Silent in classical Jyotish; a popular modern claim, not a text rule.

gist: Admits he is drifting to a different topic.
Anyone wanting to do mantra practice must be very dedicated.
Jokes that he has been teaching classes for so many years he looks older than his age.
Audience banter about formless versus form worship and keeping the wife as form.
Starts question and answer, donation-related questions first.
Audience question whether everyone can do blood donation.

hindi: मंगल का दान होता है और कौन कर सकता है यस ब्लड डोनेशन मंगल का दान है
says: Blood donation is a donation belonging to Mars, since Mars is the planet of blood.
classical_check: Mars as karaka of blood is classical; treating blood donation as a Mars daan is his extension.

hindi: यदि आपके मंगल में त्रुटि है तो मत देना चंद्रमा भी दूषित हो जाता है इसमें
says: If your Mars is flawed in the chart you should not donate blood, because the Moon (fluids, mind) also gets contaminated by the act.
cells_derived_method: Mars flaw depends on the house and sign it sits in: debilitation in Cancer, enemy signs, affliction, or lordship of dusthana houses make the flaw strong; own or exalted placement removes it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 6th house is a clear flaw, so by his rule this person should avoid donating blood.
Derived: Mars exalted in the 10th house in Capricorn is strong, so by his rule donation is not discouraged on the Mars side.

ambiguity: He does not say what counts as a flaw; the derived examples apply ordinary dignity logic.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; no classical rule on blood donation.

hindi: ये आपका 12थ हाउस से क्लियर होगा ये 12वां भाव है जहां से डोनेशन ब्लड की जा रही है जो पता नहीं कहां जा रही है
says: Whether blood donation is safe is read from the 12th house, because 12th is the house of giving away and loss, and the blood goes to an unknown place.
cells_derived_method: 12th house meaning is shaped by the sign on it: a fire or Mars-ruled sign there makes the outflow energetic, a watery sign makes it emotional, and the planets in it colour the result.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries in the 12th (lagna Taurus) puts Mars as its lord in its own sign, so blood outflow is likely tolerated well.
Derived: Scorpio in the 12th (lagna Sagittarius) is Mars-ruled but intense, so outflow indicates some strain to be checked.

ambiguity: An earlier clause garbled the 9th and 12th ('naath house'); the 12th reading is what he finally states.
classical_check: 12th as house of expenses, loss and giving is classical; the blood application is his own.

hindi: नाइंथ नहीं है धर्म स्थान है वो अलग है
says: The 9th house is not the one used here; it is the place of dharma and is a separate matter from the blood donation question.
ambiguity: Caption makes it unclear if he said 'not the ninth' or asked about it; the sense is the 9th is excluded.
classical_check: 9th as dharma sthana is classical.

hindi: यहां पर 12थ हाउस में कोई नेगेटिव कॉमिनेशन नहीं बहि नेगेटिव कॉमिनेशन हो गया मंगल महाराज रुष्ट है चंद्रमा दूषित है तो आपने ब्लड डोनेशन कर दी रो ये प्रॉब्लम हो जाएगी
says: If the 12th house has no negative combination, donating is fine; if a negative combination exists there, Mars is displeased and the Moon is spoilt, and a person who then donates blood will have problems.
cells_derived_method: A negative combination in the 12th differs by occupant and sign: malefic planets or Mars and Moon afflicted by Saturn, Rahu or Ketu there count as negative.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars exalted in Capricorn in the 12th (lagna Aquarius) is strong itself, so the donation risk depends on whether the Moon is afflicted there.
Derived: Moon in own sign Cancer in the 12th (lagna Leo) with Mars debilitated there would be a negative Mars-Moon mix, so avoid donating.

classical_check: Silent; Mars-Moon combination is the classical Chandra-Mangala yoga but not applied to donation in texts.

gist: Reads the next question: in the 9th house the KP, lagna and chalit show sign 2 while navamsa shows sign 8.

hindi: दो नंबर और आठ नंबर का कॉन्फ्लेट होगा दो नंबर शिवजी को ओके करेगी आठ नंबर शिवजी को नेगेटिव करेगी
says: When sign 2 (Taurus) and sign 8 (Scorpio) conflict on the 9th, Taurus favours Lord Shiva while Scorpio negates Shiva.
cells_derived_method: For any house, the same pair Taurus versus Scorpio is an axis of conflict; the topic of that house is supported through Taurus and spoilt through Scorpio, so the effect is a split result.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Taurus on the 9th (lagna Virgo) means the lagna and chalit side supports Shiva worship and fortune.
Derived: Scorpio on the 9th (lagna Pisces) in navamsa denies Shiva support, so the fortune side is weakened.

ambiguity: Numbers 2 and 8 are taken as sign numbers (Taurus, Scorpio); the sentence may not explain why Taurus supports Shiva.
classical_check: Silent; Shiva-sign links are his own system, not found in Parashari texts.

hindi: तो शिवजी आउट हो गए पिक्चर से अब शिव को आप पकड़ नहीं सकते क्योंकि आपके भाग्य के डीएन इन चार्ट का सत्यानाश पीट देंगे
says: With that conflict Shiva is out of the picture, so Shiva cannot be used as the remedy deity, because the opposing signs would wreck the person's fortune charts.
cells_derived_method: For another house with the same conflicting signs the deity tied to that house topic would likewise be dropped and an alternate chosen.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Shiva worship is dropped when the 9th shows Taurus in one chart and Scorpio in another, and the person is steered to another deity.

ambiguity: 'DN in chart' is garbled; probably D1 and D9 or the divisional charts.
classical_check: Silent; deity selection by sign conflict is his method.

hindi: अब ऐसे ही कारकांश है सतां श है यह सब देखेंगे तो हो गया काम
says: The same conflict check can be applied to karakamsha and other special lagnas, and if you check all of them the work is done.
ambiguity: 'Satansh' is a garbled caption word, perhaps a different divisional chart.
classical_check: Karakamsha is classical (Jaimini); the conflict method is his.

hindi: लेकिन वहां नहीं जाएंगे हम सिर्फ दो को पकड़ते हैं मेजर्ली बाकी तो प्लस माइनस होएगा साइड इफेक्ट कितना ठीक करोगे जैसे आप लिवर ठीक करते हो
says: He will not go into all those charts and holds only two major ones, since the rest is plus and minus; you cannot remove every side effect, just as fixing the liver loads other organs.
ambiguity: Which two charts count as major is not named; context suggests lagna and navamsa.
classical_check: Parashari practice prioritises D1 and D9 as well.

hindi: किडनी पर लोड मारता है किडनी हार्ट प मारती है तो बॉडी ही खुद को ठीक कर लेती है इसलिए चलता है तरीका
says: Using the body analogy, repairing one organ loads the kidney and then the heart, yet the body corrects itself, which is why the remedy method is accepted despite side effects.
ambiguity: Medical analogy only; not a medical statement.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: एट एनी गिवन टाइम हम कभी ना कभी शरीर से रिपोर्टों से बीमार होते ही है उस प्रकार गड़बड़ है ये
says: At any given time we all have some imbalance in the body, and in the same way every chart has some disorder, so a perfect remedy that touches nothing else is not expected.
ambiguity: Garbled in the middle; the sense is that imperfection is normal.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Audience asks: and what about the Moon combination?

hindi: जो आपके चंद्रमा और मंगल का कॉमिनेशन सेट बैठता है वो बैठेगा जिसके अंतर्गत आप शुक्र को कर सकते हो तो लक्ष्मी आपके लिए ओके है क्योंकि न्यूट्रल हो जाएगी आठ नंबर में लक्ष्मी
says: Whichever Moon-Mars combination fits the person, Venus (Lakshmi) can be used within it, because Venus becomes neutral and so Lakshmi is acceptable for them even with sign 8 in the picture.
cells_derived_method: Venus acts as the neutral balancer in Mars-ruled signs; the effect varies with the house Venus occupies in a Scorpio lagna-based chart.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Scorpio on the 7th (lagna Taurus) puts Mars-Moon themes in partnership, and Venus worship as Lakshmi softens the conflict.
Derived: Scorpio on the 2nd (lagna Libra) links wealth with the Mars side, and Lakshmi worship is the safe remedy by his logic.

ambiguity: Number 8 is taken as the sign Scorpio; it could also be the 8th house.
classical_check: Silent; pairing Venus with Lakshmi is traditional, the neutralising logic is his.

hindi: यह देखना यह समझदारी लानी है अब यहां एक नंबर होगा दो होगा तीन होगा आठ होगा अब ये चार के कॉमिनेशन से देखना है
says: You must learn to check the options using the four numbers 1, 2, 3 and 8 here and look at the combinations among these four signs to choose the remedy deity.
cells_derived_method: For each house the topic in that house is judged through all four signs together, so the same combination reads differently by house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: In the 9th house with Taurus present among the four, the fortune topic gets the Venus-ruled support.
Derived: In the 4th with Scorpio among the four, the home and peace topic gets the Mars-ruled intensity.

ambiguity: The numbers are assumed to be signs Aries, Taurus, Gemini, Scorpio from the earlier question; the method is not fully explained.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Says there is one more kundali he has not yet been able to discuss.

hindi: वास्तु में दिशाएं राशि के हिसाब से होती हैं यह आपने हमें वास्तु की वीडियो में बताया था
says: In vastu the directions are assigned according to the sign (rashi), as he explained in his earlier vastu video.
cells_derived_method: Each sign maps to a direction (for example Aries east, Cancer north, Libra west, Capricorn south), so the sign on a house cusp tells which direction is meant.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Libra on the 4th (lagna Cancer) brings the west direction into home matters.
Derived: Aries on the 10th (lagna Cancer) brings the east direction into career matters.

ambiguity: The listener says this; the exact sign-direction table is in the other video, not here.
classical_check: Sign-direction mapping (Aries east, Cancer north, Libra west, Capricorn south) is classical.

hindi: यहां पर हम भाव के हिसाब से वास्तु की दिशाओं को एस्ट्रो वास्तु है ये अलग नई लाइन है तो राशि के हिसाब से भी होती है और भाव के हिसाब से भी
says: Astro-vastu is a separate new line in which directions are also assigned by house, so a direction can be read both by sign and by house.
cells_derived_method: Each house number maps to a direction in the chart, so the same direction can be shown by sign and by house which may disagree, and the 12 x 12 cell decides which is stronger.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries lagna gives east by sign and the 1st house gives its own house direction, which here agree.
Derived: Cancer on the 7th (lagna Capricorn) gives north by sign while the 7th house suggests west, so the two methods disagree.

ambiguity: He does not give the house-direction table in this slice.
classical_check: House directions (1st east, 4th north, 7th west, 10th south) exist in classical vastu-jyotish.

gist: Garbled closing caption about rotating many kundalis, fixing the lagna, number 3 and degrees only.

hindi: यह तीन डिग्री का है 3 डिग्री के पहले 30 डिग्री टोटल है इस लगन में 30 तो नहीं होती है मोटे तौर पर 30 लेकर चल रहे हैं यानी 3 डिग्री य 27 डिग्री कोई और है तो 27 डिग्री कौन सा है जमीनी के पीछे आएगा दो नंबर
says: A lagna sitting at only 3 degrees of its sign means that, out of the roughly 30 degrees of the first house, only 3 degrees belong to that sign and the remaining 27 degrees fall in the sign just before it; here sign 3 (Gemini) at 3 degrees leaves 27 degrees with sign 2 (Taurus).
cells_derived_method: For any lagna degree d in sign S, the first house is shared between S (d degrees) and the previous sign (30 minus d degrees); a low degree makes the previous sign dominant and a degree near 30 makes the lagna sign dominant. Shifts of other houses follow the same split.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna at 3 degrees Leo gives Leo only 3 degrees of the first house, while Cancer holds 27 degrees, so the Moon's sign colours the self more than the Sun's.
Derived: lagna at 28 degrees Libra puts nearly the whole first house in Libra and only a sliver in Virgo, so Venus's sign dominates the body and self.
Derived: with lagna at 3 degrees Gemini the seventh house opposite is at 3 degrees Sagittarius, so Scorpio gets 27 degrees of the partnership house and Mars's sign dominates it.

ambiguity: He says 'behind Gemini comes number 2', which only works if the house span is counted from the lagna degree to the next sign cusp backwards; the exact bhava rule he uses (equal from lagna degree, or midpoint) is not stated.
classical_check: Differs from plain Parashari whole-sign houses; it matches bhava chalit with equal division from the lagna degree, which splits the house across two signs.

hindi: दो नंबर ऑन है इसका दो नंबर की लगन ऑन है अब ये जो हमने अपने जीवन में देखा है कि भैया दो नंबर की कुंडली और बनेगी
says: Because sign 2 holds 27 degrees of the first house, a sign-2 lagna is also switched on for this person, so a second chart with Taurus as lagna must be built and read next to the main Gemini-lagna chart; he says he arrived at this from his own experience.
cells_derived_method: Whenever the lagna splits between two signs, both signs act as lagna and each needs its own full chart; the houses of the second chart are the same planets shifted one sign back, so every planet changes house between the two charts.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for a person with Gemini lagna the Moon in Cancer sits in the 2nd house, but the shifted Taurus-lagna chart puts the same Moon in Cancer in the 3rd house, so the same Moon is read as speech and wealth in one chart and effort and siblings in the other.
Derived: Saturn in Aquarius is in the 9th house from a Gemini lagna but the 10th house from a Taurus lagna, so luck and career both claim the same planet.

ambiguity: 'Sign 2 lagna is on' is garbled; taken to mean the Taurus lagna becomes active.
classical_check: Silent in Parashari; the idea of reading both lagnas when a lagna is close to a cusp resembles bhava chalit practice but he builds a full second chart, which is his own method.

hindi: यह कुंडलियां तीन नंबर का लगन है जुपिटर केतु चंद्रमा यहां है बुध शुक्र और सूर्य यहां है
says: Describing the worked chart: lagna is sign 3 (Gemini), Jupiter, Ketu and Moon sit together in one house, and Mercury, Venus and Sun sit together in another house; the caption gives positions only by pointing.
ambiguity: Houses of the two planet groups are not spoken, only gestured ('here'), so they cannot be recovered from the caption.
classical_check: Case data only; nothing for a classical text to confirm.

hindi: अब यह बुध शुक्र सूर्य केपी चार्ट में बुध रह गया सूर्य और शुक्र बदल गए प्लूटो महाराज यहां यही है ये तीन यहीं है यहीं है राहु तो यानी कि य दो ग्रह इसमें बदल गए
says: In the KP chart Mercury stays in the same place as in the lagna chart, but Sun and Venus change their houses, while Pluto and Rahu stay unchanged; so two planets are different in the KP version of the chart.
cells_derived_method: A planet near the end of a sign shifts to the next house in KP (cusp-based houses) while one near the start stays; which planets shift depends on its degree and the house cusps.
ambiguity: Which house the Sun and Venus move to is not stated.
classical_check: KP uses Placidus-type cusps, so planets do change house versus whole-sign; the specific case is his data.

hindi: अब नवांश कुंडली में एक अलग कहानी बदल गई तीन नंबर लगन था आठ हो गया
says: In the navamsa (D9) chart the story changes again: the lagna that was sign 3 (Gemini) becomes sign 8 (Scorpio), so the same person has a Scorpio-lagna D9.
classical_check: A D9 lagna depends on the exact degree, so this is checkable: Gemini lagna at 3 degrees is in the Gemini navamsa 1, the Libra-start group, giving Libra, not Scorpio, if the lagna is at 3 degrees; his 3 degrees may be a different degree or approximate.

gist: Asks aloud what happened in the chalit chart.

hindi: चलित में भी एक कहानी बदल गई है यस चलित हैज डन व्ट चलित में चंद्रमा पांच आ गया यहां बुद्ध है
says: Bhava chalit changes the story too: in the chalit chart the Moon has moved into a house numbered 5 and Mercury is placed in a particular house, so chalit differs from the rashi chart.
cells_derived_method: A planet within a few degrees of a house boundary moves to the adjacent house in chalit; the changed house then changes the house topics the planet shows.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: if the Moon, rashi-wise in Cancer in the 4th house of a Gemini lagna, moves to the 5th house in chalit then the Moon's effects shift from home and mother to intellect and children.

ambiguity: 'Number 5' may be the sign or the house; he also says Mercury is 'here' by pointing.
classical_check: Chalit shifts of planets across house boundaries are standard practice.

hindi: अब हम क्या करेंगे अपनी खोपड़ी से जो अच्छी बनने के बाद अभी नवा छुप गया कोई नहीं हम लगन केय तीन ग्रह भी कंसीडर करेंगे
says: After the main chart is made, even if the navamsa gets left out, he will also consider the three planets associated with the lagna in the other charts, so the planets near the lagna are always brought into the reading.
ambiguity: Garbled; 'three planets of the lagna' is a guess, because the caption splits the words unclearly.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Back and forth with an audience member about whether a sign is number 5 or 6 in the lagna, KP and chalit; numbers cannot be separated reliably.

hindi: प्लूटो यहां चला गया प्लूटो यहां खिचड़ी सी हो गई पता नहीं कितने लोग प चलित में तीन तीन हो गए हैं
says: Pluto changes house between charts, and since several planets now move house between the rashi, KP and chalit charts, the picture becomes a khichdi (a muddle) of planets with three in some houses.
ambiguity: Which houses Pluto moves between is not clear in the caption.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अबे खिचड़ी हो गई दिमाग खराब हो जाएगा कितना देखे तो ये शार्पनेस डेवलप करने लायक हालत जब हो जाएगी तब होगा
says: Looking at so many charts overwhelms the mind, so the ability to read this must be developed gradually; he says the sharpness to handle it comes only after enough practice.
classical_check: Silent; a comment on practice, not a rule.

hindi: अब उसके बाद आ गई एक और कुंडली अब यह जो हमारी अपनी फालतू की इजाद है जो हमने जीवन में समय के साथ सीखा आप इसकी प्रेडिक्शन देते रहो
says: After those charts, one more chart appears, and he calls this his own so-called useless invention that he learned over time in life; he tells listeners to keep giving predictions with it.
ambiguity: He is self-deprecating; 'useless' is a figure of speech, and the sentence does not say what the extra chart is until the next row.
classical_check: The extra shifted chart is his own method, not from a classical text.

hindi: जैसे यह कुंडली कहती है इसकी पढ़ाई में एक साल वेस्ट होगा यहां कंफर्म हो गया प्लूटो है एक कोर्स करेगा एक्स्ट्रा
says: Reading the extra chart, he predicts the person will waste one year in studies, confirms it through Pluto's placement, and says the person will do one extra course.
cells_derived_method: Study-related houses are the 4th (basic education), 5th (intelligence, higher studies) and 9th; Pluto, as an outer planet with delays and reversals, in or lording these houses brings a lost year; the sign it sits in sets the field.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in Scorpio in the 5th (lagna Cancer) is in its own-type sign with the education house, so a break or repeat in studies is read from this.
Derived: Pluto in Capricorn in the 4th (lagna Libra) touches the basic-education house, so early schooling is delayed.

ambiguity: The house Pluto sits in is not named; the examples use the study houses as an assumption.
classical_check: Silent; Pluto is not used in classical Jyotish.

gist: Banter that he will go on like this, and an audience member says he should quickly do the course himself.

hindi: अब हमने वहां देखा था दो नंबर राशि एक्टिवेटेड है तो हमने क्या करना है हमने यह एक नई कुंडली का ईजाद करिए कर लिया यह हमारी कुंडली क्या कहती है जी यह कहती है कि यहां पर दो नंबर आएगा यहां तीन आएगा यहां चार पाच छ सात आठ यह पूरी की पूरी एक नई कुंडली हो गई
says: Since sign 2 was found activated, he makes a new chart in which sign 2 takes the first house, sign 3 the second, sign 4 the third and so on through 8; so every planet moves one house later, and this whole new chart is read like an extra lagna chart.
cells_derived_method: Take the original lagna chart and rotate the house numbering by one sign: each sign gets the house number one less than before, so a planet in house H moves to house H plus 1 (shifted back by one sign).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: in the new Taurus-lagna chart Gemini is the second house, so the Gemini lagna planets are read as wealth and speech planets rather than self.
Derived: Sagittarius becomes the 8th house of the Taurus-lagna chart (it was the 7th in the Gemini chart), so a planet there changes from partnership to transformation.
Derived: Aries is the 12th of the Taurus chart (it was the 11th from Gemini), so a gains planet becomes a loss planet.

ambiguity: He says 'number 2 here, 3 here, 4 5 6 7 8' but the caption cuts after 8; the full rotation is inferred.
classical_check: Silent; arudha and bhava-chalit alter houses, but shifting the entire chart by a sign is his own method.

hindi: अब यह सब भी घुमानी है अब क्या होगा अब हम देखेंगे तीन नंबर का केतु नीचे और कोई कुंडली नहीं बता रही लेकिन यह बताएगी क्योंकि दो नंबर से एक्टिवेशन हो गई थी पीछे चले गए थे भाव खिसक के
says: This new chart must also be rotated; he then reads Ketu in sign 3 in a lower position, which no other chart shows but this one does, because the activation through sign 2 pushed the houses back and so shifted the planets.
ambiguity: 'Ketu lower' is not tied to a house number; position was pointed to.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसके गले की खराबी रहेगी
says: From the shifted chart he predicts a throat problem for this person; this is a health prediction he made, not a medical finding, and should not be taken as a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: The throat is the 2nd house body part and the neck area is ruled by Taurus; a Ketu or malefic in the 2nd house or in Taurus or Gemini areas points to throat or voice trouble.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in Taurus in the 2nd house (lagna Aries) sits on the throat house and sign, so throat trouble is read here.
Derived: Ketu in Gemini in the 3rd house (lagna Aries) touches the neck and shoulders and the lung area, so neck trouble is read here.

ambiguity: He does not state which planet or placement gives the throat problem; Ketu is linked only because it was the last planet mentioned.
classical_check: 2nd house and Taurus for the throat are classical body assignments; the specific chart claim is his.

hindi: इसके सिर पर चोट का निशान आएगा आधे सिर में तकलीफ रहेगी
says: He predicts that the person will carry an injury mark on the head and have trouble in half of the head; a body-part prediction, to be treated as a claim of the speaker and not a medical statement.
cells_derived_method: The head belongs to the 1st house and Aries; a Mars or Ketu influence on the lagna or Aries marks head injury, while half-head pain is usually read from Moon or Mars on the 1st house or the 12th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a malefic in Aries on the 1st house (lagna Aries) lands directly on the head.
Derived: a malefic in Gemini in the 12th house (lagna Cancer) touches the left side of the head and the eyes through the twelfth house.

ambiguity: Planets Mars and Ketu are inferred from the head topic, not named by him.
classical_check: Head as 1st house and Aries is classical; the specific claim is his.

hindi: एक आंख का नंबर स्फेरिकल बनेगा एक का सिलेंडर
says: He predicts the eye problem will be a spherical power in one eye and a cylindrical power in the other, i.e. a different defect in each eye; this is the speaker's prediction and not a medical statement.
cells_derived_method: Eyes are the 2nd house (right) and 12th house (left); an afflicted second house points to the right eye and an afflicted twelfth to the left eye.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: an afflicted 2nd house in Libra (lagna Virgo) points to the right eye.
Derived: an afflicted 12th house in Pisces (lagna Aries) points to the left eye.

ambiguity: He gives no house or planet for the eye finding; the derived method uses the standard 2nd and 12th house split.
classical_check: 2nd and 12th houses for the eyes are classical.

hindi: कल हमने सर ये देखा था कि एक और दो नंबर काम कर रही है
says: Looking back on the previous day's case, he says signs 1 and 2 had been found to be working together, i.e. both Aries and Taurus influences were active in that chart.
ambiguity: The speaker reports a yesterday case; it may be an audience member's remark relayed by him.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: दो तीन काम कर रही थी वहां पे हां अब हमने एक कुंडली सेपरेट ही ले ली पूरी की पूरी पूरी दो ही नंबर की ये भी घुमा ली
says: In the case at hand signs 2 and 3 were working, so he takes a separate full chart based on sign 2 alone and rotates that too, as a further chart to read.
ambiguity: The sentence start belongs to the 2:18 chunk; ts is the nearest earlier stamp with content.
classical_check: Silent; this is his own multi-chart method.

gist: Jokes that he has created more mess, this one learned from experience; audience nods.

hindi: अब हमने आठ नंबर ले लिया अब यहां न नंबर का शनि था ना पहले जो था जी सर न था ना यह शादी खराब नहीं दिखाता
says: Next he takes sign 8 (Scorpio) as the active sign; earlier there was no Saturn in the relevant sign and so the earlier chart did not show a spoiled marriage.
ambiguity: The sign of Saturn is garbled ('न नंबर का शनि'); sign 8 is assumed to be Scorpio.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अब ये आठ का आ गया राशि एक्टिवेटेड है डेप्थ में नहीं जा रहा मैं सिर्फ मोटे बता रहा हूं इसका तलाक होएगा ही होएगा 100% एक्स मेरिटल कराएगा
says: With sign 8 now activated he says, in rough terms and without going deep, that this person will certainly have a divorce and will have an extra-marital relationship; he calls it 100 percent. This is the speaker's claim and not a measured accuracy.
cells_derived_method: Marriage is the 7th house; Scorpio on or touching it brings secrecy, intensity and extra-marital themes, and Scorpio on the 2nd, 8th or 12th adds family-breakup and hidden affairs. The reading changes with the house Scorpio falls on.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Scorpio on the 7th (lagna Taurus) puts Mars-ruled intensity directly on marriage, so divorce or an affair is read.
Derived: Scorpio on the 2nd (lagna Libra) hits family and the maraka side, so the family life gets strained.
Derived: Scorpio on the 12th (lagna Sagittarius) is bed pleasures and hidden relations, so secret affairs are suggested.

ambiguity: 'Number 8' could be the 8th house; sign 8 (Scorpio) is chosen because he says the sign is activated.
classical_check: Scorpio and the 8th and 12th houses signify secrecy, and malefics on the 7th harm marriage in classical texts; a '100 percent' claim has no classical basis.

gist: Says he will not say how or with whom the affair happens, that he charges 1100 for such details, and jokes that audience members are learning without being taught.

hindi: अब यहां शुक्र छह नंबर का होकर फेलियर देता था माता को तकलीफ
says: Venus placed at sign 6 (Virgo) earlier gave failure and trouble to the mother, which is the reading he gives for this chart before the change.
cells_derived_method: Venus in Virgo is debilitated, so failure in what Venus signifies is read; trouble to the mother depends on the house, being strongest on the 4th or on its lord.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: debilitated Venus in Virgo in the 4th house (lagna Gemini) damages the mother's house directly, so mother-related trouble is read.
Derived: debilitated Venus in Virgo in the 10th house (lagna Sagittarius) shows career setbacks rather than mother issues.

ambiguity: 'Number 6' may be a house; sign Virgo is chosen because Venus is debilitated there and gives failure.
classical_check: Venus debilitation in Virgo is classical; mother is the 4th house and Moon.

hindi: ये बुध उ चका था पांच नंबर ऑन हो गया सूर्य की पावर सबसे ज्यादा पकड़ गई सारे काम कर रहे हैं
says: Mercury had jumped (moved) out of its place; sign 5 (Leo) came on, and the Sun's power became the strongest as all planets are now working through it.
cells_derived_method: A Sun-ruled sign active in a chart gives the Sun priority; its house sets what gets strong, for example authority in the 10th, children in the 5th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Leo on the 5th (lagna Aries) gives the Sun its own sign in the house of intellect, so the Sun's power is strongest there.
Derived: Leo on the 10th (lagna Scorpio) puts the Sun in authority matters so career power is stressed.

ambiguity: 'उ चका था' is garbled and read as 'had jumped'.
classical_check: Sun owning Leo is classical; the power-shift logic is his.

hindi: मां मरेगी नहीं जल्दी पहले मरती बुध बचाता है
says: He claims the mother will not die soon, whereas earlier she would have, and says Mercury protects her; a longevity claim recorded as his statement and not to be used, since the engine makes no longevity or death predictions.
ambiguity: Longevity statement, flagged; not usable by the engine.
classical_check: Silent; Mercury is not a classical protector of the mother.

hindi: हालाकि यह फिर जीवित रखता है ये इस प्रकार की कहानी ऐड हो गई अब अब यह पूरी कुंडली बदल गई
says: He adds that Mercury keeps her alive, and that this type of story is now added so that the entire chart reading has changed from what was seen first.
ambiguity: Continuation of the longevity remark, so the same flag applies.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: दो नंबर का मंगल यहां होता कर्जा ही कर सकता था कॉमिनेशन एक नंबर है इस पर धरती पर जितना मर्जी पैसा कर्जा लेक फूके फिर पैसा आएगा इसे तो कर्जा लेना चाहिए
says: Mars in sign 2 (Taurus) could only have given debt, and with sign 1 the combination means he can borrow as much as he likes and spend it, after which money will come; he even says this person should take loans. This is a financial statement of the speaker and not advice to be used.
cells_derived_method: Mars in Taurus (Venus's sign, an enemy-neutral sign) works through the money house and debts; the house of Taurus decides whether loan or gain, for example 2nd house wealth, 6th house debt.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Taurus in the 6th (lagna Sagittarius) puts debt and service-type loans on Mars's work.
Derived: Mars in own sign Aries in the 11th (lagna Gemini) is gains, so borrowing leads to income.

ambiguity: Sign numbers 1 and 2 are taken as Aries and Taurus; could be houses.
classical_check: Silent on a take-loans rule; investment and loan advice is outside what the engine may output.

hindi: मंगल एक नंबर यह कुंडली और एक्टिवेट हो गई तो यह इतना लफड़े वाली कहानी है इतना सब देखने लायक आ जाएगा धीरे-धीरे आ जाएगा कुछ एक साल में आ जाता है
says: With Mars in sign 1 this chart gets even more activated, which makes for a complicated story; he says the ability to see all this comes gradually and takes about a year to develop.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Says what is the problem anyway, and lets the next audience question come.
Audience question: are there general remedies for children with autism, or only chart-based remedies.

hindi: उनके पेरेंट्स को गया चले जाना चाहिए बिना नागा बच्चों को लेकर जाए ना लेकर जाएं पितरों की कृपा लें
says: For the parents of a child with autism, he advises going to Gaya without fail, with or without the child, to obtain the ancestors' grace (pitru kripa). This is a remedy claim of the tradition and not a treatment.
ambiguity: Garbled as 'ना लेकर जाएं'; read as 'take the child or not, go anyway'.
classical_check: Gaya shraddha for pitru is classical; tying it to autism is his claim.

hindi: हर हालत में घर के अंदर साउथ वेस्ट इंप्रूव करें डब्लू व में पितरों की फोटो लगाएं गोल्डन फ्रेम के अंदर
says: In every case the south-west of the home should be improved and the ancestors' photographs placed in the west or south-west zone, in golden frames; a vastu remedy for the same concern.
ambiguity: 'डब्लू व' is garbled and could be west, south-west or west-north-west.
classical_check: South-west as the pitru direction is classical vastu.

hindi: वेस्ट नॉर्थ वेस्ट के अंदर किसी किस्म से शीशा नहीं होना चाहिए
says: There must be no mirror of any kind in the west and north-west part of the house.
ambiguity: The sentence start 'W and' is garbled, so west versus north-west is not certain.
classical_check: Mirrors in the west zone are generally discouraged in modern vastu; not a classical Jyotish text claim.

hindi: एडी एचडी की बीमारी ऑटिज्म की बीमारी ये सारी की सारी तब होती है जब वहां का स्पार्क डाउन होता है
says: He claims ADHD and autism arise when the spark (energy) of that west zone of the house is low; a vastu-link claim of the speaker, not a medical statement.
ambiguity: This is a health causation claim by the speaker, flagged as tradition only.
classical_check: Silent; no classical text links these conditions with vastu zones.

hindi: स्पार्क देने वाले देवता है वहां पर असुर देवता है डल स का उसके आगे के सारे पोर्शंस सारे के सारे खराब होते हैं
says: The deity giving the spark in that zone is the Asura devta, and the portions beyond it are all bad; the garbled word around 'Dal' prevents knowing the rest of the list.
ambiguity: Word 'डल स' is garbled; it may be a list of deities such as Shosha or Papayakshma next to Asura.
classical_check: Agrees that Asura, Shosha, Papayakshma and Roga are the vastu-purusha deities on the west side.

hindi: वहां किसी किस्म से भी रेड कलर ना हो ब्राउन कलर ना हो डीप ब्राउन ग्रीन ना हो ग्रीन नहीं हो
says: In that zone there should be no red colour, no brown, no deep brown and no green anywhere.
ambiguity: Caption repeats green twice; list read as red, brown, deep brown and green.
classical_check: Colour bans for a zone are vastu practice, not in Parashari texts.

gist: Side talk with someone who interrupts, asking to be allowed to speak.

hindi: वो सब ना हो कोई भी ऐसी ट्रायंगुलर ऑब्जेक्ट ना हो रेक्टेंगल ऑब्जेक्ट ना हो यह चीजें आपकी बचें तो आपका वह एडिशनल ऐड ऑन नहीं होगा
says: There should also be no triangular or rectangular objects there; if these are avoided, the extra add-on problem will not get added to the existing one.
classical_check: Silent in Parashari; vastu shape rules vary by school.

hindi: पाप क्म में देवता होता है वह उसके और दवाइयों को पूरे तौर पर ठीक होने नहीं देगा रोग का देवता भी वही है
says: The deity Papayakshma there will not let medicines work fully, and the deity of disease (Roga) is the same zone, so a spoilt west zone slows cure; this is his tradition claim.
ambiguity: 'पाप क्म' is read as Papayakshma.
classical_check: Papayakshma and Roga are deities of the vastu mandala, in the west side, agreeing with him.

hindi: तो यह सारे के सारे करेक्शंस चाहिए ये है मोटे तौर पे और पितृ कृपा लेनी बहुत आवश्यक है
says: All these corrections are needed, roughly speaking, and obtaining the grace of the ancestors is very necessary.
classical_check: Pitru remedies are classical.

hindi: उसके अलावा दवाई डॉक्टर का चढ़ा देना है एलोपैथ होम्योपैथ फलाना पैथ देना ही देना है
says: Alongside the remedies, medical treatment from the doctor should continue, whether allopathy, homeopathy or another, as it must be given anyway; his remedies are an addition to treatment, not a replacement.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यह गांठ बांध लो पहले से कि जीवन के अंदर य बच्चा जितना ठीक होगा उतना होगा हम इसके लिए कुटकुट के नेगेटिव वाइब्रेशन नहीं देंगे हम अपने जीवन में उस
says: Parents should accept that the child will improve only as much as is possible and should not feed negative vibrations into it by constant worry; the sentence cuts off before the end.
ambiguity: The sentence is cut off at the slice end, so the final clause is lost.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: चीज पर ज्यादा ध्यान देते हैं जो हमें नहीं मिली हमें ध्यान उस परे देना जो हमें चाहिए एनर्जी को उधर मत डालो इट इज ऑल अबाउट फ्रीक्वेंसी एंड वाइब्रेशंस नेगेटिव साइड एनर्जी मत डालो
says: People dwell on what they did not get, but attention should go to what is wanted; do not pour energy into the missing thing or the negative side, because everything is a matter of frequency and vibration.
classical_check: Silent; a general mindset claim, not a Jyotish rule.

gist: Mentions the film King Richard with Will Smith as a lovely movie and an audience member agrees.
Audience question: which direction in the house helps to resolve bone-related problems.

hindi: क्योंकि पूरा वास्तु पुरुष पूरे के पूरे शरीर के हिसाब से है अब आपका साउथ साउथ ईस्ट डिस्टर्ब होता है तो बोन रिलेटेड मसल्स रिलेटेड मास पेश रिलेटेड आपको मस्कुलर प्रॉब्लम आती है
says: There is no single direction for bone trouble because the whole Vastu Purusha maps onto the whole body; however, if the south and south-east zones of the house are disturbed, bone, muscle and muscular problems arise. This is a vastu-link claim, not a medical statement.
ambiguity: The zone he names ('south, south-east') is clear but the exact muscle versus bone link is loose.
classical_check: The Vastu Purusha body-map is classical vastu; the south-east to muscles link is his own gloss.

hindi: वो भी बोन के तौर पर लोग ट्रीट करते हैं
says: Muscular problems that come from a disturbed south-east are often treated by people as if they were bone problems, so the two are confused.
ambiguity: A remark about how people treat symptoms, not a medical statement.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Garbled caption about the Vatsa devta on the front side, the upper northern belt being disturbed, and 'some type' of problem; cannot be read.

hindi: घुटने कोनिया य थो नॉर्थ वेस्ट और साउथ ईस्ट में पड़े हुए हैं कोनिया भी और घुटने भी
says: In the Vastu Purusha body-map the knees and the elbows lie in the north-west and the south-east corners, so those zones relate to joint trouble in these parts.
ambiguity: 'कोनिया' is read as elbows.
classical_check: Agrees with the Vastu Purusha mandala, which puts knees and elbows at the NW and SE corners.

gist: Asks which bone problem it is, since saying only bone-related is not enough; the questioner says it is generic.

hindi: वो शनि का दोष है जोय बोन रिलेटेड बात कर रहे हैं मंगल शनि या सूर्य का है जो बोन की खराबी आएगी वो सूर्य के दोष से आएगी
says: Bone-related trouble in the chart is Saturn's fault, or Mars's or the Sun's; he states that actual bone damage comes from the Sun's affliction.
cells_derived_method: Sun is the bone karaka, so a Sun afflicted by Saturn, Rahu or Ketu, or placed in a debilitated sign, is read as bone trouble; the house it falls in picks the body part.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: debilitated Sun in Libra in the 6th house (lagna Taurus) shows bone trouble through the disease house.
Derived: debilitated Sun in Libra on the 1st (lagna Libra) shows weak frame and bone structure from birth.

ambiguity: The caption starts mid-sentence from the earlier chunk; the Sun for bone link is clear.
classical_check: Sun as karaka of bones is classical (Brihat Parashara); Saturn also rules bones, so he differs by giving Sun the leading role.

hindi: आएगी शनि उसके नर्व खराब करेगा वो कुंडली का कार्यक्रम है घर की बात नहीं हो रही
says: Saturn would damage the nerves; he stresses this is a matter of the birth chart and not of the house or vastu.
ambiguity: This is a health statement of the speaker, not a diagnosis.
classical_check: Saturn as karaka of nerves and chronic pain fits classical tradition.

hindi: फिर ये जो जनरिक है वो तो आपका 100% शनि और वो सूर्य का दोष है
says: For the generic bone complaint the questioner mentioned, he concludes it is fully Saturn's and the Sun's fault, 100 percent, and not a vastu matter.
ambiguity: The 100 percent figure is rhetorical and not measured.
classical_check: Silent on the percent; Saturn and Sun for bones is classical.

gist: Audience question about whether to donate for a retrograde planet (the number and phrasing are garbled).

hindi: रेट्रोग्रेड प्लेनेट थोड़े टाइम के लिए रेट्रोग्रेड होता है फिर ज्यादा सीधा हो जाता है आपको डोनेशन से मतलब है
says: A planet is retrograde only for a short time and then turns direct again, so he sets that aside and asks whether the real question is about donation as a remedy for it.
ambiguity: 'ज्यादा सीधा' is taken as 'goes direct again'.
classical_check: Planets are retrograde for a limited arc and then direct, which is astronomically correct; classical texts treat retrograde planets as strong (cheshtabala).

hindi: रेट्रोग्रेड प्लेनेट की करेक्शन के लिए आप उसका स्टोन डालो धरती पर सबसे बड़ा और सबसे बढ़िया उपाय है वो सबसे बड़ा
says: To correct a retrograde planet, wear its gemstone; he calls this the biggest and best remedy on earth.
ambiguity: Which planet is not given; the claim is for any retrograde planet.
classical_check: Gemstones are a later remedial practice, not classical Parashari; many texts also treat retrograde planets as already strong.

hindi: लेकिन आपको पता होना चाहिए कैसा किस कलर किस पोटेंसी किस क्लेरिटी कितना इंडेक्स होगा यह बहुत टेक्निकल है
says: Gemstone use needs knowledge of the right type, colour, potency, clarity and index (grade); he says it is very technical, so it cannot be done casually.
classical_check: Gem quality criteria are in gemmological texts, not Parashari Jyotish.

gist: Says last two questions; the audience says best, then someone asks what remedy helps loan approval for people in debt whose loan is not approved.

hindi: लोन अप्रूवल के लिए गाय को गुड़ खिलाना चाहिए
says: For loan approval, feed jaggery to a cow; a remedy of the tradition.
ambiguity: The Mars link is not said here but is stated in a later row (jaggery is Mars).
classical_check: Silent; feeding jaggery to cows is a folk remedy.

hindi: ये बव घर में प्लेसमेंट कर दो मंगल की और शुक्र को तो शुक्र पंप अप करता है मंगल आग लगा देता है शुक्र में एकदम से वेरी पावरफुल प्लेनेट
says: Place Mars and Venus items in the house; Venus pumps things up and Mars sets them on fire, and Venus is a very powerful planet for this, so the pair is used for the loan to come through. The object to be placed is garbled.
ambiguity: The first words (what is placed, and in which house or zone) are garbled.
classical_check: Silent; this is a vastu and planet-colour remedy of his own.

hindi: घर के नॉर्थ वेस्ट के अंदर वो पेपर्स रख दो लोन के जो हैं किसी वाइट या ब्लू बैग के
says: Keep the loan papers in the north-west zone of the house, inside a white or blue bag, which is his vastu remedy for getting a loan approved.
ambiguity: The sentence completes in the next chunk ('inside the bag the loan will be approved').
classical_check: North-west is the Vayu zone and linked with movement and change in vastu; the loan remedy is his own, not classical.

hindi: अंदर लोन अप्रूवल हो जाएगा और अगर ज्यादा हो तो जिस बैंक से कराना हो उस बैंक का जो एंबलम है ना वो रख दो उसके साथ
says: Once the papers are kept in the bag the loan will get approved, and if the loan is big, keep the emblem of the lending bank together with the papers.
classical_check: Silent; a folk remedy outside classical Jyotish.

gist: Audience question: what helps to repay a loan.

hindi: लोन उतारने के लिए आपकी कमाई अच्छी होनी चाहिए और पहला भजन ना हो और उसके लिए भी हर हालत में गौ सेवा है
says: To pay off a loan your income must be good, and for that too cow service is needed in every case; the phrase about the first bhajan is garbled.
ambiguity: 'पहला भजन ना हो' is unclear and may mean 'it should not be the first thing' or something else.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: लोन सारा मंगल के पास है और मंगल सिर्फ गौ से सेट होता है
says: All matters of loans belong to Mars, and Mars is set right only through the cow.
classical_check: Mars as karaka of debts is a modern popular view; classical texts tie debt to the 6th house and Saturn and Mars.

hindi: यानी अगर घर के अंदर घर की स्त्री कुड़ती है लड़ती है लड़ाकी है क्लेश है
says: If the woman of the house fumes, fights and is quarrelsome so that there is constant strife in the house, then the Venus side of that home is disturbed.
ambiguity: The consequence is in the next sentence.
classical_check: Venus as karaka of wife and harmony is classical.

gist: Banter with a person in the audience about whether they understand and whether he should leave.

hindi: तो उस घर के अंदर शुक्र नेगेटिवली पंप अप रहेगा और लोन बढ़ेगा
says: In a house with such strife Venus stays pumped up in a negative way, and the loan keeps growing.
classical_check: Silent; this household-to-loan link is his own.

hindi: इसलिए उसको मस्त शांत प्रेम से र नहीं है ज्यादा मीठा खाने की शौकीन हो जाती है
says: So she should be kept happy, calm and loved, because otherwise such a woman becomes fond of eating too much sweet; the middle of the sentence is garbled.
ambiguity: Garbled in the middle ('र नहीं है').
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: क्योंकि शुक्र ही शुक्र का दोष है खाना और मंगल कहता है मुझे मीठा बहुत पलना है तो ये जाकर के आपका पैंक्रियास प लोड म मार देता है
says: Food is Venus's own fault area, and Mars says it wants a lot of sweets, so the combination ends up loading the pancreas; this is the speaker's health claim, not a medical diagnosis.
ambiguity: Flagged as a health-related claim; the pancreas link is not a classical house or planet rule.
classical_check: Silent; Venus for sweets and the pancreas is a modern link.

gist: Aside: 'I know it, I am telling it only' in reply to an interruption.
Audience question: how to know whether the loan should be repaid or not.

hindi: अगर आपकी कुंडली में छ बव घर से कैसे भी मंगल का एसोसिएशन है चाहे उसकी राशि पड़ी है चाहे दृष्टि है चाहे छठे घर से से देख रहा है चाहे आपका पांचवें घर से देख रहा है
says: If Mars is associated in any way with the 6th house in the chart, whether the 6th house sign is Mars's, or Mars aspects it, or Mars looks from the 6th or from the 5th, then the person should not repay the loan.
cells_derived_method: Mars touches the 6th by owning its sign (Aries or Scorpio on the 6th), by sitting in it, or by aspect from the 3rd (4th aspect), 12th (7th aspect) and 11th (8th aspect); each route differs by which house Mars is in.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars's own sign Aries on the 6th (lagna Scorpio) gives the sign link, so the rule says do not repay the loan.
Derived: Mars in Gemini in the 3rd (lagna Aries) casts its 4th aspect on the 6th house, so the aspect route applies.
Derived: Mars in Pisces in the 12th (lagna Aries) casts its 7th aspect on the 6th, so the same rule applies through the 12th.

ambiguity: A Mars in the 5th does not aspect the 6th by the usual Parashari rule; he may mean a Jaimini sign aspect or a different count, so the 5th-house route is uncertain.
classical_check: 6th house as debt is classical; the 'do not repay' conclusion is his own and the 5th-house aspect differs from Parashari special aspects.

hindi: लोन उतारो ही मत क्योंकि जब तक लोन नहीं उतरेगा आपके पास पैसे आते रहेंगे मंगल का एक सीधा सा रोल है भाई लोन है तेरे पर तो दूंगा पैसे और लोन ना है तो नहीं दूंगा
says: In that case do not repay the loan, because as long as the loan stays money keeps coming; he explains Mars's simple role as giving money when you owe a loan and not giving when there is none. This is a financial claim of the speaker and not advice for use.
ambiguity: Financial guidance; flagged and not usable as advice.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts never say a loan should be left unpaid.

hindi: जैसे कि भाई हनुमान जी कहते थे भाई अगर तो पंगा है तो मैं बैठा हूं और नहीं बैठा हूं नहीं है पंगा तो मैं बैठा ही हूं उतार दोगे तो कुछ और नया च जाएगा
says: He uses a Hanuman analogy: if there is trouble I sit here, and if there is none I still sit here; if you clear the loan something new will land on you, so the loan acts as a placeholder that keeps other trouble away.
ambiguity: The analogy is loose and the caption is garbled in the middle.
classical_check: Hanuman as a Mars deity is a popular association; the placeholder logic is his own.

hindi: इसलिए लोन चढ़ाए रखो थोड़ा सा लोन चढ़ा के रखो और ब्याज देना लेकिन उसका जरूरी है अगर ब्याज नहीं दे रहे तो वो लोन नहीं होगा वो नहीं आएगा आपको ब्याज जरूर देना है कम दो ज्यादा दो ब्याज जरूर दो
says: Therefore keep some loan outstanding and always pay the interest, little or more, since without paying interest it does not work as a loan and the money will not come; this is the speaker's financial claim, not advice the engine may give.
ambiguity: Financial advice; flagged.
classical_check: Silent; no classical support for keeping debt.

hindi: यह प्रॉब्लम आती है गौ सेवा गुण बेस्ट है गुण होता ही मंगल है गुण मंगल है
says: When this loan problem arises, cow service and jaggery are the best remedies, because jaggery (gud) is Mars.
ambiguity: 'गुण' is read as 'gud' (jaggery).
classical_check: Jaggery as a Mars item is a folk assignment, not classical (Mars items are red lentil, copper and red coral).

gist: Says it is the last question.
Audience question: secret donation is called mahadaan, but some people show off donations on social media; does that cancel the effect.

hindi: उनका इफेक्ट तो गुप्त क है मीडिया पे आ ग गुप्त कहां है वो
says: Once a donation has come out on media it is no longer secret, so it cannot count as secret donation (gupt daan) and its special merit does not apply; the caption is partly garbled.
ambiguity: Garbled; the sense is inferred from 'where is it secret'.
classical_check: Agrees with the Gita and Puranic view that publicised charity loses merit.

hindi: और सबसे बड़ी बात गुप्त धन महाधन होता है
says: Secret wealth is great wealth, so hidden giving and hidden holding of wealth is the highest kind.
classical_check: Echoes the proverb 'gupt daan mahadaan'; not a Jyotish text rule.

gist: Asks why people chase punya, what they will do with it, and says we are very afraid; says Vaikuntha means being free of kuntha (hang-ups).

Says honey and nectar go to the pituitary and pineal glands, that the brain secretes the hormone DMT, and that people take drugs because the brain makes it; a physiology and spirituality aside, not astrology.
Recommends the Netflix film Upgrade, saying it is totally about the brain.
Says your brain makes all the chemicals and makes you feel good or bad.

hindi: यह पक्की गारंटी है अगर तुम बीमार हो तो तुम्हारे भोजन में त्रुटि है अब तुम भजन करो ना
says: He guarantees that if you are ill there is a fault in your food, and then jokes that you should go and do bhajan instead; a health claim of the speaker, not a medical statement.
ambiguity: The 'guarantee' is rhetorical.
classical_check: Ayurveda stresses diet in disease; the guarantee is overstated.

gist: Audience reply that he eats the best food; he says that is fine.

hindi: हो सकता है बेस्ट खाना तुम्हें सूट नहीं करता अगर आपकी बात पित्त कफ प्रवृत्ति है और आपकी पित्त प्रव है तो आपको पित्त वाला भोजन ही खाना है
says: Even the best food may not suit you; if your constitution is pitta-dominant or pitta-kapha, you should eat according to your constitution (he says pitta-type food), not what others call best.
ambiguity: Caption is garbled; 'eat pitta food' contradicts Ayurveda, which advises pitta-pacifying food for pitta people, so he may mean 'food that suits your prakriti'.
classical_check: Ayurveda recommends food that balances the dosha, which is the opposite of eating more of the same; this slice differs from it or is garbled.

hindi: आप मिर्च वाले खाने की डिस बैलेंसिंग करोगे बॉडी खराब हो जाएगी अब बताओ आपको खाना ही गंदा खाना है
says: If you try to balance and offset a body that likes spicy food by changing the diet too much, the body will be spoiled; he then asks whether you want to eat bad food at all.
ambiguity: Garbled and loose; the claim is that forcing a diet against one's nature backfires.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: तमस का जब तामसिक प्रवृत्ति है तो अब आपको नॉनवेज नहीं खाओगे
says: For a person of tamasic nature, he implies non-vegetarian food is natural, so such a person will not stop eating it; the sentence is partly garbled and the conclusion inferred.
ambiguity: Can be read as 'a tamasic person will not give up non-veg' or as a question; read the first way.
classical_check: Gita classifies food by guna and ties tamasic food to tamasic temperament, which agrees.

gist: Says people may call him a promoter of non-veg but he is not; of 100 people only about 25 get liver failure from alcohol and another 25 do not drink at all.

Says drunk driving is harmful but argues that out of 100 road accidents only 25 involved drinkers, so the rest are unrelated to alcohol, and calls the alarmist talk useless hypnosis; a road-safety opinion, not astrology.
Whatever is publicised becomes popular and people get fooled by it; warns not to fall into hypnosis from any pretentious guru, and not to take his own words that way either.
Tells listeners to look at things by their own judgement, learn by being knocked about, keep a witness attitude, know life and take knowledge.
Distinguishes knowledge from wisdom: the one who gives knowledge is a teacher, and the one who gives wisdom is the guru.
Defines guru as one who gives no worldly knowledge but switches on the guru inside you; says others are not gurus.
Says many ask him for a guru mantra, he replies he does not feel worthy; then a garbled remark about charging for telling and some people having crores stuck in the market asking what to do.
Says human consciousness is the most powerful force, advises doing things happily and talks about the nonsense one did as a child.

Recalls childhood sleep as carefree, says adults are never truly asleep or awake and live in constant lucid dreaming, and advises taking information and living an intoxicated life; the point is a mood, not a rule.
Claims people drink because they are afraid and chant the name of Ram because of fear, and that more naam-japa shows more fear and affects the kidney; a health and devotional claim, not astrology.
Says Krishna asked to come to his refuge and never said to chant his name, and that a God who takes offence is no God, using the example of a grandfather whose moustache a child pulls.

hindi: एयर वाटर फायर तीन एलिमेंट है मुझे चुप करा दो करा दो अ भी बता रहा हूं ये तीन तत्व
says: He introduces air, water and fire as three elements, saying he will explain these three principles even if people want to silence him; the explanation continues in the next row.
ambiguity: Earth and space are left out here; the caption does not say why only three elements are named.
classical_check: Classical Jyotish and Ayurveda use five elements (earth, water, fire, air, space), so naming three differs, probably as a simplification for Krishna's nature.

hindi: अकेले हैं जो पूर्ण पुरुष कृष्ण में मिले बाकी सब में डिस बैलेंस ऑफ एनर्जी थी इस कारण कृष्ण ही पूर्ण परमात्मा कहा जाता है
says: These three elements are found in balance only in Krishna, the complete being, whereas every other figure had an imbalance of energy; that is why Krishna alone is called the complete Paramatma.
ambiguity: A devotional claim; not tied to a planet or house.
classical_check: Krishna as purna avatar (sixteen kalas) is Puranic; the three-element balance claim is his own.

hindi: इस कारण तमस रजस सत्व त्रिगुणात्मक ट्रिनिटी यह तीनों के तीनों कृष्ण के स्वरूप में ही माने जाते हैं उसी में जाने जाते हैं
says: The three gunas, tamas, rajas and sattva, forming a trinity, are all held to be present together in Krishna's form, which is why he is seen as complete.
classical_check: The three gunas are Samkhya and Gita doctrine; the trinity linking and Krishna being above them is traditional.

gist: Says the complete person who gave saam, daam, dand, bhed, the Gita and knowledge is the guru and not a mere teacher, and that nowhere in the Gita did he say to worship or tell beads.
Says people will ask whether he has read the Gita and he replies he has not, and that reading it may bring out anything; a quip about danger and debate.

Notes that many people never take God's name or visit temples yet enjoy life like rockets and are frightened with hell, answers they can meet there, and says heaven and hell are hypnosis, everything is in this world.
Says we came to this earth to live, enjoy and learn by hard knocks.
Says we should never feel sorrow because life is the teacher, gurus are met at every step but we do not become disciples, and we must be willing to learn.
Says it is necessary to know the difference between a teacher and a guru, and that everyone in life is teaching something.
Says he will speak no more, feels it is too much, wants to close the class, thanks everyone and asks for blessings; asks what the announcement for next week is.
